title: Jr. Quality Engineer
description:
Quality Control Engineer

Company: Kuche7 Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd.

Department: Quality Control (QC)

Designation: Jr. QC Engineer

Location: Bhiwandi, Maharashtra

Salary: 20K \- 25K Per Month

Experience: 0–2 year

About the Role

We are looking for a Jr. QC Engineer to join our manufacturing team. The candidate will be responsible for supporting quality inspections, maintaining quality standards, identifying process/product defects, and assisting in continuous improvement activities across the manufacturing process.

Key Responsibilities

Perform incoming, in\-process, and final quality inspections of materials and finished products.

Inspect sheet metal components, fabricated parts, painted components, and modular furniture/kitchen assemblies as per quality standards.

Check product dimensions using measuring instruments such as Vernier caliper, measuring tape, gauges, etc.

Identify and record defects, deviations, and quality issues during production.

Support preparation and maintenance of inspection reports, check sheets, NCRs, and quality records.

Coordinate with Production, R\&D, PPC, Paint, and Assembly teams to resolve quality issues.

Assist in root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).

Monitor compliance with approved drawings, specifications, BOM/MBOM, and quality standards.

Conduct regular process audits and product inspections on the shop floor.

Support implementation of 5S, quality improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Maintain proper documentation of inspection results and quality\-related data.

Assist senior QC team members in customer complaint analysis and corrective actions.

Required Qualifications

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering – Fresher preferred.

Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes and quality control concepts.

Basic understanding of engineering drawings and dimensions.

Knowledge of Vernier caliper and basic measuring instruments.

Basic knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office.

Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.

Good communication and coordination skills.

Willingness to work on the manufacturing shop floor.

Ready to work at Bhiwandi location.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of sheet metal manufacturing, fabrication, bending, laser cutting, painting, and assembly will be an advantage.

Basic knowledge of 7 QC Tools, 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, and CAPA.

Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 will be an added advantage.

Key Competencies

Quality consciousness

Attention to detail

Problem\-solving ability

Analytical thinking

Teamwork

Willingness to learn

Discipline and accountability

Practical exposure to end\-to\-end manufacturing and quality processes

title: Guest Relation Executive
description:
**GUEST RELATION EXECUTIVE — i'Deli Cafe**

Create Connections. Deliver Exceptional Experiences.

We are opening a new i'Deli Cafe outlet in Kakkanad, Kochi, and are looking for a warm, confident, and customer\-focused Guest Relation Executive to be part of our front\-of\-house team.

The Guest Relation Executive will be responsible for creating a welcoming guest experience, maintaining high service standards, handling guest interactions professionally, and supporting the smooth day\-to\-day operations of the outlet while consistently representing i'Deli Cafe's standards.

Guest Experience

* Welcome and greet guests warmly upon arrival.
* Create a friendly, professional, and positive first impression.
* Understand guest preferences and provide attentive, personalised service.
* Assist guests with seating, menu information, and general enquiries.
* Ensure guests feel comfortable and well cared for throughout their visit.
* Maintain a high standard of hospitality from guest arrival to departure.
* Engage with guests in a polite, confident, and professional manner.
* Thank guests and encourage them to return.

Guest Relations

* Build positive relationships with regular and new guests.
* Understand and respond appropriately to guest needs and expectations.
* Handle guest feedback, requests, and concerns professionally.
* Resolve service\-related issues promptly or escalate them to the appropriate supervisor when required.
* Follow up on guest concerns to ensure satisfactory resolution.
* Maintain a calm and positive attitude when dealing with difficult or demanding situations.
* Collect guest feedback and communicate relevant insights to the Outlet Manager or Supervisor.
* Support initiatives aimed at improving guest satisfaction and retention.

Service Support

* Coordinate closely with service staff, kitchen team, cashiers, and supervisors.
* Assist the service team during busy operating periods.
* Ensure smooth communication between guests and the restaurant team.
* Monitor guest tables and identify when assistance is required.
* Support the team in maintaining smooth guest flow during peak hours.
* Assist with reservations, table allocation, waiting lists, and guest enquiries when required.
* Ensure special requests and guest preferences are communicated accurately to the relevant team members.
* Support efficient service while maintaining hospitality standards.

Menu \& Product Knowledge

* Develop a strong understanding of the i'Deli Cafe menu.
* Be familiar with ingredients, preparation styles, portion options, and key product information.
* Understand basic allergen and dietary information and communicate it accurately.
* Answer guest questions about menu items confidently and professionally.
* Recommend suitable food and beverage options based on guest preferences.
* Stay updated on new menu items, promotions, seasonal offerings, and special products.
* Never provide inaccurate information regarding ingredients or allergens; clarify with the kitchen or supervisor when necessary.

Guest Feedback \& Complaint Handling

* Listen carefully to guest feedback without interrupting.
* Acknowledge concerns with empathy and professionalism.
* Take appropriate action within the scope of responsibility.
* Inform the Outlet Manager or Supervisor of significant complaints or recurring issues.
* Record or communicate important guest feedback accurately.
* Follow up where required to ensure the guest's concern has been addressed.
* Identify recurring service issues and communicate them to management.
* Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive guest matters.

Customer Service Standards

* Maintain i'Deli Cafe's standards of courtesy, grooming, communication, and hospitality.
* Use professional and positive language when interacting with guests.
* Maintain appropriate body language and a welcoming presence.
* Avoid arguments, confrontations, or negative interactions with guests.
* Remain attentive and approachable throughout the shift.
* Ensure every guest interaction reflects the brand's values and service standards.
* Maintain consistency in guest service during both busy and quiet periods.

Outlet Operations

* Support opening and closing procedures as assigned.
* Ensure the guest\-facing areas are clean, organised, and presentable.
* Check that reception, waiting, dining, and other guest areas maintain required standards.
* Assist with maintaining smooth guest movement within the outlet.
* Coordinate with the team during peak periods and special occasions.
* Support daily operational requirements as directed by the Outlet Manager.
* Follow all company policies, SOPs, and operational procedures.

Hygiene \& Grooming

* Maintain excellent personal hygiene and professional grooming at all times.
* Follow i'Deli Cafe grooming and uniform standards.
* Ensure the guest\-facing environment is clean and presentable.
* Follow all applicable food\-safety, hygiene, and workplace\-safety procedures.
* Maintain a professional appearance throughout the shift.
* Report cleanliness, maintenance, or safety concerns immediately.

Communication \& Coordination

* Communicate clearly and respectfully with guests and colleagues.
* Maintain effective coordination with the Kitchen, Service, Cashier, and Management teams.
* Communicate guest requests accurately and promptly.
* Ensure important information is passed to the relevant team members.
* Participate in daily briefings and team meetings.
* Maintain a positive and collaborative working relationship with all departments.

Sales \& Guest Engagement

* Support the team in achieving outlet sales and guest satisfaction targets.
* Promote menu items, specials, and new products appropriately.
* Identify opportunities to enhance the guest experience through suitable recommendations.
* Encourage repeat visits through positive and memorable interactions.
* Support promotional activities, events, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Maintain a service\-first approach without being overly pushy or transactional.

Events \& Special Occasions

* Assist in coordinating guest requirements for birthdays, celebrations, group visits, and special occasions.
* Ensure special requests are communicated clearly to the relevant teams.
* Support the smooth execution of guest events within the outlet.
* Help create a memorable experience for guests during special occasions.
* Coordinate with management regarding VIP or special guest requirements when applicable.

Training \& Development

* Continuously improve communication, hospitality, and customer\-service skills.
* Learn and follow i'Deli Cafe service standards, SOPs, and guest\-handling procedures.
* Participate in product, menu, service, and brand training.
* Stay updated on new products, promotions, and operational procedures.
* Accept feedback from senior team members and management.
* Demonstrate willingness to learn and take on additional responsibilities.

New Outlet Opening

* Support the guest\-relations setup and pre\-opening activities of the new Kakkanad outlet.
* Participate in service training and guest\-handling practice sessions.
* Assist with establishing front\-of\-house service routines and standards.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and customer\-focused **Sales Consultant** to join our passenger car dealership in **Jhansi**. The candidate will be responsible for generating leads, handling customer enquiries, explaining vehicle features, conducting test drives, converting enquiries into bookings and retail sales, and achieving assigned sales targets while maintaining excellent customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Attend showroom walk\-in customers and understand their vehicle requirements, preferences, and budget.
* Explain vehicle features, specifications, variants, pricing, offers, finance, insurance, exchange, and accessories.
* Conduct professional vehicle presentations and product demonstrations.
* Arrange and conduct test drives for prospective customers.
* Generate leads through showroom walk\-ins, tele\-calling, referrals, digital leads, events, and other sources.
* Follow up regularly with prospective customers and convert enquiries into bookings and sales.
* Achieve assigned **monthly sales and retail targets**.
* Maintain accurate customer and lead information in the CRM/DMS.

* Promote finance, insurance, accessories, exchange, and other dealership products.
* Coordinate with finance, insurance, accessories, and delivery teams for smooth vehicle delivery.
* Maintain good relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Ensure timely post\-sales follow\-up and customer satisfaction.
* Stay updated on new vehicle launches, product specifications, competitor models, pricing, and market trends.
* Participate in road shows, exhibitions, promotional activities, and customer events.
* Follow dealership and manufacturer sales processes and standards.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Monthly retail sales target achievement
* Enquiry\-to\-booking conversion

title: Head of Projects
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONHead / Senior Manager – Projects

**Department:** Projects  
**Designation:** Head / Senior Manager – Projects  
**Industry:** Mechanical / Engineering / EPC Projects  
**Reporting To:** Director / Managing Director / Business Head  
**Location:** Head Office / Project Sites

1\. Job Purpose

To lead and manage the complete lifecycle of mechanical EPC projects from project award through engineering, procurement, construction, installation, commissioning and final handover, ensuring timely completion, cost control, quality, safety and customer satisfaction.

The position will provide strategic and operational leadership to project teams and ensure effective coordination between Engineering, Procurement, Planning, Construction, QA/QC, HSE, Finance, HR and client/consultant teams.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Project Planning \& Execution

* Take overall responsibility for successful execution of assigned mechanical EPC projects.
* Review project scope, contract conditions, specifications, drawings, BOQ, timelines and deliverables.
* Develop and implement detailed project execution plans and project schedules.
* Establish project milestones, manpower requirements, resource plans and execution strategies.
* Monitor project progress against approved schedule and take corrective actions for delays.
* Ensure effective mobilisation and deployment of manpower, equipment, materials and other resources.
* Drive timely completion of engineering, procurement, fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning activities.
* Identify project risks and implement mitigation plans.

B. Project Management \& Control

* Monitor project cost, budget, cash flow, productivity and profitability.
* Ensure projects are executed within approved budgets and contractual timelines.
* Review project MIS, DPR/WPR/MPR, progress reports and management dashboards.
* Track planned vs. actual progress, productivity, manpower utilisation and project costs.
* Identify deviations and initiate appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Conduct periodic project review meetings with internal teams and clients.

C. EPC \& Contract Management

* Review and understand EPC contracts, work orders, scope of work, technical specifications and commercial terms.
* Ensure contractual obligations are clearly communicated to the project team.
* Identify variations, additional works, claims and potential commercial risks.
* Coordinate with the commercial/contracts team for submission and recovery of variation claims.
* Manage client/consultant communications relating to scope, schedule, resources, variations and project issues.
* Ensure proper documentation and records are maintained for contractual and commercial matters.

D. Engineering \& Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with Engineering teams for timely release of drawings, technical documents and specifications.
* Review constructability and ensure engineering deliverables are aligned with site requirements.
* Coordinate technical clarifications with clients, consultants and vendors.
* Ensure proper integration between mechanical, piping, structural, electrical and instrumentation activities wherever applicable.
* Support technical resolution of site execution issues.

E. Procurement \& Material Management

* Coordinate with Procurement and Stores teams to ensure timely availability of project materials.
* Monitor procurement schedules against project requirements.
* Review critical material and equipment procurement status.
* Ensure proper coordination with suppliers, subcontractors and vendors.
* Minimise project delays arising from material shortages and procurement issues.

F. Construction \& Site Management

* Provide leadership to project/site managers and construction teams.
* Ensure efficient execution of fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning activities.
* Monitor manpower productivity and equipment utilisation.
* Drive productivity improvement and minimise idle manpower and equipment costs.
* Ensure proper coordination between various site functions and subcontractors.
* Conduct regular site visits and project performance reviews.

G. Quality \& HSE

* Ensure strict compliance with approved QA/QC procedures, ITPs, inspection requirements and project specifications.
* Ensure adherence to company and client HSE standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture across all project sites.
* Review quality and safety performance and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure project documentation and final handover dossiers are completed as per contractual requirements.

H. Team Leadership \& People Management

* Lead, mentor and develop Project Managers, Project Engineers, Site Managers and other project personnel.
* Define responsibilities, targets and KPIs for project teams.
* Assess manpower requirements and coordinate with HR for recruitment and deployment.
* Build a high\-performance project management team.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide guidance for capability development.

I. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants and other stakeholders.
* Act as the senior point of contact for major project\-related matters.
* Participate in project kick\-off meetings, progress reviews and senior management discussions.
* Resolve escalated project issues in coordination with the client and internal management.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and successful project closure.

J. Project Closure

* Ensure completion of punch points, testing, commissioning and final handover.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, test certificates and completion dossiers.
* Ensure commercial closure, reconciliation and final billing are completed.
* Conduct project close\-out reviews and document lessons learned.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Project completion within approved schedule.
* Project profitability and cost control.
* Planned vs. actual project progress.
* Manpower productivity and utilisation.
* Reduction in project delays and idle manpower costs.
* Material availability and procurement performance.
* Quality performance and reduction in rework.
* Safety performance and accident prevention.
* Timely billing and cash\-flow realisation.
* Variation/claim identification and recovery.
* Client satisfaction.
* Successful project handover and closure.

4\. Qualification

**Essential:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **PMP / Project Management certification is mandatory or highly preferred.**
* Additional certification in Project Management, Construction Management or Contract Management will be an advantage.

5\. Experience

* **15–20\+ years of relevant experience** in mechanical project execution, preferably in EPC / Engineering / Construction organisations.
* Proven experience in handling **large\-scale mechanical EPC projects** from project initiation to completion.
* Experience in managing multidisciplinary project teams and multiple projects/sites.
* Strong exposure to engineering, procurement, fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning.
* Experience in project planning, cost control, contracts, client management and commercial coordination.
* Experience in handling project teams, subcontractors, vendors and consultants.

6\. Desired Industry Exposure

Experience in one or more of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical / Refinery
* Chemical / Process Plants
* Semiconductor / Advanced Manufacturing
* Power / Utilities
* Piping \& Mechanical EPC
* Industrial Projects
* Structural \& Mechanical Projects
* Fabrication, Erection \& Commissioning

7\. Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong project planning and execution capability.
* Excellent leadership and team management skills.

title: Field Recruiter
description:
About the Position

HyreSpot is looking for a proactive and energetic Field Recruiter to expand our candidate network and support our growing recruitment operations.

This is a field\-oriented recruitment position for someone who enjoys meeting people, developing contacts, identifying potential candidates, and converting hiring opportunities into successful joins.

The person in this role will work closely with the HR and Talent Acquisition team while independently exploring candidate sources such as local communities, colleges, training institutes, job fairs, referrals, job portals, and social media.

If you are confident speaking with people, enjoy networking, and are motivated by targets, this could be a good opportunity to build your career with HyreSpot.

Key Responsibilities

\* Identify and attract suitable candidates through field visits, referrals, online platforms, educational institutions, training centres, and local professional networks.

\* Meet candidates personally to understand their qualifications, experience, career interests, availability, and preferred job opportunities.

\* Conduct preliminary screening and shortlist candidates based on the requirements provided by the recruitment team.

\* Organize and participate in walk\-in interviews, recruitment campaigns, hiring drives, job fairs, and other talent acquisition activities.

\* Coordinate candidate interviews with the internal recruitment team and ensure candidates receive timely information about the process.

\* Maintain regular follow\-ups with shortlisted candidates and support them through documentation, selection, and joining.

\* Develop candidate networks within the assigned territory and continuously identify new sources for quality applicants.

\* Establish professional relationships with colleges, training institutes, placement centres, local organizations, and other talent pools.

\* Introduce candidates to HyreSpot's career opportunities and communicate job information clearly and professionally.

\* Assist the HR team in local employer\-branding and candidate\-engagement activities.

\* Monitor recruitment activity within the assigned area and identify effective methods for attracting candidates.

\* Share candidate feedback and local market information, including availability of talent and hiring trends, with the HR team.

\* Maintain accurate candidate details and ensure recruitment records are updated on time.

\* Submit daily and weekly activity reports covering sourcing, calls, meetings, interviews, selections, and joining status.

\* Work towards assigned recruitment targets and contribute to the team's overall hiring performance.

Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from:

\* Fresh graduates interested in building a career in recruitment or HR.

\* Candidates with up to 3 years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience.

\* Professionals from field sales, business development, customer service, telecalling, or other people\-oriented roles who want to move into recruitment.

Candidates with strong local networks and excellent communication skills.

A degree in any discipline is acceptable. An HR, Business Administration, or related qualification will be an added advantage.

What We Are Looking For

Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

Confidence in approaching and speaking with new people.

Strong networking and relationship\-building ability.

Good follow\-up discipline.

A result\-oriented approach towards assigned targets.

Ability to manage recruitment activities independently.

Comfortable travelling within the assigned territory.

Basic knowledge of computers, email, spreadsheets, and online recruitment platforms.

Knowledge of the local language will be an advantage.

Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

Experience That Will Help

Prior exposure to any of the following will be useful:

However, freshers with the right attitude, communication skills, and willingness to work in the field are encouraged to apply.

Compensation \& Benefits

Salary: ₹16,000 – ₹24,000 per month, depending on experience, skills, and interview performance.

Additional Benefits:

Performance\-based recruitment incentives.

Travel allowance/reimbursement as per company policy.

Recruitment and talent acquisition training.

Practical exposure to multiple hiring channels.

Opportunity to develop a strong professional network.

Career progression opportunities within HR and Talent Acquisition.

Recognition for achieving recruitment and joining targets.

Career Opportunity

This role can provide a strong starting point for candidates who want to develop a long\-term career in Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Staffing, or Business Development.

High\-performing employees may be considered for increased responsibilities and future career progression within the organization based on performance, consistency, and business requirements.

Apply Now

If you enjoy meeting people, building connections, finding talent, and working towards measurable goals, HyreSpot would like to hear from you. apply: sridhar.palanisamy@hyrespot.com

Join us and become part of a growing recruitment team focused on connecting candidates with meaningful career opportunities.

description:
**Company Description**  

Raffles Udaipur opened in 2021, its ornamental gardens, tumbling fountains and stately Indo\-Saracenic architecture describing a love story between India and the West. Set on a 21\-acre private island rich with birdlife and exotic flora and fauna, this contemporary reimagining of a country mansion is the first Raffles hotel in India.


Just 20 minutes from the airport, Raffles Udaipur spans a private island and serene lakeshore. Begin your journey with a graceful boat ride, guided by migratory birds. Discover 137 rooms and suites, 10 dining experiences, two pools, wellness rituals, and the timeless care of the Raffles Butler.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented Learning \& Development Manager to join our team in Udaipur, India. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing comprehensive training and development programs that drive organizational excellence and foster employee growth. Reporting to the Director of People \& Culture, you will collaborate with leadership teams across the organization to create a culture of continuous learning and professional development. This is an excellent opportunity for an innovative and empathetic professional to make a meaningful impact on our workforce's skills, engagement, and career progression.

* Design, develop, and facilitate a variety of training programs including onboarding, leadership development, skills enhancement, and specialized workshops to support organizational goals and employee development
* Execute a comprehensive onboarding experience for new employees, ensuring a smooth transition and strong foundation for success; continuously update and improve onboarding processes based on feedback and organizational needs
* Conduct thorough needs assessments in collaboration with department leaders to identify skill gaps and training requirements; translate findings into actionable learning strategies
* Manage and maintain accurate records of all training activities, participant information, and completion rates; analyze training data and metrics to measure program effectiveness and ROI
* Support the development and coaching of departmental trainers, ensuring consistency, compliance, and quality across all training initiatives throughout the organization
* Oversee the administration of online learning management systems, including course assignments, progress monitoring, and completion tracking for mandatory and elective programs
* Partner with operational leaders to review job task checklists and training tools, ensuring they support effective departmental onboarding and skill development
* Collaborate with regional Learning \& Development counterparts to align strategic direction, share best practices, and maintain consistency across the organization
* Support apprenticeship programs and educational assistance initiatives, fostering a culture of lifelong learning and professional growth
* Oversee the performance review program to ensure timely and thorough completion of probationary and annual reviews for all employees
* Contribute to broader People \& Culture operations and organizational initiatives as assigned; demonstrate flexibility and willingness to adapt to evolving business needs

  

**Qualifications**  

\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*

* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in a leadership role, preferably within the hospitality, service, or corporate environment
* Proven experience in designing and facilitating training programs that drive measurable results and service excellence
* Demonstrated expertise in conducting needs assessments and translating organizational requirements into effective learning solutions
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Publisher, Excel, and Word)
* Proficiency with online learning management systems and training administration platforms
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop data\-driven improvement strategies
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly to diverse audiences
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
* Ability to build and maintain strong interpersonal relationships with colleagues at all organizational levels


\*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*

* Previous experience in Learning \& Development, talent management, or human resources functions
* University degree in Hotel/Restaurant Management, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline
* Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies
* Experience with budget management and financial planning for training programs
* Familiarity with change management practices and organizational development
* Coaching and mentoring experience
* Experience developing and delivering leadership development programs


\*\*Key Competencies:\*\*

* Enthusiastic, positive, and motivational approach to employee development
* Detail\-oriented with strong attention to accuracy and quality
* Innovative and creative mindset with willingness to explore new training methodologies
* Collaborative approach to working with cross\-functional teams
* Flexible and adaptable with the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Results\-oriented with a commitment to achieving organizational goals
* Empathetic and supportive in fostering employee growth and engagement
* Inclusive mindset that values diverse perspectives and backgrounds
* Efficient and organized in managing time and resources effectively
* Visionary thinking with the ability to anticipate future organizational learning needs

title: Valuation Analyst
description:
Position Title

Valuation Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Vehicle and Machinery Valuator to assess the value and condition of vehicles, heavy equipment, industrial machinery, and other mechanical assets. The successful candidate will conduct physical inspections, analyze market data, determine fair market values, and prepare accurate valuation reports for clients, financial institutions, insurance companies, or internal business purposes.

Key Responsibilities

* Inspect and evaluate vehicles, heavy machinery, construction equipment, and industrial machines.
* Assess the age, condition, specifications, usage, maintenance history, and remaining useful life of assets.
* Determine market value, fair value, replacement value, and/or liquidation value as required.
* Research current market prices, comparable sales, auction results, and industry trends.
* Verify vehicle and machinery identification, model, serial numbers, registration details, and specifications.
* Identify damage, defects, depreciation, modifications, and other factors affecting asset value.
* Prepare detailed and professional valuation reports with photographs and supporting evidence.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, calculations, market research, and valuation conclusions.
* Communicate valuation findings clearly to clients and other stakeholders.
* Conduct site visits to workshops, yards, construction sites, factories, dealerships, and other locations when required.
* Keep up to date with changes in vehicle, machinery, and equipment markets.
* Ensure valuations are conducted in accordance with applicable company procedures and professional standards.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum 10th Pass
* Relevant experience in vehicle appraisal, machinery valuation, equipment inspection, automotive, engineering, insurance, banking, or asset management.
* Good knowledge of different types of vehicles, construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and industrial machinery.
* Strong understanding of depreciation and factors affecting the value of mechanical assets.
* Ability to conduct market research and analyze comparable assets.
* Good numerical, analytical, and report\-writing skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Willingness to travel for physical inspections.

Preferred Skills

* Experience valuing cars, commercial vehicles, trucks, buses, earthmoving equipment, cranes, generators, industrial machinery, and production equipment.
* Knowledge of auction and resale markets.
* Familiarity with insurance, finance, banking, or asset\-recovery valuation requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and professional judgment.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Valid driving license is an advantage.
* Key Performance Indicators
* Accuracy and consistency of valuation reports.
* Quality and completeness of physical inspections.
* Reliability of market research and valuation calculations.
* Timely completion of assignments.
* Compliance with professional and company valuation standards.
* Client satisfaction and quality of communication.

Working Conditions

The role may involve both office\-based valuation analysis and field inspections. The Valuator may be required to travel to client premises, workshops, dealerships, warehouses, construction sites, auction yards, and industrial facilities.

Employment Type

Full\-time

Reporting To

Valuation Manager / Head of Valuation

Pay: ₹12,500\.00 \- ₹16,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Vehicle and Machinery Valuator to assess the value and condition of vehicles, heavy equipment, industrial machinery, and other mechanical assets. The successful candidate will conduct physical inspections, analyze market data, determine fair market values, and prepare accurate valuation reports for clients, financial institutions, insurance companies, or internal business purposes.

Key Responsibilities

* Inspect and evaluate vehicles, heavy machinery, construction equipment, and industrial machines.
* Assess the age, condition, specifications, usage, maintenance history, and remaining useful life of assets.

* Research current market prices, comparable sales, auction results, and industry trends.
* Verify vehicle and machinery identification, model, serial numbers, registration details, and specifications.
* Identify damage, defects, depreciation, modifications, and other factors affecting asset value.

* Maintain accurate records of inspections, calculations, market research, and valuation conclusions.
* Communicate valuation findings clearly to clients and other stakeholders.
* Conduct site visits to workshops, yards, construction sites, factories, dealerships, and other locations when required.
* Keep up to date with changes in vehicle, machinery, and equipment markets.
* Ensure valuations are conducted in accordance with applicable company procedures and professional standards.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum 10th Pass
* Relevant experience in vehicle appraisal, machinery valuation, equipment inspection, automotive, engineering, insurance, banking, or asset management.
* Good knowledge of different types of vehicles, construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and industrial machinery.
* Strong understanding of depreciation and factors affecting the value of mechanical assets.
* Ability to conduct market research and analyze comparable assets.
* Good numerical, analytical, and report\-writing skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Willingness to travel for physical inspections.

* Experience valuing cars, commercial vehicles, trucks, buses, earthmoving equipment, cranes, generators, industrial machinery, and production equipment.
* Knowledge of auction and resale markets.
* Familiarity with insurance, finance, banking, or asset\-recovery valuation requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and professional judgment.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

**Department:** Quality Control (QC)  
**Designation:** Jr. QC Engineer  
**Location:** Bhiwandi, Maharashtra  
**Salary:** 20K \- 25K Per Month  
**Experience:** 0–2 year

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Jr. QC Engineer to join our manufacturing team. The candidate will be responsible for supporting quality inspections, maintaining quality standards, identifying process/product defects, and assisting in continuous improvement activities across the manufacturing process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform **incoming, in\-process, and final quality inspections** of materials and finished products.
* Inspect **sheet metal components, fabricated parts, painted components, and modular furniture/kitchen assemblies** as per quality standards.
* Check product dimensions using measuring instruments such as **Vernier caliper, measuring tape, gauges, etc.**
* Identify and record **defects, deviations, and quality issues** during production.
* Support preparation and maintenance of **inspection reports, check sheets, NCRs, and quality records**.
* Coordinate with **Production, R\&D, PPC, Paint, and Assembly teams** to resolve quality issues.
* Assist in **root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA)**.
* Monitor compliance with approved **drawings, specifications, BOM/MBOM, and quality standards**.
* Conduct regular **process audits and product inspections** on the shop floor.
* Support implementation of **5S, quality improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives**.
* Maintain proper documentation of inspection results and quality\-related data.
* Assist senior QC team members in **customer complaint analysis and corrective actions**.

**Required Qualifications**

* **B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering** – Fresher preferred.
* Basic knowledge of **manufacturing processes and quality control concepts**.
* Basic understanding of **engineering drawings and dimensions**.
* Knowledge of **Vernier caliper and basic measuring instruments**.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel and MS Office**.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to work on the **manufacturing shop floor**.
* **Ready to work at Bhiwandi location.**

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of **sheet metal manufacturing, fabrication, bending, laser cutting, painting, and assembly** will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of **7 QC Tools, 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, and CAPA**.
* Knowledge of **ISO 9001:2015** will be an added advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Quality consciousness
* Attention to detail
* Problem\-solving ability
* Analytical thinking
* Teamwork
* Willingness to learn
* Discipline and accountability

* Practical exposure to **end\-to\-end manufacturing and quality processes**
* On\-the\-job training and mentoring
* Opportunity to develop expertise in **manufacturing quality control**

The ideal candidate should have strong analytical and communication skills, an interest in understanding business processes, and the ability to translate business requirements into clear and actionable requirements for technical teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand and analyze **business requirements, processes, and workflows**.

* Prepare and maintain **Business Requirement Documents (BRD)** and **Functional Requirement Documents (FRD)**.
* Convert business requirements into clear **functional requirements and user stories**.
* Create **process flows, workflow diagrams, use cases, and basic wireframes** when required.
* Work closely with **developers, QA/testing teams, project managers, and stakeholders**.
* Identify business problems, gaps, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement.

* Perform basic **data analysis and reporting** using Excel or similar tools.
* Track requirements and ensure proper communication between business and technical teams.
* Maintain accurate project documentation throughout the development lifecycle.

Required Skills

* Strong **analytical and problem\-solving skills**.

* Knowledge of **Requirement Gathering \& Requirement Analysis**.
* Understanding of **BRD, FRD, User Stories, Use Cases, and Acceptance Criteria**.
* Basic knowledge of **Agile/Scrum methodology**.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel** – formulas, sorting, filtering, Pivot Tables, and basic data analysis.
* Basic understanding of **SQL and databases** is an advantage.
* Familiarity with **JIRA, Confluence, Trello, or similar project management tools** is an advantage.
* Good **documentation and presentation skills**.
* Excellent **verbal and written communication skills**.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in **Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com), Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA), Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering**, or a related discipline.

Preferred Keywords

**Business Analyst, Business Analysis, Requirement Gathering, Requirement Analysis, Business Requirements, Functional Requirements, BRD, FRD, User Stories, Use Cases, Acceptance Criteria, Process Mapping, Workflow, Gap Analysis, SDLC, Agile, Scrum, UAT, Stakeholder Management, Documentation, Data Analysis, MS Excel, SQL, JIRA, Confluence, Project Management, Problem Solving, Analytical Skills, Communication Skills.**

Job Description Diploma Electrical Engineer

**Position:** Diploma Electrical Engineer  
**Industry:** Manufacturing  
**Department:** Electrical / Maintenance  
**Work Mode:** On\-site

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Diploma Electrical Engineer** to support electrical maintenance, troubleshooting, and smooth operation of plant machinery and electrical systems. The candidate will be responsible for preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and ensuring electrical safety and equipment reliability.

Key Responsibilities

* Carry out **preventive and breakdown maintenance** of electrical equipment and machinery.
* Troubleshoot electrical faults in production machines, panels, motors, drives, and control systems.
* Maintain and monitor **HT/LT panels, MCC panels, PCC panels, transformers, DG sets, motors, and electrical distribution systems**.
* Handle **PLC, VFD, sensors, contactors, relays, and control circuits** troubleshooting.
* Ensure timely maintenance of electrical equipment to minimize machine downtime.
* Conduct routine inspection of electrical installations and identify potential failures.
* Maintain electrical maintenance records, checklists, and breakdown reports.
* Coordinate with Production and Engineering teams for machine maintenance and improvements.
* Ensure compliance with **electrical safety procedures, PPE requirements, and statutory standards**.
* Support installation, commissioning, and modification of electrical equipment and machinery.
* Maintain adequate electrical spare parts and coordinate with stores/purchase when required.
* Participate in **root cause analysis (RCA)** and implement corrective/preventive actions.

Qualification

* **Diploma in Electrical Engineering** from a recognized institute.
* ITI Electrical candidates with relevant manufacturing experience may also be considered.

Experience

* **2–5 years** of relevant experience in **Electrical Maintenance / Manufacturing Industry**.
* Experience with industrial machinery and electrical maintenance will be preferred.

Required Skills

* Electrical troubleshooting \& maintenance
* Preventive \& breakdown maintenance
* Motors, panels \& control circuits
* PLC \& VFD basics
* HT/LT electrical systems
* Industrial safety
* Root Cause Analysis
* Maintenance documentation

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability.
* Willing to work in **shifts**, if required.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong focus on safety, machine availability, and preventive maintenance.

**Job title:** Head – Tool Room

**Work Location:** Bhosari, Pune

**Department:** Tool Room / Tool Engineering

**Essential Qualifications**

* **B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering**.
* Minimum **10 years of relevant experience** in Tool Room / Press Tool Manufacturing / Tool Engineering.

* Experience in machining, grinding, Wire Cut/EDM, milling, fitting and tool assembly.
* Good understanding of tool manufacturing processes, tool proving and tool corrections.
* Experience in managing Tool Room manpower and machines.
* Strong knowledge of tool manufacturing cost calculation and cost control.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with experience in an **automotive / auto\-component manufacturing environment** will be preferred.

Experience in managing a Tool Room as a **cost centre/profit centre**, including budgeting, costing, manpower and productivity management, will be highly desirable.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Tool Room Operations \& Profit Centre Management

· New Tool Manufacturing

· Tool Maintenance

· Coordination with Design \& Development

· Tool Manufacturing Cost Control

· Consumable Cost Control

· Machine \& Equipment Management

· Systems, Discipline \& Process Improvement

· Manpower Management

· Productivity \& Continuous Improvement

· Management Review \& MIS

· Team Leadership \& Development

**Required Technical \& Managerial Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **Press Tool Design \& Manufacturing**
* Tool Maintenance \& Troubleshooting
* Tool Manufacturing Planning
* Machining \& Tool Room Processes
* VMC / CNC / Wire Cut / EDM / Grinding
* Tool Costing and Cost Control
* Make\-or\-Buy Analysis
* Machine Utilization \& Capacity Planning
* Manpower Planning
* Production Planning \& Monitoring
* Preventive Maintenance
* Root Cause Analysis \& Problem Solving
* Lean / Kaizen / 5S
* MIS and Performance Analysis
* Budgeting and Profitability Management
* Team Leadership and People Management
* Cross\-functional coordination
* Good communication and presentation skills

**Desired Leadership Competencies**

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

* **Ownership\-oriented approach**
* Strong commercial and cost consciousness
* Data\-driven decision making
* Ability to take quick and practical decisions
* Strong shop\-floor presence
* Planning and execution capability
* Problem\-solving mindset
* Team\-building and leadership skills
* Ability to establish systems and discipline
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Ability to manage pressure and delivery commitments

**Authority \& Accountability**

The Head – Tool Room will be accountable for:

**People \+ Machines \+ Cost \+ Quality \+ Delivery \+ Maintenance \+ Productivity \+ Profitability**

The position will have authority, within the company's approved policies and delegation matrix, to allocate manpower, prioritize jobs, control overtime, recommend outsourcing, make Make\-or\-Buy recommendations, coordinate machine maintenance/AMC activities and initiate improvement actions.

**Overall Objective**

**To establish and operate a high\-productivity, cost\-effective and profitable Tool Room capable of delivering high\-quality new press tools on time while ensuring reliable maintenance and maximum availability of production tools.**

**About Company:** 

Sidhakala Group of Industries, established in 1997, is a leading manufacturer of press components, press tooling and welded assemblies. The group operates through two manufacturing units:

* **Sidhakala Engineers – Bhosari Plant**
* **Sidhakala Industries – Chakan Plant**

Major customers include Force Motors, Piaggio, Kinetic Engineering, Minda and Jai Hind Industries. The company has an in\-house tool room for manufacturing and maintenance of press tools.

title: Human Resources Assistant Intern
description:
**Location** 
 : Noida (On\-site)
 



**Company** 
 : Zynence Labs Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Duration** 
 : 2–6 months (flexible, based on your academic commitments)
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Internship
 



  





**About Zynence** 




 Zynence is building an AI\-native, full\-lifecycle hardware engineering platform. A connected workspace that takes a hardware product from requirements and system architecture through BOM/cost, firmware, schematic/PCB, simulation, validation, and manufacturing. We're a small, early\-stage team growing quickly, which means the person in this role won't be handling a narrow slice of HR, you'll help build the HR function itself, alongside the founders.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for an HR Intern to plan and execute recruitment, onboarding, and day\-to\-day HR coordination as we grow the team. You'll own real parts of the hiring pipeline, not just admin support for someone else's process, from sourcing and screening candidates through to getting new hires set up and settled in. This is a hands\-on role at a startup where things are still being figured out: you'll help build the processes as much as run them.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 


* Draft and post job openings across LinkedIn, Naukri, and other relevant platforms.
* Source and screen candidates for open roles, using both inbound applications and proactive outreach.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and the hiring team.
* Maintain a candidate pipeline tracker and keep applicants informed at each stage of the process.
* Support salary/offer discussions and documentation in coordination with the founders.



 Onboarding \& Employee Lifecycle
 


* Plan and run onboarding for new hires — documentation, systems access, introductions, and first\-week schedules.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation (offer letters, contracts, ID/verification paperwork).
* Act as a point of contact for new joiners during their first few weeks.
* Support offboarding processes when needed, ensuring a clean handover and exit documentation.



 HR Coordination \& Operations
 


* Maintain HR trackers — headcount, open positions, interview pipelines, onboarding status.
* Help coordinate internal communication, team announcements, and basic HR policies.
* Support attendance, leave tracking, and other day\-to\-day HR administration.
* Assist with organizing team events, check\-ins, or culture\-building activities as the team grows.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Required
 


* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills \- you'll be the first point of contact for many candidates and new hires.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets/Excel) for tracking pipelines, records, and schedules.
* Organized and detail\-oriented \- able to juggle multiple candidates, timelines, and documents without letting things slip.
* Trustworthy with confidential information \- HR work involves sensitive personal and compensation data.



 Preferred
 


* Prior internship or hands\-on experience in HR, recruitment, or people operations.
* Familiarity with recruitment platforms (LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Instahyre, or similar) and applicant tracking approaches.
* Comfort using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to speed up screening, scheduling, and documentation work \- we use AI heavily across the company and like people who do too.
* Genuine interest in startup environments and building processes from scratch rather than following an existing playbook.



  





**What We Look For** 



* Ownership \- you follow a candidate or a new hire through to the end, not just to the next step in your task list.
* Judgment and discretion \- you handle sensitive information (compensation, personal details, performance conversations) with care.
* People\-oriented \- you enjoy talking to candidates and helping new hires feel welcome, not just processing paperwork.
* Comfort with ambiguity \- this is an early\-stage company; processes will be incomplete and priorities will shift.
* Clear communication \- with candidates, new hires, and founders alike.



  





**Duration \& Logistics** 




 This is a 2–6 month internship; the exact duration is flexible and can be structured around your academic schedule (semester breaks, part\-time alongside coursework, or a dedicated full\-time block). On\-site at our Noida office.
 



  





**Why Join Zynence?** 



* Build the HR function at an early\-stage company from the ground up — your work will shape how we hire and onboard people, not just execute someone else's process.
* Direct exposure to founders and hiring decisions, not a narrow HR\-admin role buried in a large company.
* Real ownership over recruitment and onboarding for a live, growing team — not a shadow/observation internship.
* Broad exposure to how an early\-stage tech startup actually operates, beyond HR alone.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume to sushil@zynence.com
 



 Subject: Application for HR Intern – Zynence
 



 Please mention your availability (start date, and how many months you can commit to) in your application.

description:
**Job Title**

**Talent Acquisition Executive / Senior Talent Acquisition Executive**

**Company**

**House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP)**

**Location**

Baner, Pune, Work from Office

**Employment Type**

Full\-time

**Experience**

1–2 years in Talent Acquisition or a similar role

**Compensation**

₹1\.80–3\.60 LPA (Based on experience and expertise)

**Education**

Graduate (B.Tech, B.Com, BBA, BA, etc.), MBA preferred

**About House of EdTech**

**House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP)** is a high\-growth, multi\-entity EdTech organization focused on delivering **large\-scale, outcome\-driven professional education** across high\-impact domains including **Artificial Intelligence, Finance, Data, Product Management, and Business Skills**.

Founded by **Aditya Goenka \- Founder @ Be10x \& Office Master \| Enabling People Upskill Themselves \| LinkedIn)** and **Aditya Kachave \- Be10x \| LinkedIn),** **IIT Kharagpur alumni**, the organization has rapidly emerged as one of India’s most dynamic EdTech groups by combining **cutting\-edge curriculum, practitioner\-led training, and performance\-driven execution**. With a strong learner\-first philosophy and deep expertise in digital education delivery, House of EdTech enables working professionals and entrepreneurs to **upskill, increase productivity, and unlock measurable career and income growth**.

Today, the organization:

* **Serves over 5 million learners** across India and global markets
* Operates at an **annual recurring revenue (ARR) exceeding ₹450 crore**
* Employs **2,000\+ professionals** across sales, marketing, tech, product, and operations
* Maintains a **strong on\-ground presence in Pune and Kolkata**, supported by pan\-India digital reach

**Diversified Brand Portfolio**

House of EdTech operates a **strategically diversified portfolio of category\-leading education brands**, each addressing distinct learner needs and professional outcomes:

* **Be10x** ()Focused on practical AI tools and productivity solutions that help professionals work smarter and faster using real\-world AI applications.
* **Office Master** ()Specializes in advanced MS Excel, Power BI, and Office productivity programs designed for business and data professionals.
* **AI for Techies** ()Caters to technical professionals seeking hands\-on AI, Python, and SQL skills for accelerated career growth in tech and analytics roles.
* **Dr. Finance** ()Delivers structured personal finance education, enabling individuals to make informed decisions around saving, investing, and wealth creation.
* **Profit Uni** ()Provides applied stock market and trading education, focusing on practical strategies, risk management, and consistent profitability.
* **Springpad** ()Offers specialized programs in analytics and business intelligence, empowering learners with job\-ready, insight\-driven skills.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic **Talent Acquisition Executive / Senior Talent Acquisition Executive** to join our HR team in Kolkata. In this role, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer management. This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about talent acquisition to work in a high\-growth EdTech environment and contribute to building world\-class teams.

**Key ResponsibilitiesTalent Sourcing \& Strategy**

* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to attract top candidates
* Utilize multiple channels such as job portals, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and professional networks to source candidates
* Identify new and creative ways to reach out to potential candidates
* Research and implement innovative recruiting techniques
* Leverage employer branding to attract quality talent
* Create compelling job postings and recruitment advertisements

**Candidate Screening \& Shortlisting**

* Review resumes and applications to identify the best talent
* Conduct initial screening calls to evaluate candidates' skills, experience, and culture fit
* Assess candidate qualifications against job requirements
* Maintain timely and professional communication with all applicants
* Shortlist candidates efficiently to move them through the hiring funnel
* Evaluate both technical skills and cultural alignment

**Interview Coordination \& Process Management**

* Schedule interviews and coordinate between candidates and hiring managers
* Manage end\-to\-end interview logistics and communications
* Gather and document interview feedback to facilitate smooth decision\-making
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process
* Track candidate progress through recruitment stages
* Follow up with candidates and provide timely updates

**Building \& Maintaining Talent Pipelines**

* Proactively build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for future hiring needs
* Engage with passive candidates and develop long\-term relationships with potential hires
* Create talent pools segmented by role, skills, and experience level
* Keep track of industry hiring trends and market conditions
* Nurture candidate relationships for future opportunities
* Stay updated on salary benchmarks and competitive landscape

**Employer Branding \& Candidate Experience**

* Represent the company in a professional and engaging manner
* Actively contribute to enhancing the employer brand by ensuring a positive candidate experience
* Promote House of EdTech as a great place to work through social media, networking events, and recruitment campaigns
* Showcase company culture and values to attract the right talent
* Gather candidate feedback to improve recruitment experience
* Participate in job fairs, campus placements, and networking events

**Recruitment Analytics \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate recruitment data and generate reports on key hiring metrics
* Use data\-driven insights to optimize recruitment strategies and improve hiring efficiency
* Track metrics such as time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, source effectiveness, and conversion rates
* Provide regular updates to leadership on recruitment status
* Utilize Applicant Tracking System (ATS) effectively
* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

**Required Skills \& QualificationsMust\-Have Skills \& Experience**

* **Experience** – 1–2 years in Talent Acquisition or a similar HR role
* **Recruitment Knowledge** – Strong knowledge of recruitment processes, sourcing strategies, and hiring best practices
* **Communication** – Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* **Multitasking** – Ability to manage multiple job openings and prioritize tasks effectively
* **Technical Proficiency** – Proficiency in using job portals, LinkedIn, and applicant tracking systems (ATS)
* **Interpersonal Skills** – Strong interpersonal skills to engage with candidates and stakeholders effectively

**Core Competencies**

* **Sourcing Excellence** – Creative and effective in finding and attracting talent
* **Candidate Assessment** – Strong interviewing and evaluation skills
* **Relationship Building** – Ability to build rapport with candidates and hiring managers
* **Organization** – Excellent organizational and time management skills
* **Adaptability** – Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* **Attention to Detail** – Meticulous in candidate screening and documentation
* **Proactive Approach** – Self\-starter who takes initiative

**Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have)**

* Experience working in the EdTech industry or fast\-growing startups
* Knowledge of HR software and recruitment tools
* Experience in campus hiring, bulk hiring, or leadership hiring
* Exposure to technical recruitment
* Understanding of compensation benchmarking
* Certification in HR or recruitment (SHRM, HRCI, etc.)
* Experience with employer branding initiatives

**What We OfferCareer Growth \& Development**

* **Career Growth** – We invest in your development through mentorship programs, training sessions, and career advancement opportunities
* **Skill Enhancement** – Learn advanced recruitment techniques and talent strategies
* **Clear Progression** – Path to senior TA roles and HR leadership positions
* **Learning Opportunities** – Exposure to diverse roles and hiring across multiple functions

**Work Culture \& Environment**

* **Work Culture** – A supportive, energetic, and collaborative work environment where your ideas are valued
* **Dynamic Team** – Work with 2,000\+ passionate professionals across the organization
* **Modern Office** – Well\-equipped office in Kolkata with professional amenities
* **Inclusive Environment** – Diverse and inclusive workplace culture

**Brand Exposure \& Impact**

* **Diverse Portfolio** – Work with leading brands such as:
* Springpad
* Be10x
* Profit Uni
* Office Master
* Mad About Sports
* Dr. Finance
* AI for Techies
* **Business Impact** – Play a key role in building teams that serve 5 million\+ learners
* **Mission\-Driven** – Contribute to democratizing education by hiring the best talent

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* **Competitive Compensation \& Benefits** – Attractive salary (₹1\.80–3\.60 LPA), performance incentives, and employee perks
* **Performance Recognition** – Rewards for successful hiring and contributions
* **Growth Potential** – Clear salary progression based on performance

**Additional Benefits**

* Opportunity to shape talent acquisition processes and strategies
* Professional network building in EdTech and HR community
* Exposure to recruitment across sales, tech, content, operations, and more
* Structured onboarding and training program
* Recognition as a key contributor to organizational growth

**Why Join House of EdTech?**

At House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP), we are on a mission to empower learners and professionals through innovative educational solutions. Join our team of dynamic employees and be part of a company that values growth, learning, and innovation.

We're not just hiring recruiters—we're building a talent acquisition function that will support our ambitious growth plans and help us reach millions more learners across India and beyond.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Baner, Pune, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* We must fill this position urgently. Can you start immediately?

title: WANTED GENERAL MANAGER
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONGeneral Manager – HospitalPosition Details

**Designation:** General Manager – Hospital  
**Department:** Hospital Administration / Operations  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / CEO / Hospital Director  
**Location:** Hospital  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

The General Manager will be responsible for the **overall operational, administrative, financial, and service management** of the hospital. The role involves ensuring smooth day\-to\-day functioning of all departments, maintaining high standards of patient care and service quality, managing employees and resources, ensuring regulatory and accreditation compliance, and supporting the hospital's growth and financial performance.

The General Manager will act as a key link between the **Management, Medical Team, Nursing, Administration, Finance, HR, Engineering, Operations, and Support Services**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Hospital Operations

* Oversee the day\-to\-day operations of the hospital and ensure smooth functioning of all departments.
* Ensure efficient utilization of hospital infrastructure, manpower, equipment, and other resources.
* Monitor patient flow, admissions, discharges, OPD, IPD, emergency, diagnostics, pharmacy, and support services.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of essential hospital services.
* Coordinate with department heads to resolve operational issues promptly.
* Develop and implement SOPs, policies, and operational procedures.

2\. Patient Experience \& Service Quality

* Ensure high standards of **patient care, safety, satisfaction, and service quality**.
* Monitor patient complaints, feedback, grievances, and service recovery.
* Establish systems to improve patient experience and reduce waiting times.
* Ensure professional and courteous behavior by all hospital staff.
* Conduct regular rounds and review service standards across departments.

3\. Financial \& Business Management

* Monitor hospital revenue, expenses, profitability, and operating costs.
* Work closely with the Finance Department to prepare and monitor budgets.
* Review department\-wise financial performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Monitor billing, collections, credit management, insurance/TPA processes, and revenue leakage.
* Control unnecessary expenditure while maintaining quality of services.
* Support development of new revenue streams and business opportunities.
* Review monthly MIS and key financial indicators with management.

4\. Human Resources \& Team Management

* Coordinate with HR for recruitment, manpower planning, training, performance management, and employee retention.
* Ensure appropriate staffing levels across departments.
* Monitor employee attendance, discipline, productivity, and performance.
* Develop leadership and accountability among department heads.
* Conduct regular review meetings with HODs and key personnel.
* Promote teamwork, professional conduct, and a positive workplace culture.

5\. Medical \& Clinical Coordination

* Coordinate with the Medical Director, Consultants, Nursing Head, and Clinical HODs for smooth clinical operations.
* Facilitate resolution of operational issues affecting clinical departments.
* Ensure availability of required clinical support services.
* Support implementation of clinical quality and patient\-safety initiatives.
* Ensure proper coordination between clinical and non\-clinical departments.

6\. Quality, Accreditation \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable **healthcare laws, statutory requirements, hospital regulations, and accreditation standards**.
* Coordinate hospital quality and accreditation initiatives such as NABH or other applicable standards.
* Monitor implementation of SOPs, quality indicators, audits, corrective actions, and risk\-management programs.
* Ensure proper documentation and readiness for internal and external inspections.
* Promote a culture of continuous quality improvement and patient safety.

7\. Facility \& Infrastructure Management

* Oversee Engineering, Maintenance, Housekeeping, Security, Laundry, Dietary, Biomedical, Electrical, HVAC, Plumbing, and other support services.
* Ensure proper maintenance of hospital buildings, infrastructure, equipment, and utilities.
* Monitor preventive maintenance schedules and breakdown response.
* Ensure adequate safety, cleanliness, infection\-control support, and environmental standards.
* Coordinate hospital expansion, renovation, and infrastructure projects where required.

8\. Vendor \& Procurement Management

* Oversee procurement and vendor\-management activities in coordination with authorized departments.
* Evaluate vendor performance, quality, pricing, and service levels.
* Ensure timely availability of essential materials, consumables, and services.
* Support negotiation with vendors and service providers.
* Ensure appropriate inventory control and reduction of wastage.

9\. Safety, Risk \& Emergency Management

* Ensure implementation of hospital safety policies and emergency preparedness plans.
* Coordinate disaster management, fire safety, security, and emergency response systems.
* Monitor incident reports and ensure appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Conduct regular safety reviews and mock drills as required.
* Ensure patient, staff, visitor, and hospital property safety.

10\. MIS \& Management Reporting

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Monitor key performance indicators such as:
* OPD \& IPD volumes
* Bed occupancy
* Average length of stay
* Revenue
* Patient satisfaction
* OT utilization
* Diagnostic utilization
* Pharmacy performance
* Collection efficiency
* Employee productivity
* Complaints and grievances
* Present performance reports and improvement plans to senior management.

11\. Business Development

* Support the hospital's business growth and market\-development strategies.
* Develop relationships with corporates, insurance companies, TPAs, doctors, referral networks, and other stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities for new services, specialties, and partnerships.
* Support marketing and community outreach initiatives.
* Monitor competitor activities and local healthcare market trends.

Qualifications

* **MBA / PG Diploma in Hospital Management / Healthcare Management / Hospital Administration** preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline; candidates with **MBBS, BHA, BHM, BBA, or related qualifications** may also be considered based on experience.
* Strong knowledge of hospital operations and healthcare administration.
* Knowledge of NABH/accreditation requirements is preferred.
* Strong understanding of hospital finance, HR, quality, and operational processes.

Experience

**Preferred:** 8–15 years of relevant experience in hospital administration/operations, with significant experience in a managerial or leadership position.

Experience in managing a **multi\-specialty hospital** will be an advantage.
