description:
Sales \& Marketing Executive – IT Services  
**Company:** Rorko India Private Limited  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment:** Full\-time, work from office  
**Experience:** Fresher or up to 1 year  
**Qualification:** MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales preferred  
About the Role  
Rorko India is looking for a confident and organised Sales \& Marketing Executive to support and gradually take ownership of our sales and marketing activities.  
You will interact with prospects and clients, manage outreach campaigns, coordinate meetings, maintain the CRM and ensure every opportunity is followed up properly. You will also support marketing programs designed to generate qualified meetings for Rorko’s technology services.  
This role is suitable for an MBA fresher who understands the fundamentals of sales and marketing, communicates professionally and wants to build a career in B2B technology sales.  
Key Responsibilities

* Learn and clearly communicate Rorko’s technology services and capabilities.
* Research target companies, industries and decision\-makers.
* Build and maintain qualified prospect lists.
* Conduct sales outreach through email, LinkedIn, telephone and other relevant channels.
* Write clear, personalised outreach emails and follow\-up messages.
* Schedule client and prospect meetings, send invitations and manage calendars.
* Prepare meeting agendas and record minutes, requirements and next actions.
* Participate in discovery calls, presentations and client meetings.
* Coordinate internally for proposals, presentations, case studies and follow\-ups.
* Maintain accurate lead, contact, company and opportunity information in the CRM.
* Track every conversation, follow\-up date, task and sales\-pipeline movement.
* Plan and execute marketing campaigns focused on generating qualified meetings.
* Support webinars, email campaigns, LinkedIn activities, partnerships and other lead\-generation programs.
* Coordinate the preparation of sales collateral and marketing content.
* Follow up consistently with prospects without becoming repetitive or spam\-oriented.
* Support existing client communication and coordination when required.
* Prepare weekly reports covering outreach, responses, meetings, opportunities and pending actions.
* Ensure that no active lead or client requirement is missed.

What We Are Looking For

* MBA or PGDM in Marketing, Sales or a related specialisation is preferred.
* Fresh graduates with relevant internships or practical project experience are encouraged to apply.
* Good understanding of marketing, sales funnels and customer journeys.
* Strong spoken and written English.
* Confidence speaking with clients and senior decision\-makers.
* Ability to write professional emails and manage business communication.
* Good working knowledge of email, calendars, online meetings and presentation tools.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms or a strong willingness to learn.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for tracking and reporting.
* Strong follow\-up discipline, attention to detail and organisational ability.
* Ability to understand business requirements and coordinate with internal teams.
* Curiosity about technology, software and digital solutions.
* Ability to work independently after initial training and guidance.

Coding or a technical degree is not required. However, you must be willing to learn how websites, mobile applications, custom software, cloud and AI solutions create business value.  
This Role Is Not Suitable If

* You are uncomfortable initiating conversations with new prospects.
* You avoid calls, meetings or follow\-ups.
* You are interested only in social media or creative marketing.
* You need repeated reminders to update tasks and CRM records.
* You send generic bulk messages without researching the prospect.
* You are unwilling to learn about technology services and consultative selling.

How Success Will Be Measured

* Number and quality of qualified meetings generated.
* Consistency and quality of sales outreach.
* Timeliness of follow\-ups and next actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of CRM records.
* Movement of leads through the sales pipeline.
* Quality of client communication and meeting coordination.

description:
**Center Manager Job Description**

Roles \& Responsibilities

**KEY TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

**\- Must be from WELLNESS Background**

\- You will be the one point of contact for the center and you will be accountable for overall operations of the clinic and to achieve the sales objectives of the team members

\- You will supervise the flow of clients through the business and ensure that all reception responsibilities are completed accurately and delivered with high quality and in a timely manner to improve customer satisfaction.

\- Responsible for generating sales and making the center profitable.

\- Responsible for monitoring the administrative, operational and technical aspect for smooth functioning of the center.

\- To follow client retention policies and measures to retain the client.

\- Ensuring customer satisfaction by maintaining the quality of services through SOPs adherence and training \& development of the team.

\- Doing in\-house and outhouse events for generating revenue and brand awareness.

\- Driving the CRM initiatives for the center.

\-Planning and execute different offers and schemes at a center level

· **Documentation**: Regular checking and corrective measures for filling of the Client Records and other requisite documents \& informing the Corporate Office. Ensure correct and timely software entries, checking them for necessary corrections.

· **Monitoring Client Progress**: Regular monitoring of progress of all clients. Organize periodic meetings with respective departments to resolve general and specific concerns. To interact with all clients (especially those losing slowly/not getting expected results) personally and coordinate with R \& D for further technical inputs, as and when required.

· **Zero Sessions**: Stringent Monitoring to ensure zero sessions are conducted as per SOP and within the stipulated timelines.

· **Maintain liaison** between the Centre and the Corporate Office.

· Knowledge transfer and technical inputs from R\&D or Corporate Office to the respective Centre staff.

· To regularly update oneself on all Obesity / Beauty related research in ones region and share the relevant information pertaining to the same with R \& D Dept.

· Communication, implementation and compliance of all corporate policies in the Centre.

· Coordinate with Zonal head and Corporate Office in case of delays in the availability of stock \- linen, documents, appliances and their accessories, and to ensure all equipment is in working condition at all times.

· To take Corporate guidance for booking of complicated Medical Cases.

· To take corrective measures, with advice from Corporate Office if required, in case of wrong bookings and medical contraindications.

· **Executions \& Compliance to SOP:** To ensure that Centers achieve qualitative and quantitative executions as specified by the Corporate \& according to the service delivery parameters given by R\&D. To co\-ordinate with R\&D for any guidance regarding the same. Periodic technical audits and technical reviews of staff to check for compliance with SOP. Take corrective actions at Centre level and inform Corporate Office in case of deviations and refresher training required by the staff.

· **Trainings :** To identify the Training needs of the staff and inform the R \& D of the following :

\- Training Needs \-Fresher / Refresher / Advanced / Skill Gap Analysis / Other parameters requiring improvement on individual basis

\- To ensure stringent compliance of the Training Nomination SOP w.r.t Training Nomination

Letter / Mandatory signing of Training Agreements by complete staff / Action on Non compliance

\- To ensure that the post Training Implementation feedback form is filled up for respective profiles as and when required and sent back to R \& D

\- To ensure that the identified Centre staff ( Profile wise ) takes keen interest in the improvement of average

performers and feedback of the same sent to the R \& D

· **Review the appointment planner:** For optimum utilization of infrastructure, staff and appliances.

\- To review and ensure that the Daily Monitoring Format is correctly and completely filled up and sent to the Corporate within the stipulated time line.

· **Follow**\-**up of irregular clients**: Regular monitoring of client follow\-up data wherever required and self follow\-up for special clients including VIPs and Doctors.

· **Unsuccessful but regular clients**: Implementation of the specific technical inputs, including counseling of such clients and co\-ordinate with Corporate Office for further technical inputs as and when required. To try and keep the percentage of USR clients within the minimum limit as specified by the Corporate.

· **Validity Expiry**: Monitoring of validities for calculations and informing the Corporate Office for any deviation and personal counseling of those clients who were regular but still could not complete the package. To try and expedite that the programme of maximum clients are completed within validity.

· **Transfer/Conversion of Clients Progamme**: Ensure that transfers/ conversions of the clients programme, if any, happen with the consent \& coordination of client and the respective CH/AH. In case of inter centre transfers, to ensure transfer of client papers and credit note is done within 48 hours / before client approaches the concerned centre.

· **Client complaints**: Resolve escalated client issues and proactively initiate and reduce possible causes of complaints by customers. To ensure any client complaints is resolved within the next 7 days in case corporate intervention is required, else to resolve within the next 48 hours at the centre level itself. To ensure complete and fair compliance of the Customer Complaint SOP

· **Staff**:

· **Recruitment and Induction:** To ensure that the recruitments are done as per the specified SOP and to conduct the Induction of the new recruits as per designation wise Induction Schedules and to conduct induction sessions as specified for different profiles (Dietician / Slimming Head / Physiotherapist / Doctor / Beauty Head / Beauty Incharge / Hair Stylist / Pedicurist / Dermatologist)

· **Induction**: To assist in the recruitment of new Centre staff , conduct preliminary technical interviews of candidates in case of vacancy and forward for approval to Corporate Office.

· **Orientation of Staff**: To impart on\-the\-job training at Centre level, to new staff and send their periodic assessment to Corporate Office as specified in the SOP.

· **Vacancies / TNA** : Update the Corporate Office/Zonal Head periodically on the status for vacancies and training needs of the staff.

**Sales**: Work with Sales team members \& Slimming / Beauty In\-charges to ensure meeting of in\-house sales targets that may be set from time to time. To give realistic sales targets to individual staff members and monitor the same on a daily basis aiming towards the achievement of centers sales target.

· **Events**: To coordinate with the Corporate in giving technical support to the Centre for organizing the Events and sending feedback of the same to the Corporate. Two main events to be planned out and conducted every quarter, in co\-ordination with the Corporate.

· **Software entries:** To ensure timely entries of data in the software and monitor the same. To send required data to IT department within the time line specified by the Corporate. On the basis of feedback given by the Corporate, actions to be immediately implemented and revertal on same given to the Corporate.

· **Staff Attrition:** To ensure that the staff attrition does not overshoot a maximum limit as specified by the Corporate. To ensure that all relevant contracts are in place for all staff members.

· To ensure optimum staff strength at the Centre at all times keeping in mind the influx and lean hours

**KEY ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES**

· **Sops:** To ensure adherence \& compliance to standard operating procedures at all times and to also ensure that standards are

driven by the Center Manager(s) while providing ownership value.

· To oversee achievement of budgeted sales target every month \& offer timely advice to team to review strategies to close sales \& generate bookings more effectively and scientifically.

· **Events**: To review in consultation with Zonal head \& Corporate approval events / promotions planned, local ads to be released and unique packages formulated to match variety of budgets, in order to create \& drive awareness about Pachouli as a slimming, beauty \& fitness ( Wellness ) brand.

· To ensure that the data on Centre level Marketing initiative / feedback is collated and analyzed and the same sent to the Head Marketing, Corporate and Regional VP Operations

· To promote D2D, family card or any other promotional programs / schemes that the corporate might launch from time to time**.**

· To monitor SMS data / Call Centre escalated queries / Alive Chat mails or any other marketing activities promoted by the marketing department at the corporate.

· To oversee monthly budget of the centre \& team operations to bring down non\-essential overhead costs without impacting quality of service.

· To monitor the effectiveness of yield/capacities in the centers and systems to ensure revenues are maximized and provide feedback to senior management

· To oversee duty roster \& identify staff capable of multitasking and sending them for respective trainings for up gradation.

· **Monthly/Daily staff meetings**: To help settle personnel grievances through a rational \& open meeting or use personal discretion to intervene directly. To ensure that they are held on a monthly basis and to send the reports to the Corporate within the defined time line.

· To provide ongoing information and status reports to Regional Operations Head / Senior management team in the corporate on monthly basis on financial and operational performance of center(s).

· To oversee management \& maintenance of all client records, attendance record, MIS reports, security arrangements, inventory control, compliance to all statutory obligations such as PF, ESIC, Bonus etc..

· **Checklists**: To inspect the center by taking rounds and ensure that the upkeep is as per standard norms and the hygiene and sanitation conditions are par excellence. In addition ensure that machines are in working order. To fill the checklists on a monthly basis and forward the same to the Corporate within the stipulated time line.

· To explain the details of incentive plan / salary break up and regularly coordinate with HR on timely distribution of salaries and incentives to the center staff.

· To put forth recommendations to corporate office for centre renovation, relocation/ termination of manpower, and closure of certain sections of centre \& discontinuing use of certain machines

· To conduct regular checks at the center to ensure consumption of products as per SOP and services executed at the centers and FIFO policy is being adhered to for product consumption / retail chain.

· To constantly upgrade oneself so as to achieve the progression level as per the multitasking / up gradation planner

**Additional Responsibilities:**

1\. To offer assistance in pre opening activities of new centers by finalization of floor maps, appliances, consumables, gadgets etc for centers (new and renovations) with approval from corporate office.

2\. To train and groom the next identified successor as Centre Head ( staff identified from within the Centre team )

3\. In addition to the above mentioned duties and job functions, to carry out any other assignment given occasionally by the Regional Operations Head.

**While the above encapsulates all their responsibilities, the following needs a special mention and should be done on priority basis** **.**

· **To ensure cleanliness, hygiene and maintenance of the center.**

· **Regular reports on problems observed, actions to be taken and deadlines for the same.**

· **Special focus on service delivery, customer care, satisfaction, delight and feedback.**

· **Cash checking To ensure systematic cash handling and maintenance of cash register . Physical cash and entries in the cash register should match. Report to be sent on any variation to all concerned.**

* Amritsar, Punjab: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

title: CloudOps Engineer (L3)
description:
**Job Purpose** 




 Frontline Infrastructure Support Engineer (L3\) serves as the Senior technical support for enterprise infrastructure, providing expert\-level administration, troubleshooting, architecture guidance, and technical leadership across complex IT environments. The role is responsible for resolving critical infrastructure issues, driving automation, implementing infrastructure improvements, supporting strategic initiatives, and ensuring the reliability, scalability, security, and performance of enterprise platforms.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




**Infrastructure Architecture \& Engineering** 



* Design, implement, administer, and optimize enterprise infrastructure across Windows, Linux, virtualization, Kubernetes, storage, backup, cloud, and GPU platforms.
* Define technical standards, best practices, and operational procedures to improve infrastructure reliability and scalability.



**Advanced Incident \& Problem Management** 



* Lead the resolution of complex and business\-critical infrastructure incidents.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA), incident chronology and implement permanent corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide technical leadership during Major Incident Management and disaster recovery scenarios.
* Act as the highest escalation point for L1 and L2 support teams.



**Windows \& Active Directory Engineering** 



* Design and administer enterprise Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Certificate Services, Federation Services, and Windows Server environments.
* Lead server lifecycle management, security hardening, patch strategy, and performance optimization.



**Linux Platform Engineering** 



* Administer enterprise Linux platforms, including kernel tuning, automation, clustering, security hardening, high availability, and performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot complex OS, application, and platform\-related issues.



**Virtualization \& Container Platform Engineering** 



* Design, administer, and optimize VMware, Hyper\-V, and Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.
* Manage cluster architecture, capacity planning, workload optimization, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.



**Storage, Backup \& Disaster Recovery** 



* Design and administer enterprise storage and backup solutions.
* Lead disaster recovery planning, backup architecture, replication, capacity planning, and business continuity initiatives.



**Cloud Infrastructure** 



* Support Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud infrastructure, hybrid networking, and cloud platform administration.



**GPU \& AI Infrastructure** 



* Design, administer, and optimize GPU infrastructure supporting AI, Machine Learning, and High\-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads.
* Manage GPU resource allocation, driver lifecycle, firmware updates, monitoring, and performance optimization.



**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code** 



* Develop infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Drive Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), configuration management, and operational automation initiatives.



**Change, Release \& Capacity Management** 



* Review and implement complex infrastructure changes.
* Lead infrastructure upgrades, migrations, platform refresh, and technology transformation projects.
* Perform capacity planning and infrastructure performance optimization.



**Technical Leadership** 



* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.
* Develop technical standards, runbooks, SOPs, and operational documentation.
* Collaborate with architects, engineering teams, OEMs, and vendors on strategic initiatives.



  





**Experience \& Educational Requirement** 




 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication
 



  





**RELEVANT EXPERIENCE** 



* 6 to 10\+ years in Enterprise Infrastructure Engineering, Managed Services, Data Center Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, or Platform Engineering.
* Proven experience supporting business\-critical production environments with 24×7 operations.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise monitoring tools (SolarWinds, SCOM, Zabbix, Nagios, PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana) and ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, ManageEngine, BMC Remedy, or Jira Service Management. Expertise in virtualization (VMware, Hyper\-V, Kubernetes, OpenShift), enterprise storage, backup solutions, and hybrid cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP). Strong exposure to GPU infrastructure for AI/ML and HPC workloads, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Ansible), container platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise security technologies.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an
 **AI Engineer** 
 to work on an enterprise AI platform that is transforming how public\-sector organizations evaluate tenders and procurement documents.
 



  





 Our platform uses
 **Generative AI, Agentic AI, document intelligence and open\-source foundation models** 
 to automate complex document\-heavy workflows involved in tender evaluation. The product is already deployed in large
 **Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)** 
 and runs on
 **NVIDIA GPU infrastructure** 
 using open\-source AI models.
 



  





 This role sits at the intersection of
 **AI research and production engineering** 
 . You will experiment with new models and techniques, but the goal is not research for its own sake — it is to
 **improve accuracy, reduce latency and cost, and make the product increasingly autonomous.** 




**What You Will Work On** 



* Experiment with and evaluate the latest
 **open\-source LLMs and VLMs** 
 for document understanding, extraction, reasoning and classification.
* Benchmark models for
 **accuracy, latency, throughput and GPU utilization** 
 and make recommendations for production adoption.
* Optimize AI inference pipelines to improve
 **response time, throughput and infrastructure efficiency** 
 .
* Develop and deploy
 **Agentic AI workflows** 
 that can autonomously execute multi\-step document processing and tender evaluation tasks.
* Design agents capable of planning, reasoning, tool use, information retrieval and validation across complex procurement workflows.
* Build production\-grade pipelines for processing
 **large, complex and highly unstructured documents** 
 .
* Work on techniques such as
 **RAG, structured extraction, reranking, model routing, prompt engineering and evaluation** 
 .
* Fine\-tune or adapt models where appropriate to improve performance on domain\-specific procurement tasks.
* Work closely with product and domain teams to translate business requirements into AI capabilities.
* Profile and optimize GPU workloads across
 **NVIDIA GPU infrastructure** 
 .
* Develop robust evaluation frameworks to continuously measure
 **LLM accuracy, hallucination, latency and reliability** 
 .
* Stay current with developments in open\-source models, inference frameworks and agentic AI, and rapidly prototype promising approaches.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




**Must Have** 



* **3–5 years of hands\-on experience** 
 building and deploying AI/ML systems.
* Strong
 **Python programming** 
 and software engineering fundamentals.
* Strong understanding of
 **Generative AI / LLMs** 
 and modern AI application architectures.
* Hands\-on experience deploying models in production environments.
* Experience with
 **open\-source LLMs** 
 such as Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek or similar models.
* Experience with
 **GPU\-based inference and optimization** 
 .
* Strong understanding of model performance metrics including
 **latency, throughput, concurrency and GPU utilization** 
 .
* Experience with
 **Docker and Linux** 
 ; Kubernetes is a strong plus.
* Ability to read research papers, understand new techniques and turn them into working production systems.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset and willingness to experiment rapidly.



**Good to Have** 



* Experience with
 **NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, vLLM or NVIDIA NIM** 
 .
* Experience with
 **Agentic AI / AI agents** 
 , tool calling, orchestration and multi\-agent workflows.
* Experience with
 **RAG, vector databases, embeddings and reranking** 
 .
* Experience with
 **LLM/VLM evaluation and benchmarking** 
 .
* Experience with document AI, OCR, document understanding or multimodal models.
* Experience with
 **PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers and PEFT/LoRA** 
 .
* Familiarity with cloud or on\-prem GPU deployments.
* Experience working with large\-scale enterprise AI deployments.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In this role, you will be expected to move beyond simply integrating LLM APIs. You will help us answer questions such as:
 


* **Can we make the model 20% more accurate?**
* **Can we reduce inference latency by 30%?**
* **Can we run the workload on fewer GPUs?**
* **Can an AI agent autonomously complete a document evaluation workflow that currently requires human intervention?**
* **Can we reliably deploy a new open\-source model into production without compromising quality?**



 You will have significant ownership in taking these ideas from
 **experiment → benchmark → engineering → production** 
 .
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 You will work on an AI product that is already solving
 **real enterprise problems in production** 
 , rather than building prototypes that never leave the lab.
 



 The role offers an opportunity to work across:
 



**Open\-source AI models → AI research → GPU optimization → Agentic AI → Production engineering → Enterprise deployment** 




 If you enjoy going deep into models, experimenting with new AI techniques, writing production\-grade code and seeing your work directly improve a live AI product, this role is for you.

 For all positions: we’re looking for people who learn quickly, adapt to new and emerging technologies, and want to help build the future of advertising technology. This is an office\-based role in South Delhi — we value genuine enthusiasm for working from office, tinkering with LLMs, AI, programmatic, ad insertion, and even gaming, inside a startup\-style, operationally flexible environment. Hard work and a real focus on building a long\-term career in ad\-tech software development matter more to us than a polished résumé.
   

  

*Disclaimer: due to the large volume of applications received, we are only able to respond to successful candidates.*
 On the Early\-Career Program
   

  

 Programmatic ad\-tech is an exceptionally niche industry, and very few schools or workplaces truly expose people to its technical, operational, or business realities — especially combined with emerging interactive and immersive advertising experiences. Because of this, we understand that strong candidates may come from lateral career shifts or seemingly unrelated backgrounds. While we review every application for relevant experience and education, résumés alone rarely reveal curiosity, systems thinking, adaptability, or genuine interest in the industry.
   

  

 Established players in this space rarely let experienced talent circulate freely, and we recognize the challenge of building in such a rare ecosystem while bootstrapping. We encourage applicants to research the industry before applying, avoid applying blindly, and tell us why this space excites you — especially if you’re willing to pursue an early\-career journey of learning, exploration, and growth while transitioning from another field.
   

  

 Application Requirements
   

  

* A completed application form, including your resume.
* Essay 1 — Statement of Purpose: why Blowtrumpet is for you, why you want to be part of ad\-tech, and how ad\-tech differs from other industries (e.g. ed\-tech) in ways that interest you.
* Essay 2 — Your Workflow in the Emerging Technologies Age: your view on AI and where it’s heading, how you’re incorporating AI into your workflow today, and real examples of difficulties you’ve faced and how you resolved them.
* Essay 3 — Gamification: what gamification means to you, a real\-life example, what the gamification loop looks like, and how you’d apply it to create an engaging experience for friends, family, or coworkers.


 You may use AI tools to help write these essays.
 **If you do, disclose which tools you used, your prompts and guidance, and confirm your agreement with the output. If you choose not to use AI, tell us that too.**
 Optional Guiding Questions
   

  

 You’re welcome to draw on any of the following while writing your three essays — they’re prompts, not a separate form to fill out line by line.
   

  

* 1\. Provide us with your present PIN Code. We won’t be processing applications without a valid PIN Code and address location. You’re encouraged to join our Discord server, “Hire For Work” (linked in the website footer) — introduce yourself and interact there; it goes a long way for our assessment and lets us connect with you in real time. Also define, in your own words, the difference between ed\-tech and ad\-tech.
* 2\. Name 5 ed\-tech platforms you find useful. What did you like about them, who is their target audience, and how do they help you? What skills have you developed through ed\-tech?
* 3\. Name 5 ad\-tech platforms you find useful. What did you like about them, who is their target audience, and how do they help you?
* 4\. Why is ad\-tech for you?
* 5\. Why do you want to work with a startup? Talk about one area of expertise you feel will add value to our products, and the clients or industry it serves.
* 6\. We also hire for our legacy services business. Would you like your application considered for a client\-facing, incentive/ROI\-driven role in advertising services? How would you add value to that practice, which role would you prefer for your career progression, and for which clients or sector?
* 7\. Why do you use AI? How do you envision AI being used in the years to come? Talk about a recent development in AI — is it close to the ad\-tech or fin\-tech industries?
* 8\. Do you feel knowledge of fin\-tech systems is useful for product development in ad\-tech? What are the advantages of AI in building or managing a fin\-tech environment?
* 9\. How do you keep up with the latest innovations? Name 5 websites you consult for staying updated, learning new skills, or troubleshooting.

* 14\. Share a real\-world example of gamification you’ve practiced with friends, family, or coworkers.
* 15\. Write a clear statement of purpose to complete your application. How does Blowtrumpet fit with your aspirations, and what would you like to achieve? Discuss your plans for the next 3–5 years.


 Status \& Contact
   

  

 We make a sincere effort to respond early to fully completed applications. Because of application volume, we’re sometimes only able to respond to shortlisted candidates. You can check on your application status by writing to hr@blowtrumpet.com.

title: Junior Instructional Designer
description:
Hexr Factory is a next\-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner, creating real\-time 3D, interactive, visualisation and digital\-learning experiences for global clients.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for two Junior Instructional Designers to convert client\-supplied scripts, lesson briefs and storyboards into clear, structured production plans for 3D animation and video content. This role sits at the intersection of learning design and creative production. You will help make sure that a concept is instructionally sound, visually expressible and ready for storyboard, asset, animation, voice\-over, edit and final\-video teams.
   

  

 This is not a conventional content\-QA role. Quality review is part of the work, but the primary responsibility is to interpret, develop and structure source material before and during production.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Study client scripts, storyboards, learning objectives and content briefs to understand the intended concept, audience and learning outcome.
* Break content into a practical lesson, segment, scene and shot structure for 3D animation and video production.
* Convert abstract concepts into visual actions, demonstrations, character behaviour, backgrounds, props, on\-screen text, transitions and camera requirements.
* Develop and maintain script\-to\-storyboard mappings, scene breakdowns, shot lists, asset lists, VO cues, subtitle cues and production notes.
* Restructure content when the sequence is unclear, too dense, repetitive or difficult to represent visually, while preserving the client’s intent and documenting open decisions.

You will work with the Creative Director, 3D/Asset leads, Unreal artists and technical artists to translate concepts, references and project briefs into accurate models, UVs, materials and textures.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
We’re looking for builders who’d rather architect a solution than wait to be handed a spec — freshers and experienced developers who treat a startup environment as a feature, not a risk.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Build across the full stack — from database and API design to polished, production front\-ends.
* Work fluently across modern JavaScript/TypeScript tooling: the MERN stack, Node, Bun, Deno, React, Next.js, NestJS.
* Take ambiguous problems, think like an architect, and ship independently rather than waiting for a perfect spec.
* Move between roles as needed — this is a startup, and “not my job” isn’t in the vocabulary.


 What You Bring
   

  

* Strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern full\-stack framework combination.
* A genuine tinkering instinct — you build things for fun, not just for a paycheck.
* Comfort with ambiguity and the flexibility to wear multiple hats across a small, fast\-moving team.
* For tier\-1 engineering graduates especially: the depth to go beyond tutorials and actually reason about systems.


**Bonus Points:** 
*Exposure to advertising, gaming, or real\-time systems; open\-source contributions or personal projects worth showing off.*
 For all positions: we’re looking for people who learn quickly, adapt to new and emerging technologies, and want to help build the future of advertising technology. This is an office\-based role in South Delhi — we value genuine enthusiasm for working from office, tinkering with LLMs, AI, programmatic, ad insertion, and even gaming, inside a startup\-style, operationally flexible environment. Hard work and a real focus on building a long\-term career in ad\-tech software development matter more to us than a polished résumé.
   

  

*Disclaimer: due to the large volume of applications received, we are only able to respond to successful candidates.*
 On the Early\-Career Program
   

  

 Programmatic ad\-tech is an exceptionally niche industry, and very few schools or workplaces truly expose people to its technical, operational, or business realities — especially combined with emerging interactive and immersive advertising experiences. Because of this, we understand that strong candidates may come from lateral career shifts or seemingly unrelated backgrounds. While we review every application for relevant experience and education, résumés alone rarely reveal curiosity, systems thinking, adaptability, or genuine interest in the industry.
   

  

 Established players in this space rarely let experienced talent circulate freely, and we recognize the challenge of building in such a rare ecosystem while bootstrapping. We encourage applicants to research the industry before applying, avoid applying blindly, and tell us why this space excites you — especially if you’re willing to pursue an early\-career journey of learning, exploration, and growth while transitioning from another field.
   

  

 Application Requirements
   

  

* A completed application form, including your resume.
* Essay 1 — Statement of Purpose: why Blowtrumpet is for you, why you want to be part of ad\-tech, and how ad\-tech differs from other industries (e.g. ed\-tech) in ways that interest you.
* Essay 2 — Your Workflow in the Emerging Technologies Age: your view on AI and where it’s heading, how you’re incorporating AI into your workflow today, and real examples of difficulties you’ve faced and how you resolved them.
* Essay 3 — Gamification: what gamification means to you, a real\-life example, what the gamification loop looks like, and how you’d apply it to create an engaging experience for friends, family, or coworkers.


 You may use AI tools to help write these essays.
 **If you do, disclose which tools you used, your prompts and guidance, and confirm your agreement with the output. If you choose not to use AI, tell us that too.**
 Optional Guiding Questions
   

  

 You’re welcome to draw on any of the following while writing your three essays — they’re prompts, not a separate form to fill out line by line.
   

  

* 1\. Provide us with your present PIN Code. We won’t be processing applications without a valid PIN Code and address location. You’re encouraged to join our Discord server, “Hire For Work” (linked in the website footer) — introduce yourself and interact there; it goes a long way for our assessment and lets us connect with you in real time. Also define, in your own words, the difference between ed\-tech and ad\-tech.
* 2\. Name 5 ed\-tech platforms you find useful. What did you like about them, who is their target audience, and how do they help you? What skills have you developed through ed\-tech?
* 3\. Name 5 ad\-tech platforms you find useful. What did you like about them, who is their target audience, and how do they help you?
* 4\. Why is ad\-tech for you?
* 5\. Why do you want to work with a startup? Talk about one area of expertise you feel will add value to our products, and the clients or industry it serves.
* 6\. We also hire for our legacy services business. Would you like your application considered for a client\-facing, incentive/ROI\-driven role in advertising services? How would you add value to that practice, which role would you prefer for your career progression, and for which clients or sector?
* 7\. Why do you use AI? How do you envision AI being used in the years to come? Talk about a recent development in AI — is it close to the ad\-tech or fin\-tech industries?
* 8\. Do you feel knowledge of fin\-tech systems is useful for product development in ad\-tech? What are the advantages of AI in building or managing a fin\-tech environment?
* 9\. How do you keep up with the latest innovations? Name 5 websites you consult for staying updated, learning new skills, or troubleshooting.
* 10\. Describe your troubleshooting workflow.
* 11\. Are you a gamer? Which games have you played? How often, when, and with what objective?
* 12\. Are you a streamer / content creator? What software and platforms do you use? Share your channel details and your content development/management workflow.
* 13\. What do you understand by gamification? Create a sample gamification loop for an ad\-tech environment that you feel would be useful for the industry — mention the checkpoints, endpoints, rewards, and your approach to quantifying them.
* 14\. Share a real\-world example of gamification you’ve practiced with friends, family, or coworkers.
* 15\. Write a clear statement of purpose to complete your application. How does Blowtrumpet fit with your aspirations, and what would you like to achieve? Discuss your plans for the next 3–5 years.


 Status \& Contact
   

  

 We make a sincere effort to respond early to fully completed applications. Because of application volume, we’re sometimes only able to respond to shortlisted candidates. You can check on your application status by writing to hr@blowtrumpet.com.
   

  

*Disclaimer: due to the large volume of applications received, we are only able to respond to successful candidates.*

**Job Description: Business Development Executive – Field Sales**

**Location: Delhi NCR/Gurgaon**

Department: Sales \& Business Development

**Employment Type: Full\-Time**

**Working Days: Monday to Saturday (6 days a week)**

**Own two\-wheeler/bike.**

**Travelling Allowance will be provided**

Experience: 1–3 years

**About Lokaci**

Lokaci Innovations and Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a technology company focused on the Beauty \& Wellness industry. We provide CRM software solutions that help salons and beauty \& wellness businesses manage and grow their operations more effectively.

We are looking for an energetic and target\-oriented Business Development Executive – Field Sales to join our Bangalore team.

**Job Role**

The candidate will be responsible for visiting salons across Delhi NCR/Gurgaon, meeting salon owners/managers face\-to\-face, demonstrating our CRM software, and converting prospects into customers.

This is a field\-oriented sales role, requiring extensive local travel and direct interaction with salon and beauty \& wellness business owners.

**Key Responsibilities**

Visit salons, beauty parlours, and other businesses in the beauty \& wellness industry across Bangalore.

Identify potential customers and generate new leads through direct field visits.

Meet salon owners, managers, and decision\-makers face\-to\-face.

Understand the customer's business requirements and explain how Lokaci's CRM software can help.

Conduct product demonstrations and explain key features, benefits, and pricing.

Follow up with prospects through phone calls, WhatsApp, and additional meetings.

Convert qualified leads into paying customers and achieve monthly sales targets.

Build and maintain strong relationships with salon owners and business clients.

Maintain daily records of field visits, leads, meetings, demonstrations, and conversions.

Share regular sales reports with the reporting manager.

**Candidate Requirements**

1–3 years of experience in field sales, business development, B2B sales, SaaS sales, or direct sales preferred.

Freshers with excellent communication and sales aptitude may also be considered.

Confident in meeting and speaking with business owners face\-to\-face.

Comfortable with daily field visits and extensive travel within Bangalore.

Strong persuasion, negotiation, follow\-up, and closing skills.

Target\-oriented and self\-motivated.

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

description:
**About Us:**

Frootle India Private Limited is a house of global electronics brands. Dealing in innovative International Home, Kitchen, Entertainment and Wellness products for the India market. With 300\+ dedicated employees having an average age of 25 years makes us young and passionate to achieve our company goals happily.

Some of the well\-known brands are:

**1\. Ecovacs** \- Robotic Vacuum Cleaner

**2\. Tineco** \- Cordless Floor Cleaner

**3\. Kuvings** \- Cold Press Juicer \| Blender

**4\. Coway** \- Air Purifier

**5\. Instant Brands** \- Electric Pressure Cooker \| Air Fryer

**6\. Nutricook** \- Electric Pressure Cooker \| Air Fryer

**7\. XGIMI** \- Smart Portable \| Cinematic \| Ultra Short Throw Projector

**8\. Cosori** \- Air Fryer

**9\. Levoit** \- Air Purifier

**10\. Laurastar** \- Hygienic Steamer \| Steam Iron \& more

**11\. Hoover** \- Canister Floor \| Carpet Vacuum

**12\. Hizero** \- Cordless Hard Floor Cleaners

**13\. Blendtec** \- Commercial Blenders

**Role Summary:**

We are looking for the Brand Associate \& Customer Success professional who will be responsible for managing customer interactions, understanding customer preferences, supporting sales growth and contributing to brand\-building initiatives.

The role involves working closely with the Brand Manager and internal teams to strengthen brand presence across online and offline channels, improve customer satisfaction, support promotional activities and provide customer insights that contribute to product and brand strategy.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls, understand customer requirements and provide timely and effective support
* Address customer concerns professionally, resolve issues where possible and escalate them to the relevant teams when required
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, preferences and information using Excel, CRM and other reporting tools
* Conduct regular lead follow\-ups through calls, messages and other communication channels to nurture prospects and ensure timely closure
* Understand customer preferences, qualify leads and identify opportunities to convert potential customers into sales
* Drive sales across online and offline platforms by effectively communicating product features, benefits and value propositions
* Develop and implement marketing and brand promotion plans to increase brand awareness and strengthen market presence
* Ensure consistent brand visibility and communication across online and offline platforms
* Support product positioning and pricing strategies in alignment with the brand's long\-term objectives
* Work closely with the Brand Manager to execute brand strategies, campaigns and promotional activities
* Ensure consistency across the product line and overall brand strategy
* Support customer loyalty and retention initiatives to improve long\-term customer relationships

**Essential Qualifications:**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in marketing, advertising, communication, business administration, management, or a similar field
* Fresher to 2\-3 years of experience in related field
* Work experience as a brand associate, marketing associate, or a similar role
* Knowledge about product packaging, positioning and pricing
* Ability to perform market analysis and interpret charts, spreadsheets, etc.
* Good Written and Verbal communication

**What We Offer** 

* Opportunity to work with globally recognized technology brands
* Paid leave benefits as per company policy
* Performance\-based incentives
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities

Pay: ₹420,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – SALESMAN

**Job Title:** Salesman / Sales Executive  
**Department:** Sales  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** ZORO Groom \& Bride – Nadapuram  
**Reports To:** Store Manager / Sales Manager

1\. Job Summary

The Salesman is responsible for assisting customers, understanding their requirements, recommending suitable products, and providing an excellent shopping experience. The role also involves achieving sales targets and supporting the smooth day\-to\-day operation of the store.

2\. Key Responsibilities

* Welcome customers and provide friendly and professional assistance.
* Understand customer needs and recommend suitable products.
* Explain product features, sizes, colours, prices, and available options.
* Assist customers in selecting products according to their requirements.
* Provide proper assistance during product trials and fitting when required.
* Maintain attractive and organized product displays.
* Keep the sales area clean, neat, and presentable.
* Handle customer enquiries, requests, and complaints professionally.
* Support billing and other store activities when required.
* Assist with stock checking, replenishment, and product arrangement.
* Take proper care of company products, equipment, and store property.
* Work towards achieving individual and store sales targets.
* Build good relationships with customers and encourage repeat business.
* Coordinate effectively with the Store Manager and other team members.
* Follow all company policies, procedures, attendance rules, and instructions.
* Perform other sales and store\-related duties assigned by the management.

3\. Required Skills \& Qualities

* **Fluency in Malayalam is required.**
* Good customer\-handling and communication skills.
* Positive, friendly, and professional attitude.
* Good convincing and selling skills.
* Ability to understand customer requirements.
* Energetic, confident, and customer\-focused approach.
* Willingness to learn about clothing, fashion, and company products.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Punctual, responsible, and disciplined.
* Passion for sales and providing good customer service.

4\. Qualification \& Experience

* Minimum qualification: **SSLC / Plus Two or equivalent**.
* Previous experience in retail sales, particularly in the **clothing or fashion industry, is preferred**.
* **Freshers are encouraged to apply** if they have good communication skills, a positive attitude, and a genuine passion for sales and customer service.
* Candidates who are confident, energetic, willing to learn, and interested in building a career in sales are welcome to apply.

5\. Working Hours \& Flexibility

* Working hours will be as per the Company's operational schedule and branch requirements.
* Employees may be required to work during **weekends, festivals, wedding seasons, special occasions, and peak business periods** based on operational requirements.
* During busy or peak periods, employees may be required to **work beyond normal store hours, including late evenings or nights**, subject to applicable labour laws and Company policy.
* Employees are expected to cooperate with the Company during peak business periods.

6\. Salary

**₹10,000 – ₹25,000 per month**

Salary will be determined based on the candidate's **experience, skills, communication ability, suitability for the role, and interview performance**.

7\. Performance Expectations

The employee will be expected to:

* Achieve assigned sales targets.
* Provide excellent customer service.
* Maintain proper product presentation.
* Follow company policies and procedures.
* Maintain punctuality, discipline, and professional behaviour.
* Work cooperatively with the sales team and management.
* Contribute to the overall sales and growth of the store.

8\. Equal Opportunity

ZORO Groom \& Bride welcomes applications from suitable candidates based on their skills, attitude, qualifications, and suitability for the position.

**ZORO GROOM \& BRIDE**  
*Professional Service. Quality. Customer Satisfaction.*

Pay: From ₹10,000\.00 per month

title: Housekeeping Staff
description:
**HOUSEKEEPING STAFF \- i'Deli Cafe**

Keep Our Space Clean, Fresh \& Welcoming

We are opening a new i'Deli Cafe outlet in Kakkanad, Kochi, and are looking for a reliable, hardworking, and detail\-oriented Housekeeping Staff member to maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and presentation throughout the outlet.

Cleaning \& Hygiene

* Maintain cleanliness of the restaurant, dining area, kitchen support areas, washrooms, storage areas, and staff areas.
* Clean floors, tables, chairs, windows, doors, counters, and other surfaces.
* Ensure guest areas remain clean and presentable throughout operating hours.
* Clean and sanitise washrooms regularly.
* Follow proper cleaning and sanitation procedures.

Guest Area Maintenance

* Regularly check dining and common areas for cleanliness.
* Clear and dispose of waste appropriately.
* Ensure tables and surrounding areas are clean and ready for guests.
* Respond quickly to spills, breakages, or other cleaning requirements.
* Maintain a neat and welcoming environment for guests.

Kitchen \& Support Areas

* Assist with maintaining cleanliness of designated kitchen and back\-of\-house areas.
* Clean floors, walls, drains, and other assigned areas.
* Follow hygiene procedures when handling cleaning materials.
* Support kitchen staff with general cleaning duties when required.

Waste Management

* Collect and dispose of waste according to company procedures.
* Maintain cleanliness around waste collection areas.
* Ensure waste bins are cleaned and properly maintained.
* Follow appropriate segregation and disposal practices.

Cleaning Supplies

* Use cleaning chemicals, tools, and equipment safely and correctly.
* Monitor cleaning material requirements and inform the supervisor when supplies are low.
* Store cleaning products safely in designated areas.
* Avoid misuse or unnecessary wastage of cleaning materials.

Hygiene \& Safety

* Follow all company hygiene, sanitation, and workplace safety procedures.
* Use appropriate protective equipment when required.
* Immediately report spills, damaged equipment, pest issues, leaks, or safety hazards.
* Maintain high standards of personal hygiene and grooming.

Opening \& Closing Support

* Assist with pre\-opening cleaning and preparation of the outlet.
* Ensure guest and operational areas are ready before service begins.
* Complete assigned cleaning duties during closing.
* Ensure the outlet is left clean, organised, and ready for the next operating day.

Teamwork \& Support

* Work closely with service, kitchen, and management teams.
* Assist colleagues with cleaning requirements during busy periods.
* Follow instructions from the Housekeeping Supervisor, Floor Supervisor, or Restaurant Manager.
* Maintain a positive and cooperative attitude.

New Outlet Opening

* Support the cleaning and preparation of the new Kakkanad outlet before opening.
* Assist with deep cleaning and final presentation of all areas.
* Help establish daily cleaning routines and hygiene standards from day one.
* Ensure the outlet maintains a clean and welcoming environment from its first day of operation.

**Experience**

* 1–2 years of housekeeping, cleaning, hospitality, restaurant, hotel, or similar experience preferred**.**
* Freshers with the right attitude and willingness to learn may also be considered.

**Education**

* Basic educational qualification preferred.
* Relevant housekeeping or cleaning experience will also be considered.

**Job Type**

Full\-time, Permanent

**Work Location**

Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala

**In person**

Shift Availability

* Day Shift
* Evening Shift
* Night Shift

As we prepare to launch our new i'Deli Cafe outlet in Kakkanad, we would be pleased to meet you and discuss this exciting opportunity to join our team.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided

title: Business Development Associate (BDA)
description:
**Xplore New Technologies Private Limited is a technology development company focused on building innovative digital platforms and technology\-driven products.**

We develop online solutions that connect businesses, property owners, service providers, and customers through technology.

Our flagship product, **SpotLet**, is an online marketplace and digital platform designed to help property owners showcase, promote, and generate income from their properties while making it easier for customers to discover and book unique spaces.

We are currently building our **Business Development team** to promote and expand SpotLet by connecting with property owners and bringing quality properties onto the platform.

**About SpotLet**

**SpotLet is an online marketplace and platform that provides information, discovery, and booking opportunities for properties and unique spaces across multiple categories.**

Property owners can use SpotLet to **showcase their properties online and create opportunities to generate additional income** by making their spaces available for relevant bookings.

The platform can feature a wide variety of properties, including homes, villas, cottages, farmhouses, apartments, event spaces, unique venues, and other properties suitable for stays, events, and creative productions.

**About the Role**

We are looking for enthusiastic, confident, and target\-oriented **Business Development Associates (BDAs)** to join our growing team in Hyderabad.

As a BDA, your primary responsibility will be to **promote SpotLet to property owners and onboard suitable properties onto the platform.**

You will primarily work through **phone calls and other digital communication channels** to identify property owners, introduce SpotLet, explain how the platform works, and demonstrate how listing their property can help them reach potential customers and generate additional income.

This is primarily an **Inside Sales / Business Development / Property Acquisition role**.

You will speak directly with property owners, understand their properties and requirements, explain the different opportunities available through SpotLet, and encourage them to list their properties on the platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make outbound calls to prospective property owners.
* Introduce and promote **SpotLet** to property owners.
* Clearly explain SpotLet's online marketplace and how it works.
* Explain the potential benefits of listing properties on SpotLet.
* Identify properties suitable for Homestays, Staycations, Events, Film Shoots, Photography, and other creative requirements.
* Understand the property type, location, facilities, features, and potential use cases.
* Persuade interested property owners to list their properties on SpotLet.
* Follow up with prospective property owners and convert leads into successful property listings.
* Assist property owners through the initial onboarding and listing process.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, follow\-ups, and conversions.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with property owners.
* Coordinate with internal teams for successful property onboarding.
* Achieve individual and team\-based business development targets.
* Collect feedback from property owners and share insights with the team to improve SpotLet's products, services, and sales process.

**Who Are We Looking For?**

We are looking for candidates who are:

* Confident and comfortable speaking with people over the phone.
* Good at communicating and explaining products/services clearly.
* Persuasive, energetic, and customer\-focused.
* Comfortable with outbound calling and sales conversations.
* Comfortable working with targets and performance goals.
* Good at follow\-ups and relationship building.
* Self\-motivated and willing to learn.
* Comfortable using computers, smartphones, WhatsApp, email, CRM systems, and basic office software.
* Interested in technology, digital platforms, online marketplaces, sales, and business development.
* Able to communicate effectively in **English and Hindi**.
* Knowledge of Other Languages is an advantage.

**Freshers Are Welcome**

title: Junior Project Coordinator
job_function: Design, Information Technology, and Project Management
description:
Hexr Factory is a next\-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner — redefining how businesses and teams turn ideas into reality through powerful, real\-time digital experiences.
   

  

 We don’t just build products — we engineer dynamic, interactive ecosystems that transform complex concepts into compelling, high\-impact solutions. From cutting\-edge digital twins and advanced simulations to fully interactive platforms, our work enables sectors such as AEC, real estate, automotive, edtech and enterprise to visualise, communicate and operate with exceptional clarity and accuracy.
   

  

 At Hexr, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our multidisciplinary team blends deep interactive realtime 3D expertise with leading\-edge software engineering, design thinking and high\-fidelity visualization to deliver visually striking, technically robust experiences across web, desktop and mobile environments.
   

  

 This is a place for ambitious thinkers and problem\-solvers — people who want to push boundaries, build meaningful technology and create experiences that don’t just look good, but truly make an impact.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Project Coordinator with 1–3 years of relevant experience to support the day\-to\-day execution of cross\-functional projects. The role is focused on keeping work organised, maintaining accurate project information, coordinating reviews and handovers, and helping leads identify risks early. This is a hands\-on coordination role, not a Project Manager position.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Maintain project plans and trackers with clear tasks, owners, priorities, due dates, dependencies and current status.
* Follow up on progress and verify updates against available files, versions, review comments or approvals before reporting completion.
* Coordinate daily stand\-ups, reviews and internal checkpoints; record decisions, actions, blockers and unresolved questions.
* Convert requirements and feedback from meetings, email and chat into clear, trackable actions.
* Monitor deadlines and dependencies, flag risks early, and communicate the likely impact and required decision to the relevant lead.
* Prepare concise project updates covering confirmed progress, at\-risk items, blockers and decisions required.
* Maintain meeting notes, action logs, change records and other project documentation in the agreed source of truth.
* Coordinate handovers between teams only after required review, approval, version and file\-link checks are complete.
* Support resource and capacity visibility, including planned leave and competing priorities, while working with project leads on practical schedule changes.
* Help improve tracking, reporting and follow\-up routines using spreadsheets, project tools, automation or carefully verified AI assistance.
* Handle client and internal project information with discretion and confidentiality.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, production coordination, PMO support or a comparable delivery\-focused role.
* Practical experience using spreadsheets and at least one project or task\-management tool.
* Working knowledge of task planning, dependencies, risks, status reporting, reviews, approvals and handovers.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail and consistent follow\-through.
* Ability to work with creative and technical teams, ask precise questions and escalate issues with useful context.
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience is acceptable. An MBA or project\-management certification is welcome but not required.
* Familiarity with Agile or Scrum routines and basic reporting or automation workflows is an advantage.

**About the Apprenticeship Program**

**Job Description**
**Software Engineer – Corporate Affairs Digital Platforms**
**Role Profile / Job Description**
 Role Purpose
   

  

 The Software Engineer is responsible for designing, building, testing, deploying and supporting high\-quality digital platform capabilities across Corporate Affairs digital products and services. The role contributes to secure, scalable and maintainable solutions that support global web, content, brand, campaign and operational support capabilities.
   

  

 Working with Technical Delivery Leads, Product Managers, architects, QA, operations and supplier teams, the role turns prioritised requirements into reliable software. It follows modern engineering practices across coding, testing, automation, DevOps, observability and operational support, helping ensure platforms remain resilient, secure, efficient and easy to evolve.
   

  

 Scope \& Scale
   

  

**Area**
**Scope**
**Platform focus**
 Supports Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services, including Brand Portal, global web, content, campaign, analytics and operational support capabilities.
   

  

**Engineering scope**
 Builds and supports front\-end, back\-end, integration, automation, testing and DevOps capabilities depending on platform needs and team structure.
   

  

**Delivery model**
 Works within Agile delivery teams, contributing to refinement, estimation, development, testing, release and operational improvement activities.
   

  

**Operational ownership**
 Supports a “you build it, you run it” mindset through monitoring, observability, incident support, problem solving and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Quality focus**
 Contributes to secure, accessible, performant, maintainable and production\-ready software aligned to engineering standards and platform governance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Software Design \& Development
   

  

* Design, build and maintain digital platform capabilities, components, services, APIs, integrations and automation solutions.
* Write clean, maintainable, secure and well\-tested code aligned to agreed engineering standards and coding practices.
* Contribute to technical design, solution options, code reviews and implementation feasibility assessments.
* Support platform modernisation, re\-use of shared patterns, reduction of technical debt and simplification of legacy capabilities.
* Develop solutions that are scalable, accessible, performant and supportable across global and multi\-market use cases.


 Agile Delivery \& Product Contribution
   

  

* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, demos, retrospectives and delivery reviews.
* Work with Product Managers and Technical Delivery Leads to understand business outcomes, user needs and prioritised requirements.
* Break down technical work into clear tasks and contribute to user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery planning.
* Identify assumptions, dependencies, blockers and risks early, increasing with options and recommendations where needed.
* Contribute to delivery transparency through clear updates, documentation and use of delivery management tools.


 Testing, Quality \& Release Engineering
   

  

* Build and maintain unit, integration, component and automated tests to support reliable software delivery.
* Support regression testing, accessibility checks, performance validation and production readiness activities.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, release automation, deployment processes and environment management.
* Perform code reviews and use static analysis, quality gates and peer feedback to improve engineering quality.
* Support safe release practices, rollback planning and post\-release verification.


 Platform Operations \& DevOps
   

  

* Support operational reliability through monitoring, observability, logging, alerting and service health improvements.
* Investigate and resolve incidents, defects and platform issues, working with support, supplier and infrastructure teams as required.
* Contribute to runbooks, knowledge articles, support documentation and handover materials.
* Support automation of manual operational processes to improve efficiency, reduce risk and increase delivery speed.
* Help ensure services meet non\-functional requirements for resilience, availability, security, privacy and maintainability.


 Collaboration \& Engineering Culture
   

  

* Collaborate effectively with architects, QA, operations, security, privacy, analytics, suppliers and business customers.
* Share knowledge, document solutions and support capability building across bp and supplier engineering teams.
* Apply a product attitude by considering user value, business impact, long\-term operability and platform consistency.
* Adopt AI\-assisted engineering and automation tools where appropriate and governed, improving productivity and quality.
* Promote continuous improvement, curiosity, engineering field and accountability across the team.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Experience building and supporting digital products, web platforms, CMS\-backed services, APIs, integrations or cloud\-native applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including code quality, testing, maintainability, design patterns, security and performance awareness.
* Experience with modern development practices, Agile delivery, version control, CI/CD, automated testing and DevOps ways of working.
* Ability to work with requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, translating business needs into robust technical outcomes.
* Good understanding of operational readiness, monitoring, logging, incident support and production service ownership.
* Experience working with suppliers, distributed teams and cross\-functional stakeholders in enterprise technology environments.
* Desirable experience with Contentful, MACH architecture, headless CMS, React or modern front\-end frameworks, Java/API development, AWS, Azure DevOps, Git, automation or AI\-assisted development.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Delivery of high\-quality software changes, fixes and enhancements to agreed scope, quality and timeline expectations.
* Clean, maintainable and secure code with appropriate test coverage, documentation and peer review.
* Improved platform reliability, performance, accessibility, security and operational supportability.
* Effective contribution to Agile ceremonies, estimates, refinement, release activity and delivery transparency.
* Reduction of manual effort, technical debt and operational risk through automation, simplification and engineering improvements.
* Strong collaboration with product, delivery, architecture, QA, operations and supplier teams.
* Successful transition of changes into production and BAU support with clear ownership and support documentation.


**About Bp**
 Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Design, Brand & User Experience Associate
description:
AI\-native products need AI\-native design thinking. We’re looking for someone who can see around the corner of what “simple” means in a world where the interface itself is starting to think.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Understand and design for customer journeys across our emerging AI\-native applications.
* Simplify complex advertising and automation workflows into genuinely usable experiences.
* Shape brand and visual identity consistent with the design system across web, product, and communications.
* Push a point of view on where AI\-native product design is headed — and design for that future, not just today.


 What You Bring
   

  

* Strong UX/UI fundamentals and a portfolio that shows real problem\-solving, not just visual polish.
* Demonstrated interest in AI\-native applications, AI automation, and their implications for design.
* A visionary streak — you can articulate where the industry is going and design toward it.
* Excellent communication and the ability to defend design decisions with reasoning, not just taste.


**Bonus Points:** 
*Prior exposure to programmatic advertising, AI tooling, or interaction design for automation\-heavy products.*
 For all positions: we’re looking for people who learn quickly, adapt to new and emerging technologies, and want to help build the future of advertising technology. This is an office\-based role in South Delhi — we value genuine enthusiasm for working from office, tinkering with LLMs, AI, programmatic, ad insertion, and even gaming, inside a startup\-style, operationally flexible environment. Hard work and a real focus on building a long\-term career in ad\-tech software development matter more to us than a polished résumé.
   

  

*Disclaimer: due to the large volume of applications received, we are only able to respond to successful candidates.*
 On the Early\-Career Program
   

  

 Programmatic ad\-tech is an exceptionally niche industry, and very few schools or workplaces truly expose people to its technical, operational, or business realities — especially combined with emerging interactive and immersive advertising experiences. Because of this, we understand that strong candidates may come from lateral career shifts or seemingly unrelated backgrounds. While we review every application for relevant experience and education, résumés alone rarely reveal curiosity, systems thinking, adaptability, or genuine interest in the industry.
   

  

 Established players in this space rarely let experienced talent circulate freely, and we recognize the challenge of building in such a rare ecosystem while bootstrapping. We encourage applicants to research the industry before applying, avoid applying blindly, and tell us why this space excites you — especially if you’re willing to pursue an early\-career journey of learning, exploration, and growth while transitioning from another field.
   

  

 Application Requirements
   

  

* A completed application form, including your resume.
* Essay 1 — Statement of Purpose: why Blowtrumpet is for you, why you want to be part of ad\-tech, and how ad\-tech differs from other industries (e.g. ed\-tech) in ways that interest you.
* Essay 2 — Your Workflow in the Emerging Technologies Age: your view on AI and where it’s heading, how you’re incorporating AI into your workflow today, and real examples of difficulties you’ve faced and how you resolved them.
* Essay 3 — Gamification: what gamification means to you, a real\-life example, what the gamification loop looks like, and how you’d apply it to create an engaging experience for friends, family, or coworkers.


 You may use AI tools to help write these essays.
 **If you do, disclose which tools you used, your prompts and guidance, and confirm your agreement with the output. If you choose not to use AI, tell us that too.**
 Optional Guiding Questions
   

  

 You’re welcome to draw on any of the following while writing your three essays — they’re prompts, not a separate form to fill out line by line.
   

  

* 1\. Provide us with your present PIN Code. We won’t be processing applications without a valid PIN Code and address location. You’re encouraged to join our Discord server, “Hire For Work” (linked in the website footer) — introduce yourself and interact there; it goes a long way for our assessment and lets us connect with you in real time. Also define, in your own words, the difference between ed\-tech and ad\-tech.
