description:
**Main Purpose**


The HR Technology \& Automation Manager is responsible for leading the global HR technology function, encompassing the strategic ownership, configuration, governance, continuous improvement, and roadmap evolution of Workday and the broader HR technology landscape. The role also drives HR process automation and digitalization across the organization — identifying, redesigning, and implementing automation solutions that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and enhance the employee experience.


Acting as both a strategic and technical leader, this role bridges HR, IT, HRIS, and technology vendors. It manages day\-to\-day HRIS operations, leads a team of HRIS analysts, and champions the adoption of workflow automation, AI, and digital tools across HR processes.

**Primary Job Responsibilities**

**HR Technology \& Workday**

* Lead the design, development, configuration, and continuous improvement of Workday and all HRIS functionalities across the organization, including modules, integrations, security, reporting, and enhancements.
* Manage the full lifecycle of HRIS projects: requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, and post\-launch support for implementations, upgrades, and system integrations.
* Develop, maintain, and migrate integration solutions between Workday and internal/external systems (Payroll, Finance, Benefits, etc.) using Studio, Cloud Connect, REST/SOAP Web Services, XML, and XSLT.
* Define and enforce HRIS governance frameworks, data standards, access controls, and security configurations to ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor system performance and proactively recommend improvements to optimize the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of HR systems.
* Manage the HRIS budget including planning, vendor cost management, and tracking execution against approved budgets aligned with business priorities.
* Stay current on Workday releases, community updates, and the broader HR technology market; assess the impact of new features and lead their adoption where relevant.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for all HRIS configurations, integrations, and processes.
* Provide expert guidance and training to team members and HR stakeholders on HRIS and Workday best practices.
* Serve as the key integrator between functional HR requirements and technical HRIS delivery; partner closely with HR, Payroll, IT, Finance, and external vendors globally.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and company policies related to HR data security and privacy.

**HR Automation \& Process Digitalization**

* Own the HR automation agenda: systematically identify repetitive, manual, high\-volume, or error\-prone HR processes across the function as candidates for automation or digitalization.
* Partner with HR stakeholders to map, redesign, and streamline processes before automating — ensuring automation reinforces best\-practice workflows, not inefficient ones.
* Evaluate, recommend, and implement automation solutions including workflow automation tools, RPA, AI\-powered capabilities, system integrations, and digital self\-service enhancements.
* Leverage AI and intelligent automation tools where appropriate to improve HR data quality, accelerate processing, reduce manual intervention, and enable predictive insights.
* Establish governance standards, prioritization frameworks, and documentation practices for all HR automation initiatives across the organization.
* Define and track impact metrics for automation efforts: efficiency gains, reduction in manual effort, data quality improvements, error reduction, and enhanced employee and manager experience.
* Act as the bridge between HR, IT, HRIS, and technology vendors to ensure alignment on automation strategy, tooling, data security, and architecture.
* Build awareness and capability across the HR team for automated tools and self\-service solutions, driving adoption and reducing dependency on manual processing.
* Continuously scan the HR technology landscape for emerging platforms, AI\-enabled capabilities, and automation tools that can advance HR digitalization goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Human Resources, or a related field of study.
* Minimum 8 years of HRIS/HR technology experience, with at least 5 years of hands\-on Workday expertise including module configuration, integrations, and security (Studio, Cloud Connect, REST/SOAP, XML, XSLT).
* Proven track record leading HRIS teams and delivering global HR technology initiatives in a complex, multi\-country environment.
* Demonstrated experience in HR automation, process digitalization, or the implementation of workflow/RPA/AI\-enabled solutions within HR.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and data across domains such as Recruiting, Onboarding, Compensation, Payroll, Benefits, and Learning.
* Experience with Workday tenant security configuration, integration architecture design patterns, and ERP integration best practices.
* Excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, and organizational skills; comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast\-paced, agile environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to translate technical topics clearly for non\-technical HR stakeholders and present confidently at senior levels.
* Experience with software development lifecycle and project management; agile methodology experience is a plus.
* Shows initiative, works independently with minimal supervision, and approaches complex problems creatively with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Exposure to AI tools, process mining, intelligent automation platforms, or digital transformation programs is a strong plus.

title: Plant Manager
description:
**PLANT MANAGER**

**Industry:** Thermistors / Electronic Components / Powder Metallurgy  
**Department:** Plant Operations  
**Reports To:** Managing Director / Operations Director  
**Location:** Nila Tech Pvt. Ltd.  
**Experience:** 12–20 years, preferably with 5\+ years in a plant leadership role

Job Purpose

The Plant Manager will be responsible for the overall management and performance of the manufacturing plant, ensuring safe, efficient, cost\-effective, and timely production of thermistors and other powder\-metallurgy\-based electronic components.

The role will lead production, process engineering, quality, maintenance, production planning, stores, utilities, safety, and manpower management while driving continuous improvement, productivity enhancement, waste reduction, and customer satisfaction.

The Plant Manager will be expected to develop a strong manufacturing culture based on process discipline, quality at source, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities1\. Plant Operations \& Production

* Take overall responsibility for day\-to\-day plant operations and manufacturing performance.
* Ensure production plans are achieved in terms of quantity, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Develop and implement production strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Monitor production capacity, bottlenecks, cycle times, OEE, productivity, and utilization.
* Ensure effective control of processes involved in powder metallurgy and thermistor manufacturing, including:
* Raw\-material preparation and powder processing
* Mixing / formulation
* Granulation and pressing
* Sintering / firing
* Grinding and sizing
* Metallization / electrode application
* Lead forming / assembly
* Electrical testing and inspection
* Packaging and final dispatch
* Establish appropriate process parameters, control plans, and standard operating procedures in coordination with engineering and quality teams.
* Improve line balancing, material flow, layout, and production efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to production schedules and minimize delays and downtime.

2\. Quality Management

* Ensure consistent product quality and compliance with customer specifications.
* Work closely with the Quality team to establish and maintain process controls.
* Drive reduction of rejection, rework, scrap, customer complaints, and process variation.
* Monitor critical characteristics such as resistance values, B\-value, tolerance, dimensional accuracy, electrical characteristics, mechanical strength, and reliability, as applicable to the product.
* Ensure effective root\-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action for internal and customer quality issues.
* Promote a zero\-defect / quality\-at\-source culture throughout the plant.
* Support customer audits, certification audits, and process/product audits.

3\. Powder Metallurgy \& Process Engineering

* Develop a strong understanding of powder metallurgy processes and their impact on product performance.
* Ensure control of critical variables such as:
* Powder composition and particle characteristics
* Mixing uniformity
* Binder/additive control
* Compaction pressure and density
* Green strength
* Sintering temperature profiles and atmosphere
* Shrinkage and dimensional control
* Electrode/metallization quality
* Electrical characteristics
* Work with R\&D / Process Engineering teams for new product introduction, process development, and process optimization.
* Lead scale\-up activities from laboratory/prototype stage to mass production.
* Ensure process capability and repeatability for critical manufacturing operations.

4\. Maintenance \& Utilities

* Ensure high availability and reliability of production equipment.
* Establish preventive and predictive maintenance systems.
* Monitor equipment downtime, MTBF, MTTR, and maintenance costs.
* Ensure timely maintenance of critical equipment such as presses, furnaces, grinders, mixers, testing equipment, compressors, HVAC systems, and utilities.
* Develop plans for machine upgrades, automation, replacement, and capacity expansion.
* Ensure adequate spare\-parts planning and inventory control.
* Improve equipment OEE and reduce unplanned breakdowns.

5\. Cost \& Productivity Improvement

* Take ownership of plant manufacturing costs and drive continuous cost reduction.
* Identify opportunities to reduce:
* Material consumption
* Scrap and rejection
* Energy consumption
* Labour cost per unit
* Machine downtime
* Consumable costs
* Conversion costs
* Establish productivity improvement targets for each department.
* Lead Lean Manufacturing / Kaizen / Six Sigma initiatives where appropriate.
* Promote automation, semi\-automation, poka\-yoke, and process simplification.
* Improve yield and material utilization across powder\-processing and sintering operations.

6\. Production Planning \& Materials

* Coordinate with Production Planning, Purchase, Stores, and Sales teams to ensure uninterrupted production.
* Maintain optimum levels of raw materials, WIP, and finished goods.
* Identify and eliminate material\-flow constraints.
* Ensure FIFO, traceability, batch control, and proper material identification.
* Coordinate capacity planning for new programs and customer requirements.
* Ensure timely completion of production orders and dispatch commitments.

7\. People \& Team Management

* Lead and develop production, quality, maintenance, engineering, and support teams.
* Establish clear KPIs and performance objectives for departmental managers and supervisors.
* Build a culture of accountability, discipline, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Identify training and competency requirements.
* Develop second\-line leadership and succession plans.
* Ensure effective manpower planning and optimum utilization of personnel.
* Maintain strong communication between shop\-floor employees and management.

8\. Safety, Environment \& Compliance

* Ensure a safe working environment and compliance with applicable statutory requirements.
* Implement robust systems for:
* Industrial safety
* Fire prevention and emergency preparedness
* Chemical handling
* Furnace and high\-temperature equipment safety
* Electrical safety
* PPE compliance
* Dust control and housekeeping
* Waste disposal
* Drive accident prevention and near\-miss reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental and statutory regulations.

9\. Continuous Improvement

* Establish a structured continuous\-improvement program across the plant.
* Use data\-driven methods to identify losses and improvement opportunities.
* Drive initiatives focused on:
* OEE improvement
* Yield improvement
* First\-pass yield
* Scrap reduction
* Cycle\-time reduction
* Energy efficiency
* Setup\-time reduction
* Inventory reduction
* Workplace organization / 5S
* Promote problem\-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, SPC, FMEA, and Kaizen.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Plant Manager will be accountable for achieving agreed targets relating to:

* Production achievement (%)
* On\-time delivery (%)
* OEE (%)
* First\-pass yield (%)
* Process yield (%)
* Rejection and scrap (%)
* Customer complaints / PPM
* Manufacturing conversion cost
* Productivity per employee
* Machine downtime
* MTBF / MTTR
* Energy consumption per unit
* Inventory / WIP levels
* Safety incidents
* Employee productivity and turnover
* Continuous\-improvement savings

Education \& ExperienceEssential

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, Metallurgy, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* 12–20 years of relevant manufacturing experience.
* Proven experience managing a manufacturing plant or major production operation.
* Strong experience in production, quality, maintenance, and process improvement.

Preferred

* Experience in powder metallurgy, ceramics, electronic components, thermistors, ferrites, resistors, sensors, or similar precision manufacturing industries.
* Knowledge of sintering/firing processes and material\-property control.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, SPC, and structured problem solving.
* Exposure to ISO 9001 and other relevant quality\-management systems.
* Experience in new\-product industrialization and process scale\-up.

Technical Competencies

The candidate should have a good working knowledge of:

* Powder metallurgy manufacturing
* Material and process control
* Sintering / furnace operations
* Pressing and compaction
* Grinding and finishing
* Electrical/electronic component manufacturing
* Process capability and SPC
* Quality management systems
* Preventive/predictive maintenance
* Production planning
* Lean Manufacturing / Kaizen
* Root\-cause analysis
* Cost reduction
* Industrial engineering and productivity improvement
* ERP/MRP systems
* Health, safety, and environmental requirements

Leadership Competencies

* Strong leadership and decision\-making ability
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work under production and customer\-delivery pressures
* High level of ownership and accountability
* Data\-driven approach to decision\-making
* Change\-management capability
* Strong shop\-floor orientation
* Ability to develop people and future leaders

Key Interfaces

The Plant Manager will work closely with:

* Managing Director / CEO
* Sales \& Marketing
* R\&D / Product Development
* Process Engineering
* Quality Assurance
* Production Planning
* Purchase \& Supply Chain
* Maintenance \& Utilities
* Finance
* HR \& Administration
* Customers and external auditors

Overall Success Profile

The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on manufacturing leader capable of managing a technically demanding plant while simultaneously improving quality, productivity, yield, delivery, cost, and safety.

The person should be comfortable working on the shop floor, analyzing process data, solving technical problems, leading cross\-functional teams, and converting business objectives into measurable plant\-level results.

Primary Objective

Build a highly reliable, efficient, scalable, and quality\-driven manufacturing operation capable of consistently producing thermistors and powder\-metallurgy components to stringent customer specifications and delivery requirements.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

description:
**Strategic Manager\-cum\-Executive**

Department

Management / Strategy \& Operations

Reporting To

Managing Director / Director / CEO

Job Purpose

The Strategic Manager\-cum\-Executive will work closely with the senior management team to support the company’s **strategic growth, business development, project execution, operational efficiency, and management decision\-making**.

The role requires a combination of strategic thinking and hands\-on execution. The incumbent will monitor key business activities, coordinate between departments and project teams, identify growth opportunities, ensure timely follow\-up on management decisions, and provide regular performance insights to senior management.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Strategic Planning \& Business Management

* Assist senior management in developing and implementing the company’s short\-term and long\-term strategic plans.
* Translate management objectives into actionable plans, timelines, and measurable targets.
* Monitor achievement of business, financial, operational, and project\-related objectives.
* Identify business gaps, operational challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
* Prepare management reports, dashboards, MIS, and strategic analysis for decision\-making.
* Track industry trends, construction\-sector developments, competitors, and emerging business opportunities.

2\. Business Development \& Growth

* Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, projects, clients, and market segments.
* Support the preparation of business proposals, capability presentations, tenders, and client submissions.
* Develop and maintain relationships with clients, consultants, architects, contractors, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the estimation and tendering teams to assess project opportunities.
* Monitor the company's project pipeline and follow up on prospective projects.
* Support senior management in negotiations and strategic business discussions.

3\. Project \& Operations Coordination

* Monitor the overall progress of ongoing construction projects against approved schedules, budgets, and milestones.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Procurement, Accounts, HR, and other departments.
* Identify delays, bottlenecks, resource constraints, and critical project issues and escalate them to management.
* Follow up on corrective actions and ensure timely closure of management decisions.
* Review project progress reports and highlight critical deviations.
* Assist in improving coordination between the corporate office and project sites.

4\. Commercial \& Financial Monitoring

* Assist management in monitoring project profitability, cost control, cash flow, and collections.
* Review project budgets and compare actual performance against planned costs.
* Coordinate with Accounts/Finance regarding billing, receivables, payments, and outstanding amounts.
* Track variations, additional works, claims, and commercial issues.
* Highlight financial risks and potential cost overruns to senior management.

5\. Procurement \& Vendor Coordination

* Coordinate with procurement teams regarding material requirements, quotations, purchase orders, and delivery schedules.
* Assist in evaluating vendors and subcontractors based on cost, quality, reliability, and delivery performance.
* Monitor critical material and subcontractor requirements for ongoing projects.
* Support management in resolving major procurement and vendor\-related issues.

6\. Management Coordination \& Executive Support

* Act as a coordination link between senior management and various departments.
* Maintain a tracker of key decisions, priorities, deadlines, and action points assigned by management.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with concerned personnel and report status to management.
* Organize management meetings and prepare agendas, minutes, and action plans where required.
* Ensure important instructions and decisions are communicated effectively and followed through.
* Handle confidential management information with professionalism and discretion.

7\. Performance Monitoring \& MIS

* Develop and maintain management dashboards covering:
* Project progress
* Revenue and collections
* Project profitability
* Tender pipeline
* Procurement status
* Manpower
* Receivables
* Critical risks and issues
* Prepare weekly and monthly management reports.
* Analyze KPIs and identify areas requiring management intervention.
* Ensure timely and accurate information is available for strategic decision\-making.

8\. Risk Management \& Problem Solving

* Identify operational, commercial, financial, contractual, and project\-related risks.
* Maintain a risk and issue tracker for critical projects and business activities.
* Recommend practical solutions to improve project and business performance.
* Escalate critical risks to senior management along with possible corrective actions.
* Support crisis management and resolution of critical operational issues.

9\. Process Improvement

* Review existing business and project processes and identify inefficiencies.
* Recommend systems, procedures, and controls to improve productivity and accountability.
* Support implementation of SOPs, reporting systems, digital tools, and performance\-monitoring mechanisms.
* Promote better coordination and communication across departments.

10\. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Support senior management in maintaining key client relationships.
* Participate in client meetings, project review meetings, negotiations, and business discussions when required.
* Ensure important client concerns are followed up and resolved promptly.
* Maintain professional relationships with consultants, government authorities, vendors, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.

11\. Special Projects \& Management Initiatives

* Take ownership of strategic projects or special assignments entrusted by senior management.
* Conduct research, analysis, feasibility studies, and business assessments as required.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives involving multiple departments.
* Ensure assigned initiatives are completed within agreed timelines and objectives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be evaluated based on:

* Achievement of strategic and operational targets.
* Timely completion of management action points.
* Improvement in project coordination and execution.
* Business development and qualified project pipeline.
* Improvement in project profitability and cost control.
* Timely MIS and management reporting.
* Reduction in project delays and unresolved critical issues.
* Improvement in collections and commercial follow\-up.
* Effectiveness of cross\-functional coordination.
* Successful implementation of management initiatives and process improvements.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good understanding of construction/project management.
* Ability to understand project costs, budgets, contracts, and commercial matters.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and management reporting tools.
* Ability to prepare presentations, MIS, dashboards, and analytical reports.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple priorities.
* High level of confidentiality, integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

Preferred Qualification \& Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* MBA / PGDM / qualification in Project Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
* **5–10 years of relevant experience**, preferably in construction, infrastructure, real estate, EPC, or related industries.
* Experience working directly with senior management or promoters will be an advantage.

Role Profile

This is a **high\-responsibility, cross\-functional role** requiring the individual to operate both as a **strategic thinker and an execution\-oriented manager**. The position is expected to ensure that management priorities are converted into measurable actions and that critical business and project matters receive timely attention and resolution.

description:
**Designation: Regional Manager of Supply \& Network for RSA Business Unit**

**Experience: 5\-10 years Type of Employment: Full Time, Permanent**

**Location: HSR Layout, Bangalore Role Overview**

The Regional Manager – Supply \& Network will own the complete supply network and operational readiness of ReadyAssist within the assigned territory. This is a high\-calibre field leadership role, not a conventional vendor\-management position. The RM will effectively taking complete ownership of network availability, skill coverage, partner activation, order acceptance, fulfilment, quality, cost, and partner discipline. The role requires extensive on\-ground presence, continuous market mapping, aggressive partner onboarding, relationship building, operational problem\-solving, and 24×7 supply management. The ultimate objective is simple: Ensure ReadyAssist has the right service provider, with the right skill, at the right location, at the right time — 24×7, 365 days a year — to fulfil every eligible RSA order within SLA.

The person we are looking for: A hunter, builder and operator who can walk into a market, understand the supply gap, find the right partners, negotiate, onboard, activate them, and build a reliable 24×7 supply network. Someone who does not wait for supply problems to appear on a dashboard — they go to the ground and solve them.

Preferred Experience **5–10 years in Ground Operations, Field Operations, Mobility, Logistics, Last\-Mile Delivery, Aggregator Management, Partner Acquisition, or similar businesses.**  Minimum 3–5 years in a field leadership role managing distributed partner/aggregator networks.

**Proven experience in on\-ground partner acquisition and network expansion.**  Experience managing large and geographically distributed service\-provider ecosystems. **Experience in an on\-demand, SLA\-driven business is strongly preferred.** 

Experience in RSA, automotive, mobility, logistics, last\-mile delivery, e\-commerce, food delivery, or similar businesses will be an advantage. **Strong understanding of dashboards, operational technology, partner platforms, and data\-driven execution.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Territory Ownership **Own the complete RSA supply network within the assigned territory.**  Take end\-to\-end accountability for supply availability and order fulfilment. **Act as the single owner of supply performance for the territory.**  Build the territory into a strong, scalable, and reliable supply network. **Identify market opportunities and supply gaps proactively.**  Take complete ownership of resolving ground\-level supply challenges. 2\. Supply Network Building \& Expansion **Build and continuously expand the network of: o Aggregators o Mechanics o Towing partners o Workshops o Specialized service providers o Other relevant roadside assistance partners**  Identify underserved locations, cities, towns, highways, and pin codes.

Develop supply before business demand increases. **Maintain adequate primary and backup supply across critical locations.**  Build additional capacity for nights, weekends, holidays, peak periods, and emergencies.

3\. **Aggregator \& Partner Acquisition Personally drive partner acquisition and onboarding across the territory.**  Spend significant time in the market identifying and engaging potential aggregators and service providers. **Build strong local networks and market intelligence.**  Conduct partner meetings, capability assessments, negotiations, onboarding, and activation. **Continuously maintain a strong pipeline of prospective partners.**  Acquire the right quality and quantity of supply rather than simply increasing partner count. **Ensure every onboarded partner becomes an active and productive partner.**

4\. 24×7 Supply Availability **Ensure supply is available 24×7, 365 days a year.**  Monitor supply availability by: o Location o Pin code o Time of day o Skill type o Vehicle type o Demand pattern **Identify night\-time and low\-demand\-period supply gaps.**  Build contingency and backup supply for critical locations. **Ensure sufficient supply capacity during sudden demand spikes.**

5\. Order Fulfilment \& SLA **Own 100% order fulfilment for the territory.**  Ensure 100% order acceptance **Monitor: o Order acceptance**

o Response time o Fulfilment o SLA adherence o Cancellations o Declines o Unassigned orders o Escalations **Immediately intervene when supply shortages affect fulfilment.**  Conduct root\-cause analysis for every major supply failure. **Ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained. 6\. Skill Coverage \& Network Capability**  Ensure the territory has adequate coverage across required RSA skills. **Identify gaps in specialized services and build appropriate supply.**  Ensure the right service provider is available for the right job. **Continuously assess whether the existing network can support current and future business requirements.**  Build specialized supply wherever business requirements demand it.

7\. Partner Activation \& Productivity **Ensure onboarded partners remain active, available, and productive.**  Drive partner activation and adoption of ReadyAssist technology. **Improve order acceptance and partner productivity.**  Identify inactive, low\-performing, and unreliable partners. **Take corrective action through engagement, coaching, replacement, or network restructuring.**  Maintain strong partner relationships while enforcing operational discipline.

8\. Partner Quality \& Discipline **Ensure all partners adhere to ReadyAssist SOPs, quality standards, SLA requirements, and customer\-handling expectations.**  Conduct regular partner visits and audits. **Verify actual ground\-level availability rather than relying only on system data.**  Take action against partners demonstrating poor quality, misconduct, repeated SLA breaches, or operational indiscipline. **Maintain a high\-quality and dependable partner ecosystem.**

9\. Cost \& Commercial Discipline **Maintain healthy supply economics within the territory.**  Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising fulfilment or customer experience. **Monitor partner payout and service economics.**  Identify inefficient supply structures and redesign them where required. **Balance availability, quality, fulfilment and cost.**

10\. Extensive Field Execution **Spend a significant majority of time on the ground.**  Travel extensively across the assigned territory. **Conduct regular market visits and partner meetings.**  Personally visit critical supply\-gap locations. **Conduct surprise partner visits and operational audits.**  Meet new aggregators and service providers continuously. **Understand local market dynamics, competitor networks, pricing, availability, and partner behaviour.**  Be willing to travel anytime and anywhere when the business requires it.

11\. Data \& Performance Management **Study daily operational dashboards and identify supply gaps.**  Convert data into specific field actions. **Track territory\-level KPIs and corrective actions.**  Review partner productivity and network health regularly. **Use data to decide: o Where to onboard o Which partners to activate o Where additional supply is required o Which partners need intervention o Where supply needs to be replaced**  Provide regular performance insights to the Zonal Manager – Supply \& Network.

12\. Business Expansion Support **Build supply readiness and new business opportunities.**  Work closely with Business and Operations teams to understand upcoming demand. **Ensure the supply network is ready before business goes live.**  Scale the territory rapidly when business requirements increase.

title: Marketing Officer
description:
**Job Description:** 

**Marketing Officer** is an entry level position in sales and marketing career with DLIFE Interiors. Initial assignment is into creating a productive network of referral partners within the given branch area. Task is to enroll potential referral partners (Silver Envoys) and maintain strong relationships with them and generate enquiries (leads) for home interiors. This role does not involve sales, but requires regular local travel within a 30 KM radius of the branch and meeting potential referral partners and enrolling them to the Silver Envoy Programme. Simultaneously, the Marketing Officer starts learning the sales process, acquires knowledge in the interior industry and develops the necessary skills to become an assistant or support client manager in the same or another branch. It is more of a sales promotional and supportive role, in the journey towards becoming a successful client manager.

**Educational Qualification Required.** 

MBA/ BBA/ Bcom/ Btech\-Civil \- (Fresher / 1\-2 Years of Sales Experience in any Industry)

**Skills / Abilities Required:** 

\* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for client interaction, follow up and lead generation.

\* Sales/ Interpersonal Skills: Ability to meet, convince and convert partners and potential customers for mutual benefit.

\* Networking and relationship building: Success in this field depends upon the ability to build productive, long term relationships.

\* Work Ethics: Self motivated, goal oriented and disciplined to work with minimum supervision.

\* Reporting: Maintain and share the details about the new Silver Envoys and leads to the Silver Envoy Manager as well as the branch manager.

**Training:**

The first 10 working days will be dedicated to formal training and showroom visits.

From the 11th working day onwards, they will begin outdoor visits for Silver Envoy creation and lead generation.

**Target:**

The target for Silver Envoy enrolment \-Enroll 3 Silver Envoys (Potential referral partners) a day.

Generate one potential lead per day.

**Future Career Progression:** 

Support Client Manager

Assistant Client Manager

Client Manager

Senior Client Manager

Branch Manager

Area Sales Manager

**Incentives** 

Marketing Officer Incentives are linked to the successful closing of the Marketing Officer generated leads by a client manager in the branch.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Job Summary

We are looking for a dedicated and technically sound **Chemist** with 1–4 years of experience in the chemical manufacturing industry. The candidate will be responsible for laboratory analysis, quality control, production support, maintaining chemical testing records, and ensuring compliance with company quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct chemical analysis and testing of **raw materials, in\-process materials, and finished products**.
* Perform routine laboratory tests as per approved testing procedures and specifications.
* Monitor and maintain the quality of products during the manufacturing process.
* Support the Production Department in process monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Prepare chemical solutions, reagents, and samples required for laboratory testing.
* Maintain accurate laboratory records, test reports, logbooks, and documentation.
* Ensure proper sampling, labeling, storage, and disposal of chemical samples.
* Identify deviations in test results and immediately report them to the Senior Chemist / QC Head.
* Assist in investigation of quality issues and take corrective actions as instructed.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of chemicals in accordance with safety procedures.
* Maintain cleanliness, housekeeping, and discipline in the laboratory.
* Follow all **chemical, process, electrical, fire, and personal safety procedures**.
* Ensure proper use of PPE while handling chemicals and performing laboratory activities.
* Coordinate with Production, QC, Maintenance, and other departments whenever required.
* Assist in calibration and maintenance of laboratory instruments and equipment.
* Follow SOPs, work instructions, and company quality standards.
* Participate in internal audits, quality improvement activities, and process improvement initiatives.
* Prepare daily/weekly laboratory reports as required by the department head.
* Perform any other duties assigned by the Reporting Manager / Management.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of **chemical testing and laboratory procedures**.
* Knowledge of handling laboratory instruments and chemical equipment.
* Basic understanding of chemical manufacturing processes.
* Ability to identify abnormalities and troubleshoot routine laboratory/process issues.
* Good documentation and record\-keeping skills.
* Knowledge of chemical safety and laboratory safety practices.

We are looking for an energetic, highly motivated, and process\-driven **Junior ERP Consultant** to join our growing business development team in Kochi. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dynamic individual who wants to combine business analysis with corporate sales, exploring market segments and consulting business owners on digital transformation.

In this role, you won't just be selling software—you will be on the ground acting as a consultant for small\-to\-medium enterprises (SMEs), manufacturing units, and distributors. * **Pre\-Meeting Strategy:** Participate in mandatory internal alignment sessions with senior consultants and management before critical corporate presentations.
* **Pipeline \& Coordinator Alignment:** Diligently follow up with open leads, collaborate closely with the backend Sales Coordinator for proposal generation, and drive prospects to closure.
* **Market Intelligence:** Gather ongoing feedback from the field regarding competitor pricing and feature requirements to assist our core product development team.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* **Skills:** Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in **Malayalam, English and Hindi**. Ability to understand basic business workflows (purchases, sales, stock).
* **Attributes:** High resilience, target\-oriented, and comfortable handling on\-the\-field challenges with a problem\-solving mindset.

**Benefits \& Compensation**

title: HR Communication Intern
description:
**Role description** **About Cimpress:**



Cimpress is a global leader in mass customization, helping businesses and individuals create personalized products across print, signage, apparel, packaging, and more.



Established in 2017, Cimpress India (CI) is a strategic capability center supporting Cimpress businesses through talent, technology, and operational expertise. We are a remote\-first organization with over 2,500 team members across technology, graphic services, HR, and other functions. Our teams are based across Ahmedabad, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, with the flexibility to work from wherever they feel most productive.


**About The Role:**



We are looking for a meticulous and creative HR Communication Intern to support the HR team in creating digital\-first communications and knowledge resources for employees.



You will document HR processes, create easy\-to\-understand content and bite\-sized videos, develop digital playbooks, and use AI and other digital tools to make HR information easier to access and understand.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys writing, content creation, storytelling, and simplifying information for employee communications, employer branding, and employee experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Process Documentation \& Simplification: Partner with stakeholders to document HR processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices, and simplify them into clear, user\-friendly content.
* Multimedia Content Creation: Script and edit bite\-sized videos explaining HR processes, tools, workflows, and guidelines.
* Digital Knowledge Management: Build and maintain structured digital HR playbooks and knowledge repositories on existing digital platforms \& channels like Confluence, keeping content organized, up to date, and easy to navigate.
* Enablement Material Development: Create FAQs, process guides, checklists, templates, and how\-to guides.
* AI \& Digital Tool Integration: Use AI and digital tools for documentation, content creation, video scripting, summarization, and productivity.
* Stakeholder Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement: Gather stakeholder feedback to validate content, improve accessibility, and keep resources clear and consistent across HR channels.

**What You’ll Bring:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, English, Literature, Media, Marketing, or a related field.
* Ability to work independently in a remote\-first environment.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to learn.

**Must Have:**


* Familiarity with Canva and PowerPoint.
* Exposure to AI tools such as Gemini, or similar.

**Why You'll Love Working Here:**



At Cimpress India, we’re all about creating a supportive and collaborative work environment. Our remote\-first culture gives people the flexibility and trust to work from where they can do their best work.



As an intern, you'll have the opportunity to work closely with the HR team, contribute to high\-impact projects, and gain hands\-on experience in communication, content creation, and digital HR resources while working with colleagues. We are an equal opportunity employer.


**Our Businesses**



Cimpress operates a diverse portfolio of businesses across the world, including Vistaprint and other brands focused on mass customization.  



  

**Skills**  

  

**About Cimpress**  

Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high\-quality printed and custom products. A global leader in mass customization, Cimpress builds technology and supply chain capabilities that enable customized print, signage, packaging, and apparel products at scale through its family of customer\-focused businesses. Cimpress India is a strategic talent hub that enables Cimpress businesses to build and scale teams in India. The organization operates a centralized talent container model that removes operational complexity and provides end\-to\-end support across hiring, HR, finance, compliance, and administration. With 2,500\+ team members across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, Cimpress India delivers technology, graphics services, shared capabilities, analytics, and business operations that advance Cimpress’ long\-term strategy. Join us on a journey to help millions of businesses build brands, stand out, and grow.

We are a growing U.S.\-based third\-party construction company specializing primarily in hotel and residential construction projects. Our India team provides HR, business, marketing, and operational support to our U.S. operations.

* Strong research, problem\-solving, and coordination abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

* Direct exposure to a U.S.\-based construction company
* International work experience and professional exposure

title: Engineering Program Excellence Sr. Associate
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-253655 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 04, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


The EOS \& EHS Operational and Program Excellence Associate supports the adoption, execution, data quality, and continuous improvement of Engineering Operations Services systems and operational excellence programs. This role works under the guidance of the Sr. Manager to help ensure Engineering, Facilities, and EHS operational teams have accurate system data, reliable documentation, and fit\-for\-purpose reporting to support compliant and efficient decision\-making.


The Associate contributes to facility management systems, asset lifecycle data, standard work, KPI tracking, audit readiness activities, and user adoption efforts. The role requires strong attention to detail, a learning mindset, and the ability to collaborate across Engineering, Facilities, EHS, Quality, Compliance, Technology, and site operations stakeholders.

**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Supports program planning, status tracking, risk management, action item follow\-up, and stakeholder communication for EOS \& EHS initiatives.
* Maintains and validates Engineering and Facilities Management system data, including asset lifecycle information, master data, workflow records, and operational documentation.
* Assists with system enhancement intake, documentation, testing support, change tracking, and deployment readiness activities.
* Supports audit programs and inspections by helping ensure relevant records, evidence, reports, and system data are accurate, traceable, and available when required.
* Assists with interpretation of facilities operations data to support investigations, deviation reviews, preventive and corrective action follow\-up, and continuous improvement activities.
* Prepares and maintains dashboards, KPI trackers, reports, and recurring management review inputs for facility\-focused performance measures.
* Contributes to system standardization and harmonization efforts by documenting local practices, mapping processes, and supporting adoption of global standards.
* Supports compliance with cybersecurity, regulatory, quality, data governance, and documentation requirements for assigned Engineering systems.
* Partners with Technology teams and business users during integrations, upgrades, user acceptance testing, access reviews, and issue resolution.
* Enables reliable data consumption for analytics, reporting, and operational decision\-making through disciplined data stewardship and data quality practices.
* Supports enhancement activities while maintaining system stability through established change control, testing, documentation, and release management practices.
* Creates user guides, training materials, status updates, meeting notes, and process documentation to support adoption and operational excellence.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Facilities Management, Life Sciences, Information Systems, Business Operations, or a related field.
* Expected experience: 5\-9 years (subject to HR alignment and GCF confirmation).
* Relevant experience supporting operations, facilities, maintenance, engineering systems, digital systems, data management, business process improvement, or program coordination.
* Ability to work on site in Hyderabad and collaborate with stakeholders across global time zones when required.


\<\>·**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS**

* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical, system, or data\-driven topics to diverse audiences.
* Working knowledge of facility management, maintenance operations, asset lifecycle management, or Engineering Operations Services processes.
* Exposure to regulated environments and the importance of quality, compliance, documentation, and audit readiness.
* Data\-driven mindset with comfort using metrics, dashboards, analytics, or insights to support decisions and continuous improvement.
* Experience with Power BI, Excel, SharePoint, Teams, ticketing systems, enterprise work management tools, CMMS/EAM platforms, or data quality workflows.
* Strong written communication and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to summarize technical or data\-driven topics clearly.
* Ability to support change management, user adoption, training, and process standardization initiatives.
* High attention to detail, strong follow\-through, and willingness to learn business processes, system controls, and technical data management practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and fast\-paced global environment.
* Foundational understanding of data governance, master data, system integrations, cybersecurity expectations, and controlled documentation practices are an advantage.

**PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Relevant certifications aligned to the role or domain (preferred or mandatory based on job requirements).

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**


Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.


We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Work hours and shift requirements may vary based on business needs. Flexibility to work across different shifts may be required.

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  

  

DESCRIPTION:  

As a Field Service Supervisor at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide and support a team of skilled field service engineers while ensuring exceptional service delivery to our customers. This role combines leadership with technical expertise, promoting operational excellence and customer satisfaction. You will coordinate service activities, manage team performance, and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders. You'll contribute to meaningful impact by enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

**Job Designation: Regional Service Manager (M\&M)**

**Role Overview: \-**


The Regional Service Manager is responsible for leading a team of Service team to provide world\-class support for **XRF/OES/Process Analyzer analytical instruments in the assigned region**. This role balances technical problem\-solving with strategic business growth, focusing on service revenue generation, customer satisfaction (CAS), and team development within the Cement, Steel, and Process industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Team Leadership:** Manage and proactively lead the regional service team through all stages of the client lifecycle—from administration and planning to execution and completion.
* **Revenue Generation:** Drive regional profitability by achieving or exceeding targets for service contracts (AMCs/CMCs) and spare parts sales.
* **Operational Excellence:** Monitor team KPIs, ensuring adherence to budgets, timelines, and quality standards.
* **Customer Allegiance:** Improve Customer Allegiance Scores (CAS) by maintaining strong relationships with existing clients and identifying new business opportunities.
* **Compliance:** Ensure all team activities align with corporate policies, HR compliance, and safety standards.
* **Mentorship:** Lead, coach, and develop FSEs to upgrade their technical skills and prepare them for future leadership roles.
* **Succession Planning:** Identify and groom a successor through a structured development plan in line with organizational growth.
* **Culture:** Foster a high\-performing team environment built on empathy, ownership, and accountability.
* **Domain Expertise:** Strong knowledge of process applications specifically within the **Cement, Steel, and Process industries**.
* **Troubleshooting:** Apply advanced logical and analytical diagnostic skills to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and resolve complex instrument issues.
* **Software Proficiency:** Expert use of Service Management Software and the Microsoft Office suite.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and drive results through persuasion and partnership.
* **Conflict Management:** Skilled at handling difficult customer situations and critical technical escalations with a "soft\-spoken" yet firm professional demeanor.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to balance immediate technical fixes with long\-term business objectives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** **10\+ years** of total working experience.
	+ Minimum **5 years** in Customer Service Management.
	+ **2\+ years** in a direct supervisory/leadership role managing technical teams.
* **Technical Hands\-on:** Experience on Analytical instruments and Direct experience with **XRF/OES/Process Analyzers analytical instruments** is additional advantage.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
iCapital is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our Talent Acquisition team based in the Jaipur office and reporting to the Talent Acquisition International \- Senior Vice President, based in Lisbon. This position will be responsible for delivering on all facets of talent acquisition success throughout the organization. We are looking for someone that will seek to deliver an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience and will be a trusted partner to our stakeholders. You can expect to recruit for roles at all levels, for our India and other APAC locations (Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan and Australia).


**Responsibilities**:


* Oversee all talent acquisition logistics, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, interview scheduling, offer decision coordination, and employment documentation.
* Find, engage, and activate passive candidates using alternative search techniques and creative sourcing channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct interviews, and assess candidates against role requirements and organizational fit.
* Build and maintain trust‑based relationships with candidates, ensuring a clear understanding of their expectations, motivations, and concerns.
* Provide a high‑quality candidate experience at every stage of the recruitment process.
* Regularly track and report pipeline activity to internal stakeholders.
* Contribute to a cost‑effective talent acquisition strategy through creative job postings, networking, industry engagement, and partnerships with professional organizations.
* Provide input on employer branding initiatives across digital channels, including social media and targeted campaigns.
* Stay up to date on industry trends, innovative sourcing tools, and best practices; recommend new approaches to enhance global talent acquisition processes.
* Partner with HR team members to ensure all new hires receive a seamless and best‑in‑class onboarding experience.
* Support broader HR initiatives and projects, including those related to diversity, candidate experience, employee engagement, and process optimization.
* Support senior recruiting team members with admin tasks \- scheduling interviews, contracts, hiring documentation.

  


**Qualifications**


* Experience in full‑cycle recruitment, preferably in a fast‑paced or international environment and or Financial Services. Knowledge of the FinTech space a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or another business\-related field
* \+6 years full cycle recruiting experience mainly in technology roles.
* Strong sourcing skills, including experience engaging passive talent.
* Excellent communication and relationship‑building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders with professionalism and urgency.
* Familiarity with ATS system – Greenhouse , sourcing tools (Linkedin Recruiter), and social recruiting platforms.
* Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and committed to delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
* Fluency in the English language – both written and verbal

  



We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday).

title: Case Mgr, MSK [S], MSK
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


This is a contractual role.  

At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one.  

We are working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you’d like to help the Disability Leave Services (DLS) team build a best\-in\-class professional services program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to Amazon employees, applicants, job seekers and candidates globally, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing Disability \& Leave Services Team.  

The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.  

This is an individual contribution (IC) role with no direct reports.  

Essential Responsibilities:  

* Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees
* Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon
* Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and Amazon resources to support oversight of a leave event as appropriate
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
* Address and respond to sensitive situations
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
* Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
* Other duties as assigned
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Do you have 2\+ years of customer service experience, or a Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field?
* Do you have knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word?
* Do you have a Master's degree or above?
* Do you have experience handling confidential information?

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience and knowledge in Six Sigma belts and process improvement initiatives

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

If you’d like to help the Disability Leave Services (DLS) team build a best\-in\-class professional services program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to Amazon employees, applicants, job seekers and candidates globally, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing Disability \& Leave Services Team.  

The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.  

This is an individual contribution (IC) role with no direct reports.  

Essential Responsibilities:  

* Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees
* Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon
* Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and Amazon resources to support oversight of a leave event as appropriate
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
* Address and respond to sensitive situations
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
* Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
* Other duties as assigned

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Do you have 2\+ years of customer service experience, or a Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field?
* Do you have knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word?

* Do you have experience handling confidential information?

* Experience and knowledge in Six Sigma belts and process improvement initiatives

title: Senior Analyst - Talent Acquisition
description:
**Introduction**  


Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.
  

**How you'll make an impact** **Responsibilities**  

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated HR Recruiter to join our Human Resources team. The HR Recruiter will be responsible for managing the full recruitment cycle, from identifying potential candidates to onboarding new hires. This role requires a proactive approach to sourcing, attracting, and hiring top talent to support our business needs and growth objectives.* Collaborate with hiring managers to understand job requirements and develop effective recruitment strategies.
* Source candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media, networking events, and employee referrals.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial interviews to assess candidate qualifications and fit.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and interview panels.
* Maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for future hiring needs.
* Manage the candidate experience to ensure a positive and professional recruitment process.
* Conduct reference checks and background verifications as needed.
* Assist in developing and updating job descriptions and specifications.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in recruitment and talent acquisition.
* Participate in employer branding initiatives to enhance the company's reputation as an employer of choice.
* Support diversity and inclusion efforts in recruitment practices.


  

**About you** **Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a recruiter, preferably in the insurance or financial services industry.
* Strong understanding of recruitment processes and candidate sourcing techniques.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Familiarity with employment laws and regulations.

**Why Join Us:*** Be part of a global leader in insurance and risk management.
* Work in a collaborative and supportive environment.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.


  

**Additional Information**  

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

description:
**Company Profile**



BARE International is a US\-based, global customer experience consulting firm with 39 years of experience. The company set the industry standard as the largest independent provider of customer experience research. BARE International has global coverage with 13 Offices around the world. Our vision is to "inspire excellence" by delivering actionable insights to our clients that strategically impact the improvement of their customer experience.

  

Since 1987, we have built our reputation on innovation, ethics, and seamless client service management. Join BARE for a close\-knit work environment and global entrepreneurial experience!

 **Job Description: Senior Accounts Executive \- Mumbai**

 **Key Role**



Manage end\-to\-end day\-to\-day finance operations, including invoicing, receivables, payables, GST, TDS, routine accounting entries, and month\-end close activities.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Maintain accounting records in Tally Prime, including routine entries in foreign currencies and supporting documentation.
* Manage client E\-invoicing in Tally Prime, Accounts Receivable (AR) follow\-ups, and reconcile payments received; share periodic AR ageing/collection updates.
* Handle day\-to\-day finance communications: respond to client/freelancer emails and resolve evaluator queries.
* Coordinate evaluator/vendor payments and support Accounts Payable activities.
* Perform bank reconciliations (BRS) and periodic ledger reconciliations for customers/vendors.
* Support month\-end closing activities, including provisioning/accrual support and basic MIS as required.
* Handling GST \& TDS compliance (prepare workings/data for filing and maintaining records).
* Filing GST \& TDS return monthly/quarterly.
* Work on internal global operating systems and deliver tasks/data within agreed deadlines; perform other duties assigned by supervisor.
* Assisting in audit work.
* Handling evaluator payments.
* Handling International payments \& recording Interoffice transactions.
* Working on Cash flow report \& generate various internal reports from software for management review.
* Maintain organized and secure financial records.
* Ensure timely completion of tasks and submission of data within agreed deadlines.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor
* Understand and adhere to company policies and procedures, including ISO 27001 Information Security Management System requirements.

  


**Education \& Certifications**


* B.Com / M.Com (Commerce background preferred)

  


**Skills \& Experience**


* 4–5 years of relevant work experience in Accounts/Finance (AR/AP, invoicing, taxation support).
* Minimum 3 years of experience in a senior role as an individual contributor
* Hands\-on experience with bank reconciliation (BRS), ledger scrutiny, and month\-end close support.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel (Pivot, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP) and basic reporting.
* Good communication skills, detailed and accurate
* Knowledge of MS Office \& Tally Prime

  


**Competency Skills**


* Ability to work independently and to schedule time and resources effectively.
* Demonstrated advanced proficiency with MS Office applications, Tally Prime.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Analytical and creative approach to problem solving
* Ability to foster a team spirit, positive attitude towards work, co\-workers, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks at different stages in a deadline\-driven environment.
* Eagerness to learn, optimize costs, and contribute to process automation.

  


**Reporting \& Compensation**



Reports to: Finance Manager – India



Location: Mumbai.



CTC Offered: INR 7 – 8 LPA (with the final offer aligned to the candidate’s last drawn salary within this range)

 **Data Privacy Notice**


*BARE International would like to store your CV in its Bamboo HR Hiring database for 2 years for the purpose to provide you opportunities in case of similar openings within the BARE Group. Your data is handled by HR professionals of BARE International and is kept on servers at North America. Details about the Data handling at BARE can be obtained at BARE’s Privacy Notice at* *http://sh.baidata.com/PNJobApp**. For questions or requests to revoke this consent you can any time contact us on our Data Privacy Webform* *at* *http://sh.baidata.com/PWebForm*

title: Recruiter
description:
**Company:** Recruiting Genie LLP

**Experience:** 2\+ Years  
**Location:** Iconic Corenthum, Sector 62, Noida  
**Working Days \& Timings:** Monday–Saturday \| 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM

**Compensation:** ₹30,000–₹45,000/month \+ performance incentives, depending on experience

**About Recruiting Genie**

Recruiting Genie LLP is a founder\-led People \& Talent Solutions company helping startups and growing businesses **Hire. Access. Build.**

We work with growing organizations across recruitment, RPO, specialist hiring, project\-based talent management, and people \& workplace solutions.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an **experienced Recruiter** who has hands\-on experience working with a **recruitment, staffing, search or executive search firm**.

This is a highly execution\-oriented role. You will work closely with the Founder and the existing team to manage client hiring assignments, build candidate pipelines, engage with candidates, coordinate interviews and drive positions through **offer and joining**.

The right candidate should be able to take ownership of assigned requirements and execute with minimal supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Understand client requirements, JDs, hiring priorities and candidate expectations.

· Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, databases, referrals, networking and other channels.

· Screen candidates through calls and assess their suitability against role requirements.

· Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for assigned positions.

· Submit relevant candidates within agreed timelines and quality expectations.

· Coordinate interviews between candidates and clients/hiring managers.

· Manage candidate and client follow\-ups throughout the recruitment process.

· Drive candidates through the recruitment funnel until **offer and joining**.

· Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, candidate records and pipeline updates.

· Manage multiple vacancies and client requirements simultaneously.

· Develop a strong understanding of candidate availability, compensation trends and market conditions.

· Identify new sourcing channels and build talent pools for recurring requirements.

· Maintain a professional candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

· Communicate effectively with candidates and, when required, clients.

· Support recruitment\-related business development activities when required.

· Contribute ideas to improve RG's recruitment processes, sourcing strategy and delivery model.

**What We Are Looking For**

· **2\+ years of recruitment experience.**

· **Mandatory experience with a recruitment/staffing/search/recruiting firm.**

· Strong hands\-on experience in sourcing, screening and interview coordination.

· Experience handling multiple vacancies simultaneously.

· Good understanding of the complete recruitment lifecycle.

· Comfortable using LinkedIn and recruitment/job portals.

· Strong communication, follow\-up and candidate engagement skills.

· Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned requirements.

· Strong execution orientation and ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.

· Experience working across multiple industries, functions or client organizations will be preferred.

**Who Will Succeed at RG?**

You will be a strong fit if you:

· See **recruitment as a profession**, not just an HR function.

· Can pick up a requirement and start sourcing without constant supervision.

· Are persistent with candidate engagement and follow\-ups.

· Can manage pressure when multiple positions are active.
