title: Sr Manager HR Shared Services
description:
**About Target**  

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. Joining Target means fostering a culture rooted in care, inclusion and respect, while striving to make a meaningful and positive impact. At Target, we value diverse perspectives, encourage authentic relationships and believe every team member’s voice matters.

**Overview of Target in India**  

Target’s success is driven by a timeless purpose and a proven strategy, brought to life by talented teams across the globe. In India, Target operates as a fully integrated part of its global organization, with more than 5,000 team members in Bengaluru supporting enterprise\-wide strategy, technology and operations. Target in India offers an inclusive, learning\-focused environment where innovation, collaboration and people\-first values enable world\-class outcomes.

**About the Team**  

Target Human Resources is recognized for building strong, high\-performing teams that power the guest experience. We bring Target’s distinctive brand to life through continuous innovation, experimentation and evolution. Supporting nearly 400,000 team members across stores, distribution centers and headquarters, HR serves as a strategic partner to leaders and team members alike. Our diverse community of people professionals works behind the scenes to cultivate a progressive culture of respect, reward, growth and opportunity.

**About HR Shared Services**

HR Shared Services is a critical part of Target’s HR ecosystem, serving as a central hub that brings together people, processes, data, and technology to deliver seamless, consistent, and human\-centric HR support at scale. By centralizing, simplifying, and standardizing key HR operations, enabling self\-service, and driving efficiency through automation and digital tools, HR Shared Services empowers team members with timely, accurate support while enabling HR partners and Centers of Excellence to focus on strategic business impact.


As **Sr MANAGER** – HR Shared Services, Pay, Timekeeping and Scheduling Team, you will enable high performance by fostering a reliability\-centered culture and leading critical HR service delivery operations for Target. You will provide strong leadership by attracting and developing talent, enabling continuous learning, strengthening operational capability, and optimizing team effectiveness.


You will play a key leadership role in advancing a reliable, digital\-first, and team\-member\-centered HR Shared Services model. This role requires a leader who can balance strategic thinking with operational discipline, lead through ambiguity, build strong partnerships across HR and business teams, and develop talent for current and future business needs.


As an HR Shared Services Sr. Manager, you will take the lead as you drive:

**Strategy, Service Delivery and Operational Leadership**

* Lead HR Shared Services teams responsible for pay, timekeeping, scheduling, and relevant HR lifecycles, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant service delivery.
* Define and execute strategic and operational priorities that strengthen service quality, productivity, risk management, and team member experience.
* Translate enterprise HR priorities into clear team goals, service expectations, operational plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure core HR processes are delivered on time, within expected service levels, and in alignment with defined policies, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Establish and continuously improve operating routines, performance metrics, process controls, escalation paths, and governance mechanisms.
* Use data, case trends, insights, and operational reporting to identify experience gaps, process risks, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Build strong partnerships with HR leaders, HR COEs, Product, Technology, and other cross\-functional teams to deliver consistent and scalable HR support.
* Lead and support high\-priority initiatives that improve operational efficiency, simplify work, enhance process reliability, and strengthen enterprise HR outcomes.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high\-risk issues, ensuring appropriate judgment, timely resolution, confidentiality, and stakeholder partnership.

**Digital Enablement, Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Champion a digital\-first HR Shared Services experience by strengthening self\-service, knowledge content, automation, and AI\-enabled support pathways where appropriate.
* Identify patterns in inquiries, manual work, repeat contacts, escalations, and process breakdowns, and translate these insights into recommendations for content, workflow, automation, or system enhancements.
* Partner with Product, Technology, and HR stakeholders to support testing, rollout, adoption, and stabilization of new tools, workflows, and system improvements.
* Drive digitization and automation opportunities that improve speed, accuracy, consistency, and scalability while maintaining appropriate controls and human judgment.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by applying structured problem\-solving, process discipline, and data\-informed decision making.
* Ensure new and improved processes are clearly documented, effectively communicated, and consistently adopted across the team.

**Team Leadership and Capability Building**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of HR Shared Services leaders and specialists, creating clarity around priorities, performance expectations, service standards, and ways of working.
* Build a high\-performing, inclusive, and resilient team culture grounded in accountability, learning, adaptability, collaboration, and care.
* Develop talent through coaching, feedback, career development, succession planning, and capability\-building experiences.
* Strengthen team capability in HR operations, digital tools, data interpretation, problem solving, process improvement, stakeholder management, and service excellence.
* Plan and structure resources effectively to meet business priorities, service demand, project needs, and operational commitments.
* Foster strong communication rhythms that ensure alignment, transparency, and clear ownership across the team.
* Inspire creative and critical thinking, encouraging the team to challenge the status quo, solve problems, and continuously improve the team member experience.

**About you:**

* Graduate in any discipline
* 12–15 years of relevant experience in HR operations, payroll, shared services, service delivery, or related business operations.
* 5\+ years of people leadership experience, preferably in HR Shared Services, payroll, high\-volume operations, or digital service environments.
* Experience leading teams through operational transformation, process improvement, digitization, automation, or technology\-enabled change.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, organizational, and prioritization skills.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate, and build trust across functions and leadership levels across geographies.
* Data\-informed and improvement\-oriented, with the ability to translate trends, insights, and metrics into practical action.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a high degree of sensitivity for confidentiality and team member trust.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and adapt to evolving business needs.
* Demonstrates resilience, courage, inclusion, accountability, and a commitment to building strong teams.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**1\. COMPANY OVERVIEW** 





 Established in 1982, Aster Medicines Pvt Ltd is one of East India's leading pharmaceutical manufacturing enterprises, operating an advanced GMP and ISO 9001:2015 certified production facility situated in the Hajipur Industrial Area, Bihar. The company specializes in large\-scale third\-party contract manufacturing and PCD franchise distribution of critical care injectable formulations—including Ceftriaxone, Meropenem, Piperacillin Tazobactam, and dry powder formulations—alongside oral suspensions and specialized baby care products (Aster Baby Oil). Featuring Class 100 sterile cleanrooms, double\-pass RO \+ EDI Water\-for\-Injection (WFI) generation plants, and automated filling lines with a capacity of over 1 Million vials per month, Aster Medicines is powered by a dedicated team of over 75 skilled professionals committed to global pharmacopoeial quality standards (IP/BP/USP).
 




  





**2\. POSITION SUMMARY \& OBJECTIVE** 





 The HR Executive will serve as the operational cornerstone for human resources management at the Hajipur manufacturing plant and corporate office. The role demands an agile, hands\-on HR generalist capable of driving shop\-floor and technical talent recruitment, administering multi\-shift attendance and payroll inputs, maintaining flawless statutory labor compliance, organizing audit\-ready WHO\-GMP personnel training logs, and fostering constructive industrial relations across a 75\+ strong workforce.
 




  





**3\. KEY ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**A. Talent Acquisition \& Manpower Allocation** 




**·** 
**Plant Manpower Planning:** 

 Partner with Plant Managers and Department Heads to assess shift\-wise manpower requisitions (MRFs) and fill staffing voids promptly.
 




**·** 
**End\-to\-End Recruitment:** 

 Lead hiring cycles for machine operators, visual inspection workers, QA/QC chemists, microbiologists, storekeepers, and administrative personnel.
 




**·** 
**Sourcing \& Screening:** 

 Utilize online recruitment portals, local employment exchanges, technical polytechnics/ITI networks, and internal referrals for talent sourcing.
 




**·** 
**Selection \& Onboarding:** 

 Coordinate technical interviews, negotiate offers, verify background documentation, and facilitate day\-one joining formalities.
 




**B. Induction \& WHO\-GMP Training Coordination** 




**·** 
**Structured Plant Induction:** 

 Conduct comprehensive orientation for new employees on plant safety, company policies, code of conduct, and hygiene regulations.
 




**·** 
**GMP \& SOP Training Management:** 

 Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance (QA) and Safety Officers to schedule and document mandatory WHO\-GMP, GLP, and fire\-safety training.
 




**·** 
**Audit Documentation:** 

 Maintain meticulous, up\-to\-date employee training cards, qualification certificates, and competence matrix records for regulatory and customer audits.
 




**C. Statutory Compliances \& Labor Regulations** 




**·** 
**Labor Statute Adherence:** 

 Ensure 100% adherence to the Factories Act, 1948, Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Wages Act, Payment of Gratuity Act, and Bihar State Factory Rules.
 




**·** 
**Portal Filings \& Returns:** 

 Manage monthly calculation, challan generation, and timely online portal submissions for Provident Fund (EPFO), ESIC, and Professional Tax (PT).
 




**·** 
**Statutory Registers Maintenance:** 

 Maintain audit\-ready statutory registers (Muster Roll, Overtime Register, Adult Worker Register, Accident Register, Fines \& Advances Register).
 




**·** 
**Audit Facilitation:** 

 Represent the HR department during labor department inspections, factory inspectorate visits, and third\-party vendor audits.
 




**D. Shift Rostering, Attendance \& Payroll Input Management** 




**·** 
**Biometric Attendance Monitoring:** 

 Administer daily biometric attendance and shift allocations (Morning, Evening, Night, and General shifts) for 150\+ plant personnel.
 




**·** 
**Leave \& Overtime Tracking:** 

 Accurately record daily leaves, late marks, on\-duty (OD) gate passes, and production overtime (OT) in alignment with operational requirements.
 




**·** 
**Payroll Input Compilation:** 

 Reconcile and generate finalized monthly payroll inputs (attendance days, OT hours, deductions, advances) for the Accounts department.
 




**·** 
**Query Resolution:** 

 Disburse monthly pay slips and promptly resolve worker discrepancies regarding wages, attendance, and benefits.
 




**E. Industrial Relations, Plant Welfare \& Employee Engagement** 




**·** 
**Grievance Redressal:** 

 Serve as the first point of contact for employee grievances; maintain positive shop\-floor relations and resolve conflicts proactively.
 




**·** 
**Plant Welfare Amenities:** 

 Oversee worker amenities including canteen hygiene, pure drinking water supplies, restroom sanitation, uniform supply, and safety PPE kit allocation.
 




**·** 
**Separation Formalities:** 

 Conduct professional exit interviews, coordinate clearance handovers, and oversee prompt Full \& Final (F\&F) settlement processing.
 




**·** 
**Engagement Initiatives:** 

 Organize annual health screenings, National Safety Week events, festival celebrations, and employee recognition programs.
 




  





**4\. CANDIDATE SPECIFICATIONS \& QUALIFICATIONS** 




**Education \& Experience Profile** 





 • Qualification: Regular MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, Master of Social Work (MSW), or Post Graduate Diploma in Personnel Management (PGDPM/DLL).
 





 • Relevant Experience: 2 to 5 years of proven HR experience in a manufacturing plant setting, preferably in Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals, Medical Devices, or FMCG.
 





 • Plant Understanding: Sound familiarity with industrial labor dynamics, shop\-floor worker handling, and shift rosters.
 




  





**Technical Skills \& Competencies** 





 • Statutory Expertise: Hands\-on familiarity with EPFO, ESIC online portals, Factories Act documentation, and labor returns.
 





 • Software Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of MS Excel (Formulas, VLOOKUP, Pivots, Attendance templates) and Biometric HRMS tools.
 





 • Communication Skills: Fluent verbal and written command in English and Hindi (spoken Hindi fluency is mandatory for plant operations).
 




  





**5\. COMPENSATION \& WORKPLACE BENEFITS** 




**·** 
**Competitive Salary Package:** 

 Remuneration aligned with candidate qualifications, experience, and pharmaceutical industry benchmarks.
 




**·** 
**Statutory Security:** 

 Mandatory statutory coverage including Employee Provident Fund (PF), ESIC, and Gratuity benefits.
 




**·** 
**Growth Environment:** 

 Direct exposure to WHO\-GMP certified processes and long\-term career progression in an established pharma enterprise.

title: MIS & Business Systems Executive
description:
* **Google Workspace Automation \| Rawatsons Engineers Pvt. Ltd. \| Kolkata**

**About Us**

Rawatsons Engineers Pvt. Ltd. is a Kolkata\-based railway infrastructure construction company. We bid on and execute contracts for Indian zonal railways, RVNL (Rail Vikas Nigam Limited), IRCON, and other leading railway contractors — with work spanning Hbeam bridge sleeper fabrication and installation, foot over bridges (FOBs), girder works, and allied civil/structural contracts across multiple railway divisions.

**About the Role**

We’re building a complete business automation system — an MIS — on Google Workspace, and we’re looking for someone to own it end to end.

This is a high\-ownership role. You’ll sit with people across tendering \& BOQ preparation, project execution, billing, procurement, fabrication yard operations, and site teams to understand exactly how work happens today — then design and build clean, automated systems for it using Google Sheets, Apps Script, AppSheet, and other Google Workspace tools.

You’re expected to use AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude as a core part of your daily work — to write and debug code, and to figure things out whenever you’re stuck. We’re not looking for someone who already knows everything; we’re looking for someone resourceful enough to learn fast with these tools.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Study current workflows across departments — tendering/BOQ, project execution, billing \& accounts, procurement, fabrication \& site operations, HR — by talking directly to the people doing the work.
* Design and build an integrated MIS on Google Workspace: Sheets as the data backbone, Apps Script for automation and backend logic, AppSheet for forms/apps, and dashboards (Looker Studio or Sheets) for management reporting.
* Automate manual, repetitive work — data entry, approvals, reminders, report generation— to cut turnaround time and reduce errors.
* Build and maintain MIS dashboards for leadership covering tender pipeline \& BStrong hands\-on skill with Google Sheets — advanced formulas, QUERY, pivot tables, data validation.OQ status across divisions, project progress, billing/realization status, material and fabrication tracking, and manpower data.
* Actively use ChatGPT/Claude (or similar AI tools) to write, debug, and optimize Apps Script and other code, and to research solutions independently.
* Document every system built (basic SOPs) and train the relevant teams to use it.
* Maintain data integrity and access control across all systems.
* Continuously spot new automation opportunities and pitch them to leadership.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong hands\-on skill with Google Sheets — advanced formulas, QUERY, pivot tables, data validation.
* Working knowledge of Google Apps Script, or strong coding aptitude with a genuine willingness to pick it up fast using AI tools.
* Exposure to Google AppSheet or similar no\-code app builders is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated comfort using AI coding assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) — be ready to show this in the interview.
* Genuine curiosity about how a business actually runs — this is not a purely technical, desk\-bound role.
* Strong analytical thinking and the ability to turn a messy manual process into a clean automated flow.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer applications, commerce, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience (strong freshers with a portfolio of self\-built automations are welcome to apply).

**Good to Have**

* Experience in construction, infrastructure, or other project\-based industries.
* Exposure to Salesforce or other CRM/business systems.
* Familiarity with APIs and integrating Google Workspace with other business tools (accounting software, WhatsApp Business, etc.).
* Basic SQL/database knowledge.

**Practical Details**

* Location: Kolkata (on\-site)
* Employment Type: Full\-time
* Reports To: CEO’s Office / Leadership Team
* Compensation: As per experience, in line with industry standards

**How to Apply**

Send your resume along with any Sheets, Apps Script, or AppSheet work you’ve built before — even a small self\-made automation tells us more than a list of skills

title: Research Scientist- PRD
description:
**Position Description**
------------------------



**Business Division:** PIHS

  

**Department:**

PRD

  

**Location:**



Hyderabad/ Jaipur

  


**Position Title:**

Research Scientist \-PRD

  

**Level:**

Executive (E1\-E4\)

  

**Reporting to (Title):**

Team Lead\- PRD

  


**Position Purpose**
--------------------



The role involves conducting scientific experiments, developing and optimizing chemical processes through laboratory research, and supporting process development initiatives. Responsibilities include literature surveys, identifying synthetic procedures, analyzing experimental data, preparing technical documentation and review presentations, and contributing to SOP adherence and lab upkeep. The position also supports client\-related activities and day\-to\-day technical operations to drive impactful outcomes for the organization’s research goals.

**Strategic Responsibilities**
------------------------------


* Actively imbibing the values and philosophy of PI Health Sciences.
* Contributing effectively to the overall success of Process Chemistry by driving research and team performance in line with the objectives and targets set by the Director and Head of Chemistry.
* Fulfilling requirements as defined by the Group Leader and Team Leader, e.g., within specific research projects.
* Safeguarding intellectual property for PIHS
* Continuously updating oneself on chemistry knowledge through literature, lectures, seminars and conferences to strengthen research outcomes.
* Supporting the Team Leader, with a special focus on target setting, and consistently seeking functional feedback.
**Operational Responsibilities**
--------------------------------


* Work collaboratively with the team to achieve and exceed targets within the framework set by the Group Leader and Team Leader – Process Research.
* Stay updated on the latest developments in synthetic chemistry and process innovation, with a specific focus on innovative process research.
* Maintain continuous documentation and reporting of all research results within the defined area of responsibility, as per SOPs and guidelines.
* Actively seek functional support from the Team Leader when needed.
* Conduct literature searches using available tools (Reaxys, SciFinder, etc.).
* Perform synthetic experiments safely and efficiently, ensuring accurate and complete recording of all procedures and data.
* Provide regular updates to the Team Leader regarding the functional progress and any issues related to the project.
* Participate constructively and actively in all technical and functional meetings of the team.
* Analyze and interpret experimental data effectively.
* Stay well\-versed in reaction mechanisms and their applications.
* Contribute to impurity profiling through evaluation, synthesis, characterization, and control.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of process development and the ability to design safe, robust, and scalable processes based on green chemistry principles.
* Utilize ELN (Electronic Lab Notebook) for documentation and data capture.
* Travel to plant sites for batch execution and scale\-up activities, as required.
* Coordinate closely with cross\-functional teams such as ARD, QA, Safety, and Process Technology.
* Follow ESG policies and ensure compliance in daily operations.
**Financial Responsibilities**
------------------------------


* Work towards achieving the targeted RMC (Raw Material Cost) by optimizing the use of available resources.
**People Responsibilities**
---------------------------


* Support Team members by providing peer feedback Foster an environment of knowledge sharing within the Team Additional Accountabilities:
* Maintain healthy working relationships with the related teams and departments in Process Research
* Responsible for individual safety
**Education Qualification**
---------------------------



Ph.D./M.Sc./ M. Pharmacy in Organic Chemistry / Analytical Chemistry from a reputed University / Institute

**Work Experience**
-------------------


* **E2\-E4**: 2\-8 years of experience in Process R\&D in CDMO domain
* **E1**: Fresher from reputed institute/university
**Industry to be Hired from**
-----------------------------



Preferably Biotechnology /Pharmaceutical/ CRO/ CDMO

**Functional Competencies**
---------------------------


* Chemistry Understanding and knowledge: Detailed Knowledge of reactions and interactions of various functional groups, understanding of functional group interference in chemical transformations and compatibility of reagents with various functional groups, Ability to understand of reaction mechanisms to predict the reaction progress and side reactions
* Process chemistry and Regulatory: Awareness of solvents/ reagents that can be utilized in plant, understanding of process optimization principles and GLP, understanding of CMAs, CPPs and CQAs
* Presentation and documentation: Ability to compile the data for the project by discussing with different scientists involved in the project, preparation of the PPTs with clear objective, project related data, and conclusions
* Software and Application: Ability to use Microsoft office and ELN independently, Ability to use Reaxys/ Scifinder in order to find reagents/ conditions for performing reactions in the lab, Ability to use Chemdraw to prepare the documents
* Process Optimization \& Scale\-Up: Ability to Independently optimize reaction parameters to improve yield, selectivity, and cost\-effectiveness, ability to support scale\-up trials.
* Cross\-Functional \& Client Collaboration: Fosters coordination with cross\-functional teams to enable smooth lab\-to\-plant transfer, shares accurate data for collaborative decisions.
**Interaction Complexity and Team Work**
----------------------------------------



**Interaction**

**Frequency**

  

**Purpose of Interaction**

  


**Internal:**

* Process R\&D chemists, team leads, grp leads and engineers
* CRO, ARD team members
* QA, Safety, and Manufacturing (Plant) teams
* Supply Chain Management (SCM) team
* Project Management (PM) team
* Other cross\-functional support functions (e.g., HR, IT, Admin, Engineering, EHS as applicable)

  


As Required

  


To collaborate on experiment planning, data sharing, compliance, and seamless execution of research and scale\-up activities across functions.

  


**External:**

* Chemical Logistics providers
* Service Engineers

  


As Required

  


To coordinate chemical logistics and equipment maintenance to ensure uninterrupted lab operations and compliance.

title: Data Engineer I (R-19886)
description:
**Shape the Future with Dun \& Bradstreet** 



  



 At Dun \& Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at 
 
 dnb.com/careers
 
 .
 




  





 The Data Engineer I work as part of an agile team supporting the organization's Research and Managed Services. This is a hands\-on, hybrid, technical, and operational role. The team members will actively write and maintain code to build data tools, automations, and pipelines, while also performing day\-to\-day operational tasks that keep Research and Managed Services running reliably. The role includes identifying and evaluating internal and external data sources to feed AI\-enabled and traditional research workflows. The team member will assess source relevance, quality, coverage, accessibility, reliability, compliance considerations, and applicability to defined business and technical use cases. The role drives best\-in\-class standards and continuous improvement and requires an adaptable professional who is willing and able to learn and adopt new technologies as they are introduced to the organization
 




  




**Key Responsibilities:** 
  

**Coding \& Development** 
  

  
* Write, review, test, and maintain code, including SQL and Python, to build data tools, automations, and ingestion and transformation workflows that support Research and Managed Services
  
* Automate manual processes and develop data tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, quality, and throughput
  
* Develop and promote coding standards and contribute to code reviews within the agile team
  
* Build and maintain web\-scraping solutions, API integrations, and reusable data\-processing components
  
* Support scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured data
  


  


**Source Evaluation \& AI Enablement** 



  

  
* Identify prospective sources that can feed AI solutions and Research and Managed Services workflows
  
* Define and apply source\-evaluation criteria covering relevance, authority, freshness, completeness, coverage, consistency, accessibility, legal or licensing constraints, privacy, security, and technical compatibility
  
* Perform source profiling, sample validation, proof\-of\-concept testing, and comparative assessments before recommending onboarding
  
* Document source decisions, metadata, lineage, ownership, limitations, refresh expectations, and approved use cases
  
* Implement and support AI\-enabled workflows using LangChain or equivalent orchestration frameworks, large language models, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, and prompt\-engineering approaches where applicable
  
* Monitor source and AI\-workflow performance and recommend remediation, replacement, or additional sources when quality or coverage falls below requirements
  


  

  


**Operational Tasks** 



  

  
* Perform day\-to\-day operational activities supporting Research and Managed Services, including monitoring, exception handling, data maintenance, and issue resolution
  
* Perform database administration activities, including performance tuning and implementation of best practices
  
* Implement new data\-maintenance processes and provide end\-to\-end process ownership
  
* Ensure data integrity by validating, reconciling, and regularly cleaning data
  
* Investigate and resolve production incidents, pipeline failures, data\-quality issues, and operational exceptions
  
* Follow applicable data governance, security, and operational standards
  


  


**Collaboration \& Continuous Learning** 



  

  
* Evaluate and implement new technology solutions, and proactively learn and adopt new tools, platforms, and methodologies introduced by the organization
  
* Communicate with stakeholders and conduct knowledge\-exchange sessions for technical and non\-technical audiences
  
* Develop and maintain data documentation, including data dictionaries, source assessments, data\-flow diagrams, data mappings, runbooks, and data lineage
  
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across Data \& Analytics, Technology, Research Services, Managed Services, Product, and Data Governance
  
* Additional duties as assigned.
  


  

  


  




**Key Skills:** 
  
* Strong SQL and Python skills, with demonstrated ability to write and maintain code as a core part of daily work
  
* Experience with Playwright, Selenium, and other web\-data collection techniques
  
* Experience developing and supporting data\-ingestion, transformation, and ETL/ELT workflows
  
* Ability to collect and interpret data from multiple sources, including web scraping and GCS/S3, and formats including delimited files, XML, JSON, and PDF
  
* Working knowledge of data systems and databases used to maintain data pipelines
  
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other dashboard tools
  
* Experience managing stakeholders and project plans
  
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  
* Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn new technologies as they are introduced
  
* BigQuery experience and knowledge of AWS and/or GCP
  
* Hands\-on experience implementing AI solutions using LangChain or an equivalent orchestration framework
  
* Exposure large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents, or graph databases
  
* Knowledge of Data Operations methodologies, data management approaches, ServiceNow, and/or Jira
  
* Experience with NoSQL technologies, SQL Server administration, R programming, web technologies, and data mapping from multiple sources.

title: Data Engineer (Audience Intelligence)
description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports \& Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues. We do that by knowing fans best. We work with clients to help them understand \& influence what their fans are doing – the way fans spend their money, the events that fans attend, the channels fans respond to, the content fans watch and more. And we use the understanding this gives us to help our clients grow. Grow their audiences and grow their revenues \- both direct to consumer and business to business revenues. Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1000 people, based out of 15 offices, and we deliver work for sports and entertainment businesses of all shapes and sizes all over the world.
   

  

 We're looking for a talented Data Engineer to join our squad of \>50 Data \& BI Engineers, working on our Fan Intelligence Platform. You will be helping to build the leading data management and analytics platform for the sports industry. In this role, you'll work with cutting\-edge technologies to design, build, and optimize scalable data solutions, enabling teams, leagues, and organizations to unlock the full potential of their data. If you're passionate about data engineering, enjoy collaborating in a fast\-paced environment, and want to make an impact in the sports industry, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Responsibilties**
 Your role will be varied and evolve as quickly as you can learn and develop. Your initial duties will involve:
   

  

* Design, build, and test scalable data platform solutions in Azure, leveraging tools like ADF, Databricks, and Function Apps, using Python.
* Develop high\-quality data products, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and performance across our data pipelines.
* Collaborate closely with product and marketing teams to deliver data\-driven insights and solutions that provide high business value.
* Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and development frameworks, ensuring robust data engineering standards.

description:
**Career Area**

**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

*The Integrated Components \& Solutions (ICD) division owns Caterpillar’s Wear \& Maintenance (W\&M) components business — the ground engaging tools, undercarriage, hose \& coupling, fluids \& filters, and associated hardware that keep the world’s machines running. Our team is building the digital, data, and AI capabilities that make these products easier for customers and dealers to find, buy, use, and get value from.*
 As Data Specialist, Wear \& Maintenance (W\&M), you will help maintain and automate the W\&M data layer that powers our digital and AI capabilities. Supporting the W\&M Digital Solutions team and the W\&M Customer Experience strategy lead — and partnering closely with data owners and engineering teams — you will help build and run the processes that carry W\&M data from parts information, through compatibility, to service options — keeping it complete, accurate, and automated. This is a hands\-on, technical role: you will develop data pipelines and automation, support data analytics, and track data quality so that every downstream digital and AI experience is built on trusted data.
   

  

 You will play a key role in maintaining and improving these data processes, while also supporting the analytics and quality tracking behind smarter customer and dealer experiences.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Maintain and automate the W\&M data layer, and develop the processes that transform W\&M data from parts information, through compatibility, into service options. You will support data analytics and data\-quality tracking across the teams and systems that make up the W\&M digital ecosystem — from the underlying data, to the AI capabilities that use it, to the customer\- and dealer\-facing channels where it all comes together. You will help build, run, and monitor data pipelines and automation — using approaches such as SQL, Python, and AI\-assisted tooling such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) — that keep W\&M part, compatibility, and service\-option data complete, accurate, and trustworthy.
   

  

 You will be a key contributor to the team that owns W\&M domain data quality — helping close gaps, remediate defects, and improve coverage so W\&M offerings surface reliably across VisionLink, Cat Central, SIS2, and the Cat AI Assistant.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Maintain and automate the W\&M data layer — build and run the processes that carry data from parts information, through compatibility, to service options.
* Write and maintain SQL and Python to transform data, build automation, and validate that data\- and AI\-driven processes return accurate, trustworthy results.
* Support data analytics and quality tracking — monitor coverage, completeness, and accuracy, and surface defects for remediation.
* Contribute to and support our core product and component data — helping close gaps, improve accuracy, and ensure high quality, because good data is the foundation of every digital and AI capability. Use AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate data maintenance, classification, and enrichment at scale, with appropriate human review.
* Serve as a W\&M data domain contributor, ensuring data reflects our business needs and how customers and dealers work.
* Communicate data status, quality metrics, and results clearly to stakeholders across functions and geographies.


**What You Will Have**
* Data Management: Working knowledge of the processes, tools, and techniques of data management; ability to maintain the quality, integrity, and accessibility of organizational data across its lifecycle, and integrate data resources for business processes and functional support.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of data and process problems and create alternative solutions that resolve them.
* Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Solid Understanding of the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision and to monitor and improve the quality of organizational data.
* Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques for requirements analysis; ability to elicit, analyze, and document data and process requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
* Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools, and techniques; ability to effectively receive, interpret, and convey data status, quality metrics, and business needs in written and oral communications across many geographies and functional disciplines.


**Considerations For Top Candidates**
* 3\+ years of experience in data management, engineering, or analytics.
* Hands\-on proficiency with SQL and Python for querying, transforming, and automating data workflows.
* Experience with data platforms and pipelines (e.g., Snowflake, SQL, ETL) and comfort turning data into usable, trustworthy results. Ability to build Snowflake database objects (views, tables, stored procedures, etc.).
* General knowledge of Wear \& Maintenance products (ground engaging tools, undercarriage, maintenance parts) is a plus; familiarity with engineering/BOM data is valued.
* Ability to build pipelines that leverage machine learning and/or AI agents to incorporate business logic and ensure data quality and completeness. Interest in and aptitude for AI\-assisted data tooling (e.g., MCP, LLM\-based tools) to accelerate data maintenance and quality.
* Strong attention to detail and a track record of improving data quality, coverage, and consistency.
* Strong communication skills in a collaborative, cross\-functional, cross\-geography environment.


**Additional Details**
* This position requires the candidate to work full\-time at the Caterpillar office in Chennai, India.
* This position may require up to 10% travel.


 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.
   

  

 This position requires working onsite five days a week.
   

  

 Relocation is available for this position.
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**Posting Dates**

+ Collaborate with higher\-level SOC analysts or incident response teams for complex incident analysis.

* Documentation:
+ Maintain detailed records of security incidents, including actions taken, findings, and resolutions.
+ Document standard operating procedures (SOPs) for common incidents and responses.

* Communication:
+ Communicate with the IT team to provide updates on security incidents.
+ Escalate incidents to higher\-level SOC analysts or incident response teams as needed.

* Security Tool Management:
+ Use and manage security tools and technologies to monitor and analyze network traffic, logs, and alerts.
+ Ensure the proper functioning of security tools and report any issues for resolution.

* Vulnerability Management:
+ Assist in the identification and management of vulnerabilities within the organization's systems.
+ Report and escalate vulnerabilities to appropriate teams for remediation.

* Security Awareness:
+ Contribute to security awareness programs helping to educate employees about potential threats and best practices.

* Continuous Learning:
+ Stay informed about the latest cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices.
+ Participate in training and professional development activities to enhance skills.

* Compliance Monitoring:
+ Ensure that security activities align with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
+ Assist in the preparation of reports for compliance purposes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Information Technology, etc.).
* Professional certifications such as Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
* Understanding with SIEM tools.
* Strong understanding of networking protocols, firewalls, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention systems.


**Skills**
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* The ability to react quickly and efficiently under pressure.
* Good communication skills, as regular reporting to the team lead is required.
* Effective partnership and collaboration.
* Knowledge of TCP/IP, computer networking, routing, and switching.
* Understanding and working with Windows and Linux operating systems.


**Work Environment**
 This position may be remote, hybrid, or in\-office, depending on the organization's needs. Familiarity with specific tools and technologies relevant to the SOC environment is preferred.

title: Cloud Security Analyst
description:
**Cloud Security Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research teams to build smarter, safer AI systems — and we need practitioners who truly understand how cloud environments fail in the real world.
   

  

 If you've spent time in the trenches of AWS, GCP, or Azure and you know what a misconfigured IAM policy or an exposed storage bucket actually means for a business, this role was built for you. Your expertise will directly shape how AI reasons about cloud security — making these systems more accurate, more realistic, and more useful.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Analyze cloud security scenarios across AWS, GCP, and Azure to identify risks and realistic failure patterns
* Review IAM configurations, network architectures, storage permissions, and container security setups
* Classify security gaps, misconfigurations, and cloud incidents based on real\-world impact and blast radius
* Validate and improve AI\-generated security reasoning so it reflects how cloud incidents actually unfold
* Help build datasets and evaluations that push the frontier of AI security capabilities


**Who You Are**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience working with cloud environments in production
* Solid understanding of cloud IAM, networking, storage, and container security across major providers
* Familiar with real\-world misconfigurations and how they escalate into incidents
* Able to reason clearly about blast radius, risk exposure, and business impact
* Self\-directed and comfortable working asynchronously on task\-based assignments


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with cloud security tooling (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud, AWS Security Hub)
* Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or incident response
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, or NIST
* Security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CCSP, CISSP, etc.)


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly on frontier AI systems with top research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Meaningful work that improves how AI understands real\-world security
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Security Engineer - SIEM Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Security Engineer \- SIEM Engineer** 




**Location: Kochi, India (Onsite)** 




**Permanent \- Full Time** 




  





**About Us** 




 Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.
 



 Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.
 



 Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.
 



  





  





**Build Your Career with Cyncly in Kochi** 




 Kochi is Cyncly’s newest hub, opening doors to exciting career opportunities across diverse functions. Here, you’ll collaborate with global experts, engage in innovative projects, and grow in a culture that values innovation, flexibility, and continuous learning. With access to top mentors, excellent learning resources, and a flexible and autonomous working environment, you’ll have everything you need to thrive.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Security Engineer specializing in Vulnerability Management, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Cyncly’s digital assets. You will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and managing vulnerabilities across our global infrastructure. Working closely with cross\-functional teams, you will ensure that vulnerabilities are remediated in a timely and effective manner, and that our security posture remains robust against emerging threats. This role offers the opportunity to drive continuous improvement in vulnerability management processes and directly impact the resilience of our digital environment.
 



  





**Key Position Responsibilities Include:** 



* Lead the design, engineering, and ongoing optimization of the SIEM platform across global environments.
* Build and maintain log ingestion pipelines, parsers, connectors, and enrichment logic for both cloud and on‑premises systems.
* Develop and tune detection rules, correlation logic, and analytics aligned to MITRE ATT\&CK and threat intelligence.
* Partner with the Security Operations Center to enhance alert fidelity, reduce noise, and improve mean time to detect (MTTD).
* Drive SIEM data quality initiatives, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and visibility across critical systems.
* Onboard new log sources, ensuring proper parsing, normalization, categorization, and use‑case mapping.
* Lead troubleshooting, root‑cause analysis, and performance improvements within the SIEM platform.
* Build dashboards, visualizations, and reporting models for executives, SOC analysts, and stakeholders.
* Collaborate with cloud, DevOps, and IT teams to integrate SIEM monitoring into new products, services, and infrastructure.
* Stay current with threat landscape changes and ensure detections evolve accordingly.
* Support incident response activities with advanced investigation capabilities and forensic data enrichment.
* Contribute to documentation, playbooks, and engineering runbooks.
* Mentor analysts as the SIEM subject matter expert.



  





**Required Experience and Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in security engineering, SIEM engineering, SOC operations, or detection engineering roles.
* Deep hands‑on experience with SIEM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic, QRadar, or similar).
* Strong understanding of log ingestion, parsing, normalization, and schema design.
* Proven experience building custom detections, analytics rules, and use cases mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Solid understanding of cloud log sources (Azure, AWS, GCP) and API\-based integrations.
* Proficiency with KQL, SPL, SQL, or other query languages used for detection and analytics.
* Experience with automation/orchestration tooling (SOAR) is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with security frameworks including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work cross‑functionally in a global environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, evolving landscape.



  





**Required Skills and Competencies:** 



* SIEM engineering (log pipelines, connectors, ingestion tuning).
* Detection engineering and analytics rule development.
* KQL, SPL, or equivalent query language expertise.
* Deep understanding of MITRE ATT\&CK and threat‑driven detection.
* Ability to evaluate and onboard new log sources.
* Incident response support and investigation experience.
* Dashboarding and data visualization.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to collaborate with global teams.
* Continuous learning mindset and passion for modern security operations.



  





**Working for Us** 




 At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.
 



  





 Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.
 



  





 We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.
 



  





 If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- Come join us.

description:
\*\*Role Title: \*\* Apprentice – Assistant Project Manager


**Tier:** IC10

\*\*Stipend: \*\* INR 21,000 per month


\*\*Duration: \*\* 12 months


\*\*Target Start Date: \*\* 1 October 2026  



**About Pearson**

Pearson is the world’s leading learning company, dedicated to helping people make progress in their lives through learning. Founded in 1844, we deliver digital\-first, accessible learning experiences and employ over 20,000 people globally. In India, we support learners and educators through innovative educational products, technology, and services.


We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable workplace where every employee is valued and empowered to thrive.


**About the Apprenticeship Program**

Pearson India’s Apprenticeship Program provides graduates and early\-career professionals with structured training, hands\-on experience, and mentorship from industry experts. Through a blend of on\-the\-job learning and guided development, apprentices build the professional and technical skills needed to succeed in a global organization.


**About the Division**

The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager for the Higher Education International Division will help to ensure the assembly, execution, and maintenance of major products according to specified objectives—budget, schedule, and adherence to quality standards. The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager is part of the broader team that executes annual plans and organizes and prioritizes tasks and teams to ensure delivery.


**About the Role**

You will work with authors, Pearson Content and Digital Producers, Quality Assurance (QA), Accessibility, Rights and Permissions (R\&P) and vendor partners to deliver stable, high‐quality products to improve learner outcomes and maximize instructor impact. You will also manage production schedules for print and digital assets. This role is ideal for a fresher or early\-career professional who is eager to learn project management, risk assessment and mitigation, and digital product creation in the higher education space.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Content production of selected print, digital, and supplemental content.
* Production of digital courseware content that will be used in both print and digital delivery.
* Maintain legacy data on a vast number of series\-specific titles, including print books and editorial supplements, while at the same time helping to guide the list through the transition to a nextGen digital format.
* Learn how to act as point\-person throughout entire lifecycle process, respond to queries from various stakeholders, serve as knowledge resource for Portfolio team.
* Learn how to provide high\-level management of a large number of primary authors, development editors, technical editors, supplement authors, copyeditors, and freelance project managers. Negotiate rates, prioritize work.
* Learn how to provide communication across cross\-functional teams. Includes initiating launch meetings, serving as meeting moderator, and maintaining status reports.a
* Coordinating and keeping track of budgets in all the projects
* Learn to drive creation of project schedules; enforce adherence; provide accountability charter for delays.
* Serve as liaison with Rights and Permission team; ensure quality of coverage; escalate any schedule delays or budget concerns.
* Identify and manage vendors to schedule, budget, and quality compliance; provide feedback on performance.
* Enforce system maintenance and data integrity of records; oversee invoice processing and reconciliation.
* Support in contributing to cover and internal design process.

**Desirable Skills and Attributes**

* Highly flexible and adaptable, with a positive attitude when operating in an environment of continual flux.
* Ability to think and act independently to seek out resolutions and problem\-solve on a daily basis.
* Ability to influence and negotiate where necessary with peers, project team, sponsors/stakeholders, and other internal teams as needed.
* Ability to respond confidently to conflicts and manage situations positively, proactively escalating ongoing issues and showing solid judgment.
* Demonstrates highly active ownership of projects, possesses ability to proactively assess and mitigate risk, and actively poses solutions to problems.
* Communicates effectively (written and verbally) with peers, project team, and sponsors/stakeholders. Shows strong command of the English language.
* Able to assess and manage across a full project breadth and depth, ensuring a successful delivery of products.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams delivering both digital and print product outputs.
* Diligent attention to detail.
* Strong organization skills: Self\-organizing and self\-motivating.
* Strong time\-management abilities\-organizing tasks in a logical and efficient manner allowing for multitasking and making appropriate calls on prioritization.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
* Recent graduates or candidates with less than one to three years of experience are encouraged to apply.
* Must meet requirements under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and be registered on the NATS portal.
* Must be legally eligible to work in India.

**Experience You Will Gain**

* Practical exposure to Project Management operations, scheduling and budgeting.
* Hands\-on experience in risk assessment and mitigation, and professional communication.
* Experience in creating and sharing schedules using Smartsheets.
* Understanding of how digital learning products are built and created.
* Opportunity to work with Product, Content Solutions, QA, and R\&P teams in a professional business environment.

**Work Schedule**

This is a full\-time apprenticeship from Monday to Friday, approximately 40 hours per week. The role involves working across several geographies and requires occasional flexibility in supporting the business beyond regular office hours.


**Benefits and Rewards**

* Competitive stipend
* Professional development and mentorship
* Paid time off as per company policy
* Personal Accident Insurance Coverage

Access to Pearson’s learning platforms and online courses


* Exposure to global work culture and career pathways

**Location**

This role will be based at Pearson's office in Noida.


**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

Pearson India is committed to building an inclusive environment that embraces diverse perspectives and backgrounds. We value equality, respect, and belonging, ensuring every employee has the opportunity to contribute and grow.


\*\*Application Closing Date: \*\*


This position is offered under the Apprentices Act, 1961, as part of an official Apprenticeship Program. As an apprentice, you will undergo structured on\-the\-job training, combined with theoretical learning where applicable, to develop specific skills and prepare for skilled employment.


**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.


Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E\-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.


If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

The ideal candidate should be able to understand Postola quickly, explain it to customers in very simple language, build confidence in the product and ultimately convert interested leads into paying customers.

Freshers are welcome if they have strong communication skills and a confident personality.

title: Senior Business Development Manager – Upwork
description:
**Company Description**  

We at Prometteur Solutions Pvt. Ltd. are a team of IT experts, who came with a promise of delivering technology\-empowered business solutions. We provide world\-class software and web development services that focus on playing a supportive role to your business and its holistic growth. Our highly\-skilled associates and global delivery capabilities ensure the accessibility and scale to align client's technology solutions with their business needs. Our offerings span the entire IT lifecycle: from Consulting through Packaged, Custom, and Cloud Applications as well as a variety of Infrastructure Services.

 **Job Description**  

You will own Prometteur's entire Upwork channel — bidding strategy, agency profiles, manager


profiles, lead qualification, proposals, calls, closure, and the team that supports it. You will


personally close mid\-to\-high\-ticket projects and lead a small team of junior BDEs/freshers who


handle bidding and lead generation under your direction. You carry both an individual closure


target and a team revenue target. This is a senior, hands\-on, AI\-first role with a clear path into a


Channel Head / Sales Head seat as the team scales.


Important: This is an AI\-first sales role. We expect you to use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and


modern sales\-AI tooling daily — for proposals, lead research, follow\-ups, profile/portfolio


refresh, competitor analysis, and team productivity. Comfort with AI is non\-negotiable.


What You'll Own


Channel \& Profile Ownership

* Run and optimize multiple Upwork agency accounts and manager profiles in parallel —


each tuned to a service line, geography, or client tier.

* Own JSS, response rate, top\-rated / rising\-talent badges, and overall account health


across every profile.

* Build a connects\-allocation strategy across accounts — what bids, how often, at what


price, with which profile.

* Continuously refresh portfolios, case studies, niche specializations, and agency


descriptions to stay first\-page on relevant searches.


Team Leadership

* Lead a team of 2–3 junior BDEs / freshers — set daily and weekly bidding targets,


review every proposal before it goes out, and monitor connect spend.

* Onboard and train freshers on Upwork dynamics, lead qualification, proposal writing,


scoping conversations, and client handling.

* Run daily stand\-ups and weekly 1:1s; track each BDE's pipeline, win rate, and proposal


quality.

* Build the team's playbook — proposal templates per service line, qualification checklists,


follow\-up cadences, objection handling.


Sales Execution

* Personally close mid\-to\-high\-ticket projects in IT services — web, mobile, custom


software, SaaS, cloud, AI — across global clients.

* Run discovery calls on Zoom with founders and decision\-makers; scope, structure, and


close commercial proposals.

* Coordinate with the delivery / tech team for SOWs, estimations, and pre\-sales technical


scoping.

* Negotiate commercials, payment terms, and milestone structures.


Pipeline, CRM \& Reporting

* Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene in HubSpot — every active lead logged, deal stage


updated, next step set.

* Hit personal monthly closure target AND team\-level monthly revenue target.
* Report weekly to leadership on closures, pipeline health, win/loss reasons, and team


performance.

* Spot trends in the Upwork market — verticals, project sizes, geographies, price points


that are converting — and tune team strategy accordingly.


AI\-Powered Workflow

* Use ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini daily for proposal drafting, personalization, lead and


company research, follow\-ups, and rejection\-recovery messages.

* Build and maintain reusable AI prompt libraries for the team — proposal templates by


service line, discovery\-call prep, scope clarifications, objection handling.

* Use AI for portfolio and case\-study refresh, profile/agency description optimization, and


SEO\-friendly Upwork copy.

* Deploy AI for competitive intel — analyze who's winning similar jobs, at what price, with


what positioning, and feed insights back into bidding.

* Train freshers to bid faster and smarter with AI — without sacrificing quality,


personalization, or compliance with Upwork ToS.

* Continuously evaluate new sales\-AI tooling (Clay, Apollo, Lavender, etc.) and roll in what


works.


Must\-Haves

* 3\+ years of hands\-on selling on Upwork with verifiable closures in IT services


(non\-iGaming).

* Has handled multiple Upwork agency accounts and manager profiles simultaneously —


knows how to run them without crossover or policy issues.

* Proven team\-management experience — has led or mentored at least 1–2 BDEs /


bidders, with clear ownership of their output and targets.

* Deep working knowledge of Upwork: JSS, profile rank, connects, agency vs. freelancer


accounts, badges, boosting, dispute handling, ToS boundaries.

* Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools — ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini — for proposals,


research, and follow\-ups. Anyone not using AI in their workflow is not a fit.

* Strong written English — proposal writing should be a competitive advantage; AI is your


amplifier, not your crutch.

* Confident on discovery calls and negotiations with international clients.
* CRM discipline — HubSpot, Zoho, or equivalent — and comfort with outreach / tracking


tooling.

* Self\-driven, structured, target\-oriented; willing to be on\-site in Surat.


Nice\-to\-Haves

* Experience on additional freelance platforms — Codeur, Contra, Toptal, Freelancer.
* Background selling custom software, mobile apps, AI, or cloud / DevOps services.
* Built or maintained a personal AI prompt library / workflow for sales tasks.
* Hiring experience — has helped recruit and ramp junior BDEs.


What You Get

* Full ownership of one of Prometteur's strongest acquisition channels from Day 1\.
* Team to lead from the start — no waiting to earn the leadership track.
* Performance incentive tied to both your closures and your team's output.
* Clear growth path into Channel Head / Sales Head as the team scales.

 0\-1 Experience
 



 24x7 Support
 



 Chennai
 



  




* Provide first\-level technical support to internal and external customers through phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems.

description:
**Company Name**:The Akanksha Foundation.

**Overview Of the Company:**

The Akanksha Foundation is a non\-profit organization with a mission to provide children from low\-income communities with a high\-quality education, enabling them to maximize their potential and transform their lives. Akanksha works primarily in the field of education, addressing formal education by initiating school reform through its School Project. Currently, Akanksha reaches out to the 13000\+ children through its 26 schools in Mumbai, Pune and Nagpur.

**Position:** Primary Teacher (Marathi)

**Compensation**: Rs. 33,000/\- to Rs. 36,000/\-

**Reports to:** School Leader

**Position Summary**: As an Akanksha teacher, you will be directly responsible for at least 30 kids in a class. Your role will be to guide the students towards academic achievement while inculcating self\-esteem and values in their curriculum that will empower them to think critically and make informed choices in their life. You will cultivate an environment of high achievement coupled with fun learning in the classrooms. You will build strong bonds with children to understand each child’s needs and work with parents as partners in their child’s education and future. Overview of the Team: The Akanksha Schools aim to be high\-quality schools serving children from low\-income communities in Mumbai and Pune. These schools work in partnership with local municipalities, with the vision of creating small clusters of model schools in these cities that can be used to impact the mainstream education system. The School Team comprises teachers, social workers, school administrator and helpers led by the School Leader.

**What your role will entail:**

● Teaching the Akanksha curriculum through effective pedagogical practices

● Designing and executing lesson plans that will engage students

● Designing assessments that thoughtfully evaluate student progress

● Varying teaching strategies and styles to meet different learning needs

● Providing a positive environment to engage students in the learning process

● Establishing and maintaining a cooperative working relationships with students, parents, community and the school team

● Clearly articulating high expectations for students

● Creating and maintaining an aesthetically positive environment

● Actively participating in network opportunities for professional development

● Attending and participating in all school training and meetings

● Meeting professional obligations through efficient work habits

● Actively participating in all extra\-curricular and celebratory activities in school

● Making occasional community visits to stay connected with parents

**What you need for this Position Experience:**

● Candidates with relevant teaching experience are preferred but freshers may also be considered

**Knowledge/Skills:**

● Strong content knowledge and expertise

● Love for children and learning

● Adaptability to new instructional approaches

● Patience and capacity to solve problems

● Good planning and organizing skills

● Strong team player

● Self\-motivated with strong work ethics to achieve school goals

● Openness to feedback and critical reflection

● Strong oral and written communication skills in English

**Education:**

Primary (Grade 1\- 7\)

● Graduate \+ B.Ed/D.Ed \+ CTET/TET is mandatory

title: Backend Engineer, Clinical AI
description:
**OutcomesAI** 
 is a healthcare technology company building an AI\-enabled nursing platform designed to augment clinical teams, automate routine workflows, and safely scale nursing capacity.
   

  

 Our solution combines AI voice agents and licensed nurses to handle patient communication, symptom triage, remote monitoring, and post\-acute care — reducing administrative burden and enabling clinicians to focus on direct patient care.
   

  

**Our core product suite includes:**
* Glia Voice Agents – multimodal conversational agents capable of answering patient calls, triaging symptoms using evidence\-based protocols (e.g., Schmitt\-Thompson), scheduling visits, and delivering education and follow\-ups
* Glia Productivity Agents – AI copilots for nurses that automate charting, scribing, and clinical decision support by integrating directly into EHR systems such as Epic and Athena
* AI\-Enabled Nursing Services – a hybrid care delivery model where AI and licensed nurses work together to deliver virtual triage, remote patient monitoring, and specialty patient support programs (e.g., oncology, dementia, dialysis)


 Our AI infrastructure leverages multimodal foundation models — incorporating speech recognition (ASR), natural language understanding, and text\-to\-speech (TTS) — fine\-tuned for healthcare environments to ensure safety, empathy, and clinical accuracy. All models operate within a HIPAA\-compliant and SOC 2–certified framework. OutcomesAI partners with leading health systems and virtual care organizations to deploy and validate these capabilities at scale. Our goal is to create the world’s first
 **AI \+ nurse hybrid workforce** 
 , improving access, safety, and efficiency across the continuum of care.
   

  

**The Role**
 This sits across backend, platform and AI engineering. Three kinds of work, and you would not do them in equal measure — the balance follows what you are good at and what you want to get better at.
   

  

  

* Backend and data. Multi\-tenant services and APIs in TypeScript or python over MongoDB. Clinical content modelling: identity, deduplication, versioning, audit
* The authoring platform. The tools clinical operations staff use to read and configure triage behaviour — including making genuinely complex logic reviewable by people who are clinicians, not engineers
* The triage engine. The real\-time Python service that runs the calls. Open to you as far as your curiosity takes you


**The part people find interesting**
**A real\-time clinical voice agent that cannot be allowed to improvise.**
 The engine is a hybrid: a deterministic decision graph over clinical content, wrapped in LLM work that has to stay on a leash. Language models handle understanding — extracting facts from what a caller said, classifying answers, screening every turn for life\-threatening cues. The clinical decision itself stays deterministic.
   

  

 The engineering problems that come with that are the good ones: sub\-second latency budgets, what to do when a model call times out mid\-call, how a safety screen fails open without failing silently, and how you evaluate any of it against recorded sessions rather than vibes.
   

  

 Most engineers here start on the platform side and move toward the engine as they pick up the domain. That learning curve — clinical triage content, real\-time voice, LLM orchestration under safety constraints — is the main reason to take this job over a similar one somewhere else.
   

  

 You do not need to have built this before. You do need to want to.
   

  

**What We Look For**
* Strong TypeScript skills with working proficiency in Python. You should be comfortable reading, understanding, and working across the codebase, even when you are not directly modifying every component
* Sound data modelling and schema design judgement. You understand concepts such as identity, versioning, natural keys, stable identifiers, and how data\-model decisions affect long\-term system behaviour
* A verification\-first mindset. When determining how the system behaves, you validate it through the implementation, data, or evidence rather than relying on assumptions. This is especially important in clinical systems, where incorrect conclusions can have significant consequences
* Ability to communicate clearly with non\-engineering users. Product labels, explanations, and system behaviour should be understandable to clinicians and operational teams. If the interface can be easily misunderstood, we consider that a product issue rather than a training issue
* Transparency about scope and trade\-offs. Priorities change and scope may need to be reduced. We value engineers who clearly communicate what was completed, what was deferred, and any resulting implications


**Technical Stack**
* TypeScript (Strict Mode)
* Node.js \& Express
* MongoDB
* Python
* LLM Orchestration
* Real\-Time Voice Systems
* Vite
* Vitest
* AWS


**This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If**
* You are primarily looking for a greenfield environment. Much of the work involves evolving and strengthening an existing system that users already depend on
* You prioritize feature volume over system correctness. We value getting critical boundaries, interfaces, and behaviours right rather than maximizing the number of features shipped
* You want to focus primarily on model development. This role is more about building the reliable system around AI models—especially how the product behaves when a model is uncertain, inconsistent, or wrong


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
