title: Manager / Assistant Manager — Quality Control & Quality Assurance (Rice Industry)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Manager / Assistant Manager — Quality Control \& Quality Assurance**

*Majestic Basmati Rice Pvt Ltd.*

**Department:** Quality Assurance \& Quality Control\- Rice Industry

**Function:** Quality / Food Safety

**Location:** Bhopal

**Reporting To:** Director of Company

**Experience:** 2–5\+ Years (Freshers can also apply in internship is done in Rice Industry)

**1\. Job Summary**

Own product quality, food safety, regulatory and export compliance, and customer specification adherence across the value chain — from raw\-material procurement through processing, milling, packaging, storage, and dispatch. The role covers Basmati Rice quality parameters, lab testing, quality systems, export requirements, third\-party/customer audits, CAPA, and continuous improvement, working closely with Procurement, Production, Milling, Packaging, Warehouse, Export, and Commercial teams.

**2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Quality Control — Raw Material, Process \& Finished Product**

* Monitor and control quality across procurement, inward receipt, processing, milling, packaging, storage, and dispatch.
* Sample and inspect raw paddy, raw rice, semi\-finished and finished rice, packaging materials, and export consignments; conduct physical, chemical, sensory, and applicable microbiological analysis.
* Verify compliance against internal, customer, statutory, and export specifications.
* Manage segregation, identification, quarantine, release, rejection, and disposition of non\-conforming material; act on process deviations promptly.

**3\. Basmati Rice Quality Parameters**

Monitor and document: grain length, breadth, and L/B ratio; broken %, head rice % / recovery; moisture, foreign matter, paddy admixture; chalky, damaged/discoloured, immature, and red grains and other defects; milling yield and recovery; purity and varietal integrity; aroma, colour, appearance, uniformity, cleanliness; cooking characteristics and elongation; and other customer/destination\-country specifications.

**4\. Export Quality, Compliance, Audits \& InspectionExport Quality Requirements**

* Track country\-specific import requirements for served markets; ensure compliance with customer/export specs for physical, chemical, and microbiological parameters, pesticide/residue, heavy metals, mycotoxins/aflatoxins, food safety, packaging/labelling, and shelf\-life/storage.
* Ensure adherence to FSSAI, Codex, importing\-country regulations, and customer/statutory standards.
* Maintain approved specifications per export customer/market and align them with purchase orders and contracts, coordinating with Export/Commercial before production and dispatch.

**Export Inspection \& Pre\-Shipment Inspection**

* Coordinate pre\-shipment inspection with customers, third\-party agencies, surveyors, certifiers, and labs, per applicable protocols.
* Prepare export and retention samples; verify inspection reports and resolve deviations before shipment; ensure external lab testing and final quality clearance for dispatch.
* Ensure timely, accurate COA, test/inspection reports, declarations, and other export documents; investigate and resolve inspection failures or rejections.

**Export Audits \& Customer Audits**

* Coordinate and participate in customer, food safety, certification, buyer, regulatory, surveillance, and supplier/compliance audits.
* Prepare the plant, lab, documentation, and personnel for scheduled and surprise audits; ensure timely closure of observations.
* Prepare and track CAPA against audit findings to verified closure; maintain an audit calendar and address recurring observations with preventive controls.

**5\. Laboratory \& Quality Equipment Management**

* Operate, maintain, calibrate, and document QC lab equipment: moisture meter/analyzer, rice grain analyzer, grain length \& breadth equipment, rice grader, weighing/analytical balances, sieve/grain\-size equipment, dehuller/lab rice sheller, lab or mini rice mill, milling and head\-rice\-recovery/yield analysis equipment, kernel dimension/image analysis, colour measurement system, chalky\-grain/defect analyzer, and hot air oven (reference\-method moisture).
* Coordinate pesticide/residue and other specialised testing through approved external laboratories.
* Ensure calibration/verification per schedule; maintain certificates, history, and maintenance records; restrict use to trained personnel.
* Set testing methods and acceptance criteria; investigate abnormal results; maintain reference standards where applicable.
* Coordinate servicing/breakdown resolution, lab housekeeping/5S/safety, and evaluate new equipment needs.

**6\. Quality Assurance \& Food Safety Systems**

* Develop, implement, and maintain QA procedures, SOPs, work instructions, and quality manuals.
* Implement and monitor HACCP, GMP, GHP, ISO 22000, BRCGS, FSSAI, customer\-specific systems, and export\-market requirements.
* Monitor hygiene, sanitation, pest control, environmental controls, and food safety practices; conduct internal quality/hygiene/warehouse audits and close findings.
* Maintain quality, food safety, traceability, testing, inspection, and compliance documentation.

**7\. Customer Complaints, NCR \& CAPA**

* Investigate complaints on grain quality, appearance, aroma, moisture, broken %, packaging, foreign matter, pest infestation, cooking quality, chemical/microbiological parameters, and other concerns.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis, raise NCRs, and implement effective CAPA; track closure, verify effectiveness, and control repeat complaints.

**8\. Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Procurement — raw\-material specs and supplier quality; Production/Milling — process quality and deviations; Packaging — material and packing\-quality requirements.
* Warehouse — storage hygiene, pest control, FIFO/FEFO, and preservation; Export/Commercial — customer specs, inspections, and shipment clearance; external labs and inspection agencies as needed.
* Act as quality gatekeeper for raw\-material, process, and finished\-product release.

**9\. Training \& Team Management**

* Lead and supervise QC/QA personnel and ensure adequate coverage across shifts.
* Train staff on product specifications, sampling/testing, GMP/GHP, food safety, hygiene, SOPs, export requirements, and customer specifications.
* Maintain training records and evaluate effectiveness.

**10\. Required Qualification**

B.Tech/B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology, Food Science, Agriculture, related field. Certification in HACCP, Food Safety, ISO 22000, BRCGS, Quality Management, or Internal Auditor is an advantage.

**11\. Experience**

2–5\+ years in Quality Control/Assurance, preferably in Rice, Basmati Rice, Grain Processing, Flour Mills, Food Processing, FMCG, or Agricultural Commodities, ideally with an export\-oriented organization. Experience with customer, certification, regulatory, and third\-party audits, and exposure to export inspections and international customer specifications, is strongly preferred.

**12\. Required Technical Skills**

* QC/QA principles; Basmati Rice quality parameters, grading, and milling yield
* Laboratory testing, sampling, inspection, and product release
* Export quality requirements and customer/third\-party inspection procedures
* Food Safety Management Systems: HACCP / GMP / GHP, ISO 22000 / BRCGS, FSSAI
* Audit management; CAPA / RCA / NCR; traceability and recall systems
* Laboratory equipment and calibration; quality documentation and reporting; supplier quality management

title: Senior Telecaller
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONTravel Telecaller – B2B Lead Generation

**Company:** DreamTrawell  
**Department:** Business Development  
**Location:** Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reporting To:** Business Development Manager / Director

About DreamTrawell

DreamTrawell is a growing Destination Management Company (DMC) specialising in domestic and international travel solutions. We work with travel agents, tour operators, corporate clients and individual travellers to provide customised packages, competitive rates and end\-to\-end travel solutions.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and experienced **Travel Telecaller – B2B Lead Generation** who will be responsible for connecting with travel agents, generating enquiries, building relationships and creating a strong pipeline of business opportunities for DreamTrawell.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. B2B Travel Agent Calling

* Make daily outbound calls to **travel agents, travel agencies, tour operators and travel consultants**.
* Introduce DreamTrawell and explain our destinations, packages, services and business proposition.
* Establish contact with new travel agents and identify potential business opportunities.
* Understand the agent's preferred destinations, customer profile and business requirements.
* Maintain regular communication with existing travel\-agent partners.
* Inform agents about new packages, special offers, destinations and promotional activities.

2\. Lead Generation

* Generate qualified **B2B travel enquiries** through outbound calling.
* Identify agents who have active or upcoming travel requirements.
* Generate leads for domestic and international destinations.
* Qualify leads based on:
* Destination
* Travel dates
* Number of passengers
* Budget
* Type of traveller
* Package requirement
* Pass qualified leads to the Business Development/Sales team for further conversion.
* Maintain a healthy and updated lead pipeline.

3\. Agent Relationship Management

* Build a strong database of travel agents and continuously expand the network.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with agents who have shown interest.
* Develop professional and long\-term relationships with agents over the phone.
* Understand agent requirements and coordinate internally to provide timely responses.
* Ensure regular follow\-up on quotations and pending enquiries.
* Reactivate inactive agents and generate fresh enquiries from the existing database.

4\. Coordination With Sales \& Operations Team

* Coordinate with the Business Development team regarding leads generated.
* Share complete and accurate lead information with the concerned sales executive.
* Coordinate with the operations team wherever required for destination/package information.
* Follow up internally on quotations and ensure timely communication to agents.
* Maintain proper records of all enquiries and their status.

5\. Database \& Reporting

Maintain an updated database containing:

* Agent Name
* Company Name
* Contact Person
* Mobile Number
* City/Location
* Preferred Destinations
* Previous Enquiries
* Current Requirements
* Follow\-up Date
* Lead Status
* Booking Status

Submit **daily/weekly calling and lead\-generation reports** to the reporting manager.

DAILY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

The candidate will be expected to maintain consistent calling activity, including:

* **50–80 outbound calls per day** to travel agents.
* Generate a defined number of **qualified leads every day**.
* Regular follow\-up on existing leads.
* Maintain accurate CRM/Excel/Google Sheet records.
* Ensure every qualified lead is properly handed over to the sales team.
* Reactivate inactive agents on a regular basis.

*Targets may be revised based on the candidate's experience and business requirements.*

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Performance will primarily be measured on:

Calling

* Number of calls made
* Number of agents contacted
* Number of meaningful conversations

Lead Generation

* Qualified B2B leads generated
* New active agents identified
* Destination\-wise enquiries generated
* Conversion of leads into quotations

Follow\-Up

* Follow\-ups completed
* Response rate from agents
* Reactivation of inactive agents

Business

* Enquiries converted into bookings
* Revenue generated from leads
* Number of active agents contributing enquiries

CANDIDATE PROFILEExperience

* **1–3 years of experience** in a travel company, DMC, travel agency, tour operator or hospitality industry.
* Prior experience in **B2B travel\-agent calling** will be preferred.
* Candidates who have previously handled travel\-agent databases and outbound calling will be given preference.
* Freshers may be considered if they have excellent communication skills and a strong interest in the travel industry.

Required Skills

* Excellent Hindi and English communication skills.

**Reporting To:** CEO / Business Head

**ABOUT AVANEXA TECHNOLOGIES**

Avanexa Technologies is a Guinness Record\-holding, award\-winning digital solutions company based in Coimbatore, with offices in Bengaluru, Australia, and the USA. For over 20 years, we have partnered with 1,500\+ businesses globally — delivering web design \& development, mobile application development, cloud \& DevOps, digital marketing, UI/UX design, e\-commerce platforms, marketplace listing, and outsourcing services. With an 87% repeat business rate and a portfolio spanning startups to enterprises, Avanexa is the growth partner businesses trust.

We are expanding our Business Development team to deepen our reach across Western Tamil Nadu. If  
you are a driven sales professional who thrives on building relationships, closing deals, and making a measurable impact — we want to meet you.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

As a Business Development Executive (Fresher) at Avanexa, you will be trained to support the full sales cycle — from prospecting and pipeline development to assisting in proposal delivery and account growth — across Coimbatore, Salem, Erode, and The Nilgiris. Working under the guidance of senior leadership, you will represent our complete service portfolio including web development, mobile apps, digital marketing, and cloud solutions, targeting SMBs and regional businesses.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Supporting New Business Acquisition**

* Learn to identify, prospect, and qualify new B2B leads across target industries like SMBs, Education, and Manufacturing.
* Assist in managing a sales pipeline through field visits, cold outreach, and participating in industry events.
* Support discovery calls and site visits; learn to deliver product presentations and live demos of Avanexa’s offerings.
* Assist in preparing commercial quotations and drafting responses to RFPs or tenders.
* Learn negotiation techniques and how to manage objections professionally to help close deals.

**Account Management \& Growth**

* Nurture and grow existing client accounts through proactive check\-ins, quarterly reviews, and
* value\-driven conversations.
* Drive upselling and cross\-selling across Avanexa’s service lines (e.g., SEO for existing web clients, mobile apps for website clients).
* Ensure timely contract renewals and high client satisfaction; escalate delivery concerns to internal teams promptly.
* Act as the primary relationship owner for your accounts, coordinating internally with delivery, design, and marketing teams.

**Collections \& Financial Hygiene**

* Follow up on outstanding invoices and Accounts Receivable (AR) in coordination with the finance team.
* Ensure adherence to agreed payment milestones; resolve disputes diplomatically while protecting business interests.
* Maintain accurate records of invoices, payment timelines, and credit terms per client.

**Reporting, Task Management \& Market Intelligence**

* Maintain up\-to\-date records in Asana covering all client interactions, pipeline stages, follow\-up tasks, and deal notes.
* Submit accurate weekly/monthly MIS reports — pipeline health, conversion rates, revenue booked, and collection status.
* Track competitor offerings, pricing trends, and regional market shifts; share actionable intelligence with leadership.
* Plan and execute territory coverage schedules efficiently to maximize client touchpoints.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Experience \& Track Record**

* Fresher with a strong interest in B2B technology sales and a high potential for growth in a fast\-paced environment.
* Eagerness to learn the sales process and a demonstrable drive to achieve results. ● Prior exposure to selling to SMBs, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, or manufacturing businesses is a strong advantage.
* Experience managing AR, collections follow\-ups, invoicing processes, and credit terms negotiation.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Outstanding verbal and written communication in Tamil and English; proficiency in additional regional languages is a bonus.
* Strong consultative selling skills — ability to understand client problems and map them to Avanexa’s solutions.
* Confident presenter: comfortable conducting demos, delivering proposals, and leading commercial negotiations independently.
* High degree of self\-motivation, ownership mindset, and resilience in field sales environments.
* Proficiency with Asana for task and pipeline tracking; comfort with MS Office / Google Workspace.
* Strong market knowledge of Coimbatore, Salem, Erode, and The Nilgiris business ecosystems is preferred.

**Logistics \& Availability**

* Willingness to travel extensively within the region; valid driving license and personal two\-wheeler or four\-wheeler preferred.
* Ability to operate independently in the field with minimal daily supervision.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, IT, Marketing, or a related discipline. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Sales/Marketing is an advantage, not a barrier.

**HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED**

* Monthly and quarterly revenue targets — new business won vs. plan.
* Pipeline health — active opportunities, conversion rate, average deal size, and deal velocity. Accounts Receivable — DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) within agreed thresholds. Renewal and upsell rate across managed accounts.
* Asana hygiene score — completeness and accuracy of task records and pipeline notes. Net Promoter Score (NPS) / client satisfaction feedback from your accounts.

**WHY JOIN AVANEXA?**

* Work with a Guinness Record\-holding company with 20\+ years of legacy and a globally active client base across India, Australia, and the USA.
* Represent a full\-stack service portfolio — no single\-product limitation. Sell websites, apps, cloud, digital marketing, and more.
* Performance\-linked incentive structure that rewards closers and relationship\-builders equally. Collaborative, high\-energy team culture with direct access to leadership and fast decision\-making.
* Clear growth path into Senior BDE, Team Lead, and Regional Sales Manager roles as the team scales.
* Coimbatore headquarters with a growing regional footprint — be part of the core team that shapes the Western Tamil Nadu market.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your updated resume to hr@avanexa.com with the subject line:

“BDE Application – \[Your Name] – \[City]”

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 5 working days for an initial screening call.

**For queries:** \+919566381777 \| www. avanexa.com/careers

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 As an Associate Product Manager (APM), you will operate at the intersection of customers, engineering, and business stakeholders—translating complex, real\-world user problems into clear, structured product requirements that development teams can implement. You report directly to the Director of Product and will collaborate closely with engineering, client\-facing teams, and internal stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements. Your main goal is clarity: producing well\-structured PRDs, user stories, and documentation that eliminate ambiguity. This role is ideal for someone who thinks rigorously, writes precisely, and thrives in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Requirements \& Documentation
   

  

* Translate user problems, pains, and requirements into well\-structured product requirement documents (PRDs) that guide engineering development.
* Write clear, structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation for both internal and external audiences.
* Gather input from multiple stakeholders — customers, internal teams, and market signals — into actionable documentation that supports product development and decision\-making.
* Create and maintain product documentation to keep it current as features and workflows change.


 Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Team Managers, Engineering, and client\-facing teams to gather, analyze, and document product requirements.
* Facilitate requirement discussions and workshops to identify the right questions and bring clarity to ambiguous problem statements.
* Act as a coordination layer between product, engineering, and business teams—ensuring everyone shares a common understanding.


 Analysis \& Market Intelligence
   

  

* Contribute to market and competitive intelligence efforts by monitoring industry trends, competitor capabilities, and changing customer use cases.
* Analyze customer feedback, support data, and usage patterns to spot gaps, friction points, and opportunities.
* Assist the Sr. PMs in assessing feature ideas and prioritization decisions through thorough analysis and documentation.


**Who We’re Looking For**
 We hire for four traits above all else. The rest is downstream of these.
   

  

* Clarity in communication: You can take a complex problem and explain it to engineering, sales, and senior stakeholders in a way that each of them can act on. Your documentation is brief, precise, and clear.
* Confident and coachable: You’re comfortable saying “I don’t know” and “I was wrong.” You stand your ground when you have evidence and update your view when the evidence suggests otherwise.
* Applied thinking: You analyze user problems thoroughly before jumping to solutions. You work backward from what the user is trying to achieve and notice the secondary questions others overlook.
* Fast learner: You quickly acquire new skills, explore unfamiliar areas, respond to feedback, and figure things out. You don’t wait for instructions on what to do next.


**Qualification \& Requirements**
* 1–3 years of experience in a product, business analysis, consulting, or a related role in a B2B or SaaS environment.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving skills — you can break down ambiguous problems and clarify them.
* Excellent written communication — your documentation is clear, precise, and easy to understand without a meeting to explain it.
* Proven ability to synthesize inputs from various sources into coherent, actionable documentation.
* Comfort working closely with engineering teams — you don’t need to write code, but you should understand how software systems function.
* Attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. A genuine curiosity about how products work and how users actually experience them.


**Tools \& Technical Skills**
* Familiar with product and project management tools like Jira, Confluence, Notion, or similar.
* Comfortable working with data — able to read reports, interpret usage metrics, and identify key insights.
* Experience creating user stories, PRDs, or functional specs is a plus. Exposure to AI or SaaS products is beneficial but not required.
* Basic understanding of APIs or data flows is useful; you don’t need to be technical, but you should have a curiosity about technology.

title: Associate Product Manager - Nek
description:
**About Us** 





  
 


 Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life\-changing. Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru\-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future. 
 




  
 


 Today, 20 million\+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. We are one of the leaders in UPI autopay transactions, crossing more than 1 million transactions per day. In 2023, we expanded our vision with Nek, our jewelry brand crafted to bring together luxury and affordability, it has since surpassed ₹100 crore in revenue.  
 




  
 


 We have a big dream of bringing “Har Ghar Sona”. Small, consistent savings are just the start. We’re here to walk alongside our users, helping Indians secure their financial future every step of the way. 
 




  
 


 Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million\+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.
 







 And this is just the beginning!
   



  
 



**What’s the role?**



  
 


 As an Associate Product Manager at Nek by Jar, you will own the platform and internal systems that power Nek’s day\-to\-day operations. This includes our internal Order Management / CRM tools and key third\-party integrations such as Unicommerce, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and other operational partners.
 







 You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Data, and external partners to improve these systems, resolve gaps, and support new product initiatives. You will also be expected to build a strong understanding of Nek’s overall architecture, services, integrations, and data flows so that you can evaluate the impact of new features across the platform.
   



  
 



**What will be your responsibilities?**
  
 


* *Platform \& Internal Tools*
	+ Own Nek’s internal Order Management / CRM platform and other operational tools used by Customer Support and Operations teams.
	+ Identify product and process gaps and drive improvements that make internal systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.
	+ Understand the end\-to\-end order lifecycle across inventory, payments, logistics, communication, and post\-order journeys.


* *Integrations \& Architecture*
	+ Act as the Product POC for integrations such as Unicommerce, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and other logistics or operational partners.
	+ Own integration requirements, feature enablement, partner coordination, and issue resolution.
	+ Develop a working understanding of APIs, services, dependencies, data flows, failure scenarios, and reconciliation across the platform.
	+ Evaluate and onboard new third\-party platforms as business requirements evolve.


  
 * *Data \& Experimentation*
	+ Use product and operational data to identify problems, validate hypotheses, and prioritise opportunities.
	+ Analyse funnels, user behaviour, operational metrics, and feature performance using tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, SQL, and dashboards.
	+ Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, define success metrics, and recommend whether initiatives should be scaled, iterated, or stopped.


  
 * *Execution*
	+ Work cross\-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Data, Design, and Business teams to take initiatives from problem identification to launch.
	+ Translate business and operational problems into clear product requirements and scalable solutions.
	+ Monitor outcomes after launch and drive subsequent improvements.


  
 
**What’s required from you?**
  
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline from a reputed institute.
* 1–3 years of experience in Product, Growth, Product Analytics, or a similar role in a fast\-paced, data\-driven environment.
* Strong analytical skills and hands\-on familiarity with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Clevertap, SQL, or similar platforms.
* Good understanding of A/B testing, funnels, metrics, and data\-driven product decision\-making.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to prioritise effectively and work across multiple teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Prior experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, D2C, or order/logistics\-heavy products is preferred.


  
 
**What do we stand for?**
  
 





 The five values that we live by :
 




  
 


**Passion:** 
 At Jar, we strive to create an environment where people love what they do, are motivated and equipped to do their best work. 
 







**Equality:** 
 We bring diverse skills, ideas, and experiences to the table, supporting and challenging each other across teams to create something bigger than ourselves. 
 







**Growth:** 
 When our people grow, Jar grows. We create opportunities for learning, development, and meaningful impact. 
 







**Accountability:** 
 The core of our work ethic is taking ownership of our work, showing initiative, and having the freedom to ask questions. 
 







**Consistency:** 
 We believe in doing the right things consistently. Big change doesn’t happen overnight, it’s built one step at a time.
 




  
 


 Join us and let’s build something amazing together!   
 





  



**What employee benefits do we have?** 





  
 


 Glad you asked! Among other things, we have
 




  
 * Medical Insurance for employees and their families
* Employee Wellbeing Program
* ESOPs allocation
* Pluxee meal card
* Swish club card for exclusive employee discounts
* Advance salary plans
* Relocation assistance
* L\&D programmes

title: Associate - ENR (Capital Projects) CoE
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change\-makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. Expert Client Delivery (ECD) is an integral unit of BCN. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, and Bain intellectual property.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This is an opportunity to be part of Bain’s Capital Projects Center of Expertise (CoE), based out of the Gurugram office, specifically supporting Bain’s Capital Projects \& Infrastructure practice on live cases, client development and proposal support. The Capital Projects CoE works across major capital programs spanning energy, infrastructure, transport, oil \& gas, power \& utilities, mining and large industrial build\-outs.
   

  

 As part of the Capital Projects team, you will get exposed to case delivery and client development activities for clients executing large, complex capital programs. The primary objective is to collaborate with practice and case teams on the development and deployment of project\-controls, PMO and digital capabilities that answer strategic questions for Bain’s capital\-intensive clients — from project setup and assurance through delivery and turnaround.
   

  

 An Associate works as a team member / contributor on BCN cases, driving the analysis on complex cases with some direction from a Project Leader and occasionally leading simple cases independently. In addition, Associates help mentor and coach Analysts by providing regular guidance / feedback and progressively take on greater ownership of workstreams.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Day\-to\-day management of 2\-3 team members
* Lead a small team of Analysts and Jr. Associates, owning day\-to\-day delivery with limited PL/Manager oversight
* Understand and translate the client's context and business problem into a clear, prioritized work plan
* Create the work plan, provide guidance to junior team members, and review outputs to ensure high\-quality delivery to clients
* Anticipate roadblocks, resolve them at source, and escalate early when needed
* Program governance \& PMO operations
* Design and stand up PMO operating models — stage\-gate governance, change control, RACI, decision logs, escalation paths — and assess the robustness of a client's existing setup
* Build and interrogate the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS): run critical\-path, what\-if, and schedule\-compression analyses that underpin recommendations
* Cost \& performance controls
* Build cost\-control and Earned Value analyses (budget phasing, CPI/SPI, forecast\-at\-completion, variance) to pinpoint where a program is over budget or behind schedule
* Create executive\-ready dashboards that give client leadership a decision\-grade view of project health
* Risk \& safety management
* Build the analytical backbone for risk reviews — risk registers, quantified mitigations, contingency strategies — and turn findings into recommendations the team can land with the client
* Digital \& advanced analytics
* Shape the digital roadmap and success metrics for client programs, including 5D BIM (cost \+ schedule) and model\-based quantity management
* Apply advanced scheduling and risk analytics — constraint\-based planning, scenario simulation, Monte Carlo — to quantify outcomes and de\-risk recommendations
* Build Power BI / Tableau control towers and pilot AI tools that speed delivery and leave the client with reusable assets


**About You**
* Relevant experience of 2\-5 years for undergraduates and 0\-3 years for postgraduates from a top\-tier college with a strong academic record and 3\-4 years of relevant experience in capital projects, project controls, PMO or management consulting
* PMP® certification or active progress toward it is an advantage (not mandatory at this level)
* Hands\-on with at least 2–3 of: Project controls, P6/MS Project, Power BI/Tableau, BIM (Navisworks/Revit/Synchro), EVM, ALICE – Generative Scheduling, AI tools
* Strong analytical, MS Office, communication, problem\-solving, and team\-player skills; able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. title: Spatial Reasoning Evaluation Specialist (VIDEO RL)
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 A fast\-scaling AI research and evaluation lab in the Generative AI \& Spatial Reasoning domain, we build and benchmark next\-gen video\-based reinforcement learning (RL) agents that perceive, plan, and act in 3D environments. Our work powers real\-world embodied AI applications—from robotics navigation to autonomous systems—by rigorously testing how models understand spatial relationships, motion logic, and scene dynamics from video input. We’re hiring a Spatial Reasoning Evaluation Specialist to design, execute, and scale high\-fidelity human\-in\-the\-loop evaluations for video RL models.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Design and implement standardized evaluation protocols to assess spatial reasoning performance of video RL agents across tasks like path planning, object interaction, and scene navigation.
* Annotate, curate, and label video datasets to create ground\-truth benchmarks for agent evaluation, with emphasis on temporal\-spatial consistency and action causality.

* Build and maintain evaluation dashboards to track agent performance trends, score distributions, and spatial reasoning drift over time.

* Video annotation tools (e.g., CVAT, Labelbox)
* Spatial reasoning task design
* Human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation frameworks

* Python scripting for data validation \& reporting
* 3D scene understanding (e.g., coordinate frames, depth maps, camera poses)
* Preferred
* Experience with embodied AI platforms (e.g., Habitat, AI2 Thor, Unity ML\-Agents)
* Familiarity with RLlib or RL frameworks for agent benchmarking
* Background in cognitive science or psychophysics of spatial reasoning


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* Work directly with cutting\-edge video RL models shaping the future of embodied AI.
* On\-site innovation lab environment in India with access to high\-end annotation tools and compute infrastructure.

 **find candidates and drive the hiring process yourself**

 We are looking for someone who can think:

**About HighLevel:**
 HighLevel is an AI\-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150\+ countries, fueling community\-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
   

  

 To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
   

  

 Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2\.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250\+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long\-term scalability.
   

  

**Our People**
 With over 2,000 team members across 10\+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote\-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
   

  

**Our Impact**
 Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1\.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
   

  

 Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts .
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented
 **People Operations Apprentice**

**Analytics \& Reporting**
* Analyze employee helpdesk metrics, including ticket volumes, categories, SLA performance, and resolution times.
* Track onboarding, offboarding, leave, and attendance metrics and assist with periodic reporting.
* Support the preparation of ad hoc reports, dashboards, and data insights for the People Operations team.


**Compliance \& Employee Lifecycle Support**
* Maintain employee records and validate mandatory documentation to support compliance and audit readiness.
* Audit pending onboarding and offboarding activities and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion.
* Support recurring People Operations compliance and validation activities.


**Process Documentation \& Knowledge Management**
* Create and maintain quick\-reference guides, checklists, FAQs, and process documentation.
* Keep People Operations knowledge repositories and shared documentation organized and up to date.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize People Operations processes.


**HR Operations \& Data Management**
* Support employee benefits renewal and related operational activities.
* Assist with HR data clean\-up, validation, and reconciliation across Darwinbox and other HR systems.
* Validate employee information, including bank account and payroll\-related data, to maintain data accuracy.
* Support People Operations projects and process improvement initiatives as required.


**Coordination \& Administrative Support**
* Maintain trackers and follow up on action items to support timely completion of People Operations activities.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders across People Operations, Payroll, IT, and other teams as required.
* Provide day\-to\-day operational and administrative support to the People Operations team.


**Requirements**
* Bachelors degree
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, and reports
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills
* Ability to handle employee information with confidentiality and discretion
* Willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned responsibilities
* Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams and stakeholders
* Interest in building a career in Human Resources or People Operations
* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets would be an advantage

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title: Manager – Organization and Workforce Transformation**
**Business Unit: People Consulting**
**The Opportunity**
 At EY, we help clients reimagine the future of work and transform their organizations to drive strategic growth and improved employee experience. As a Manager – Organization and Workforce Transformation within our People Consulting team, you will lead and deliver large\-scale transformation initiatives across Workforce Strategy, and Talent Management solutions.
   

  

 In this role, you will collaborate with senior client stakeholders to design and implement integrated solutions spanning Talent Management Framework, Total Rewards, Leadership Development, Strategic Workforce Planning, and HR analytics. You will play a key role in translating business strategy into actionable workforce and HR interventions that deliver measurable impact.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Organization and Workforce Transformation engagements, focusing on people strategy and Talent Management frameworks including competency management, Career Framework, succession planning etc.
* Deliver Total Rewards solutions, including job evaluation, compensation benchmarking, and benefits strategy design.
* Deliver leadership assessment and development programs, including 360\-degree assessments and targeted capability\-building initiatives.
* Lead Strategic Workforce Planning projects, including demand\-supply analysis, scenario planning, and workforce optimization strategies.
* Leverage HR analytics to generate data\-driven insights, enabling informed decision\-making and improved workforce outcomes.
* Facilitate client workshops and stakeholder sessions to drive alignment, co\-create solutions, and support transformation adoption.
* Develop thought leadership, point\-of\-view (PoV) content, and reusable tools/assets to strengthen capabilities and support client solutioning.
* Stay informed on emerging HR trends, tools, and leading practices to enhance solution design and delivery.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Strong understanding of Organization and Workforce Transformation, including People strategy, Workforce planning and Talent Management practices.
* Expertise in Total Rewards, including Job Evaluation, Compensation Benchmarking, and benefits strategy.
* Experience in psychometric assessments, competency frameworks, and talent assessment methodologies.
* Proficiency in HR analytics, workforce planning, and data\-driven decision\-making approaches.
* Excellent project management skills, with experience managing multiple workstreams and meeting timelines.


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have:**
* 10\+ years of experience in HR consulting, organization and workforce transformation, or related advisory roles.
* Proven experience in leading enterprise\-wide Talent Management initiatives.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Prosci, CIPD, SHRM, or psychometric assessment certifications) are an advantage.
* Experience in professional services or global consulting environments is preferred.


**Who We Are**
 At EY, we support you in achieving your unique potential wherever you are in the world \- both personally and professionally. We give you stretching and rewarding experiences that keep you motivated, working in an atmosphere of integrity and teaming with some of the world's most successful companies. And while we encourage you to take personal responsibility for your career, we support you in your professional development in every way we can. You enjoy the flexibility to devote time to what matters to you, in your business and personal life. At EY, we know it's your point of view, energy and enthusiasm that make the difference. For more information, please visit: www.ey.com.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Factory HR & Admin
description:
**Position Summary** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Factory HR \& Admin Manager** 
 to manage end\-to\-end HR and administrative operations for our Bengaluru manufacturing facility.
 



 The role will be responsible for workforce planning, recruitment, employee relations, contract labour management, attendance and payroll coordination, statutory compliance, employee engagement, factory administration, security, housekeeping, transport, canteen, facilities, and overall employee discipline.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in
 **factory HR, industrial relations, contract labour management, statutory compliance, and administration** 
 , preferably within FMCG, manufacturing, personal care, or similar industries.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




1. Factory HR Operations



  





 · Manage end\-to\-end HR operations for the Bengaluru factory.
 



 · Partner with the Factory Head and functional managers on manpower planning and workforce requirements.
 



 · Manage recruitment, onboarding, transfers, promotions, confirmation, and employee lifecycle processes.
 



 · Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation.
 



 · Ensure effective implementation of company HR policies and processes at the factory.
 



 · Monitor attendance, shifts, overtime, leave, and employee discipline.
 



  





**2\. Manpower Planning \& Recruitment** 




 · Plan manpower requirements based on production plans and business requirements.
 



 · Coordinate recruitment for permanent, temporary, and contract workforce.
 



 · Maintain adequate staffing levels across production, quality, maintenance, warehouse, and support functions.
 



 · Build and maintain local recruitment channels to ensure timely availability of manpower.
 



 · Monitor manpower productivity and absenteeism.
 



  





**3\.Contract Labour Management** 




 · Manage third\-party manpower agencies and contract labour.
 



 · Ensure proper deployment of contract manpower as per approved requirements.
 



 · Verify contractor documentation, attendance, wages, and statutory compliances.
 



 · Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws relating to contract workers.
 



 · Monitor contractor performance, productivity, and workforce discipline.
 



 · Resolve grievances and operational issues related to contract labour.
   





 4\.
 **Statutory Compliance \& Industrial Relations** 




 · Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and factory\-related statutory requirements.
 



 · Coordinate PF, ESIC, PT, labour welfare, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, and other applicable compliances.
 



 · Maintain statutory registers, records, notices, and documentation.
 



 · Coordinate with labour authorities and government departments whenever required.
 



 · Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, absenteeism, and misconduct cases.
 



 · Maintain healthy industrial relations and a positive work environment.
 



 · Support factory audits, inspections, and statutory assessments.
 



  





 5\.
 **Payroll \& Attendance Management** 




 · Ensure accurate attendance and shift data for payroll processing.
 



 · Coordinate with the central HR/payroll team for monthly payroll inputs.
 



 · Monitor overtime, incentives, deductions, leave, and attendance irregularities.
 



 · Ensure timely resolution of payroll\-related employee queries.
 



 · Verify contract labour wage and attendance records.
 



  





 6
 **.Employee Engagement \& Welfare** 




 · Drive employee engagement initiatives at the factory.
 



 · Organise employee welfare activities, celebrations, recognition programs, and communication initiatives.
 



 · Address employee concerns and ensure timely grievance resolution.
 



 · Support employee development, training, and capability\-building initiatives.
 



 · Promote a positive and disciplined workplace culture.
 



  





**7\.Factory Administration** 




 · Oversee day\-to\-day administrative operations of the factory.
 



 · Manage housekeeping, security, canteen, transportation, uniforms, PPE, and other employee facilities.
 



 · Ensure adequate infrastructure and workplace facilities for employees.
 



 · Manage administrative vendors and service providers.
 



 · Monitor facility\-related costs and ensure expenses remain within approved budgets.
 



 · Ensure proper maintenance of administrative records and documentation.
   





**8\.Security \& Safety Coordination** 




 · Manage factory security operations and security agencies.
 



 · Ensure proper access control and visitor management.
 



 · Coordinate with the EHS/Safety team to ensure employees follow safety protocols.
 



 · Support implementation of safety awareness and emergency preparedness programs.
 



 · Assist in incident reporting and corrective\-action processes.
   





**9\.HR MIS \&. Reporting** 




 · Prepare and maintain regular HR and factory administration MIS.
 



 · Track headcount, absenteeism, attrition, overtime, manpower cost, contract labour, and recruitment status.
 



 · Monitor HR KPIs and identify areas requiring corrective action.
 



 · Present HR and administration reports to the Factory Head and senior management.
   





**10\.HR Policy \& Process Implementation** 




 · Ensure consistent implementation of company HR policies at the factory.
 



 · Develop and improve factory\-level HR processes and SOPs.
 



 · Identify opportunities to improve employee productivity, retention, discipline, and engagement.
 



 · Act as the key HR point of contact for factory employees and management.
   





**Key KRAs/KPIs** 




 · Manpower availability and fulfilment
 



 · Employee absenteeism and attrition
 



 · Contract labour compliance
 



 · PF / ESIC / statutory compliance
 



 · Payroll and attendance accuracy
 



 · Recruitment turnaround time
 



 · Employee grievance resolution
 



 · Employee engagement and retention
 



 · Manpower productivity
 



 · Overtime and manpower cost control
 



 · Factory administration cost within budget
 



 · Security, housekeeping and facility management
 



 · Labour relations and disciplinary management
 



 · HR audit compliance
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 · Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Labour Relations, or a related field.
 



 · MBA/PGDM in HR or an equivalent qualification will be preferred.
 



**· 8–12 years of HR experience** 
 , with significant experience in factory/manufacturing HR.
 



 · Strong hands\-on experience in industrial HR and employee relations.
 



 · Experience managing contract labour and manpower agencies.
 



 · Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
 



 · Experience in payroll, attendance, recruitment, and HR operations.
 



 · Strong administration and vendor\-management skills.
 



 · Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving abilities.
 



 · Strong MS Excel and HR MIS skills.
   





**Preferred Industry Experience** 




 Experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:
 



 · FMCG
 



 · Beauty \& Personal Care
 



 · Cosmetics / Soap Manufacturing
 



 · Manufacturing
 



 · D2C / Consumer Products
 



 · E\-commerce fulfilment / warehouse operations
   





**Ideal candidate** 




 The ideal candidate should be a
 **hands\-on Factory HR professional** 
 who can independently manage HR and administration for a manufacturing facility, build strong employee and contractor relationships, ensure labour\-law compliance, maintain discipline, and work closely with the Factory Head to support smooth and efficient plant operations.

title: Employee Relations Manager
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in\-line cloud security platform.
   

  

 We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
   

  

**Role**
 We are looking for an Employee Relations Manager to join our team. This is a Hybrid Role role based out of Bangalore, reporting to the Global Director, Employee Relations in the People and Culture department. In this role you will plan, develop, implement and promote activities and programs that enhance overall employee engagement, communication and employee relations while overseeing the compliance of company employment policies and practices with relevant employment regulations.You will also be supporting the foundational scale of our global cloud security leadership, you will advise leadership, resolve complex workplace matters, and promote an equitable workplace culture across the region.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**
* Provide expert advice, counsel, and resolution to employees and managers on complex and sensitive concerns across multiple regions, including India
* Lead, investigate, and conduct formal reviews and report outs regarding claims of harassment, discrimination, retaliation, workplace concerns and other issues to reach conclusion and present findings for further action and proposed remediation
* Maintain an organized case management system while running analytics, producing dashboards, and interpreting data to offer actionable recommendations on global employee relations trends
* Develop and implement programs and training to enhance managerial capabilities, foster a positive workplace culture, and mitigate risk across diverse, international teams
* Partner with HR leaders, business managers, and global stakeholders to establish best practices that balance compliance, equity, and business needs


**Who You Are (Success Profile)**
* You lead with integrity by holding yourself and others to high standards of accountability and building trust through consistent, transparent action.
* You are a high\-trust collaborator who embraces candid feedback and clear communication as the truest form of teamwork.
* You are a problem\-solver who is energized by finding solutions to complex workplace challenges to deliver meaningful organizational impact.
* You are data\-driven, using analytics and metrics to measure what matters, uncover trends, and guide strategic decision\-making.
* You think at scale, connecting day\-to\-day resolution efforts with long\-term company growth and global best practices.


**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**
* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem\-solving
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Employee Relations, or a related field
* 8\+ years of overall HR experience with a minimum of 5\+ years in Employee Relations, including supporting global or regional teams across multiple countries
* Solid understanding of federal, state, and international labor and employment laws and regulations, with a specific emphasis on compliance in the APAC region
* Demonstrated success developing and executing employee relations programs that have a measurable impact on outcomes across global teams


**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Previous experience in the tech industry or similar fast\-paced environments
* Proven ability to analyze data metrics to drive organizational decision\-making and provide region\-specific insights
* Proficiency in navigating employee relations dynamics in multiple countries within the region


 At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with.  Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

title: Talent Acquisition Manager - Lucknow
description:
**Job Purpose**
 To act as a Unit TA SPOC for a region/city within a state/s located in the zone.
   

  

**Job Context \& Major Challenges**
 Organizational Context
   

  

 ABC Digital has been incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital in 2023 to engage in distribution of Aditya Birla Capital products and providing services to customers, including web\-based services, e\-commerce, and payments facilities and allied activities.
   

  

 ABC Digital is developing an omni\-channel based D2C platform (website and app) to acquire new customers and serve them seamlessly. In addition, ABC Digital has started a virtual engagement management through inbound and outbound calling. Also, ABC Digital is engaged in cross\-selling different ABC products to walk\-in branch customers.
   

  

 ABC Digital is collaborating with all ABCL subsidiaries to deliver a truly personalized and seamless omni\-channel experience for both new and existing customers by building capacity and enhancing productivity through investments in talent, technology, marketing, and data and analytics.
   

  

 Job Context
   

  

 With a large customer base within ABC, there is an opportunity to cross\-sell and upsell our products at an individual level. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering insurance and investment partners as extensions of wealth advisers. ABCDL will not only leverage this large customer base for cross selling opportunities but will also tap into the large Indian population through new age distribution channels for acquiring new customers and cross selling and up selling to them as well as servicing new and old customers. To make this happen, Talent Acquisition Managers will have to ensure continuous supply and retention of talent in the organization across functions/ hierarchies. Their responsibilities will include determining current staffing needs, developing talent acquisition strategies, leading employment branding initiatives, sourcing candidates for open positions, conducting recruitment processes, ensuring positive candidate experiences, and assisting in employee retention and development. They will also participate in career fairs and events, and use metrics to analyze recruitment data and identify areas for improvement.
   

  

 Enabling skill sets \& qualifications: \-
   

  

 Proven experience as talent acquisition manager
   

  

 Experience in full\-cycle recruiting, sourcing and employment branding
   

  

 Understanding of all selection methods and techniques
   

  

 Proficient in the use of social media and job boards
   

  

 Willingness to understand the duties and competencies of different roles
   

  

 Working knowledge of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and databases
   

  

 Excellent communicator
   

  

 Well\-organized
   

  

 A leader and strategic thinker
   

  

 BSc/BA in business administration, human resources or relevant field
   

  

 Key challenges for the role:\-
   

  

 Coordinate with hiring managers to proactively identify staffing needs with forecasting.
   

  

 Source potential candidates through online channels (e.g., social platforms and professional networks)
   

  

 Plan interview and selection procedures, including screening calls, assessments and in\-person interviews as per the role requirements.
   

  

 Assess candidate information, including resumes and contact details, using the organizational applicant Tracking system.
   

  

**Design Job Descriptions That Reflect Each Positions Requirements.**
 Facilitate employer branding initiatives from a Talent Acquisition perspective.
   

  

 Organize and attend job fairs and recruitment events
   

  

 Forecast quarterly and annual hiring needs by Line of Business.
   

  

 Foster long\-term relationships with past applicants and potential candidates
   

  

**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** 
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
 KRA1 Manpower Availability \&
   

  

 Source Mix Works closely with ABC business units HR team to ensure 100% adherence to Manpower Budget vs Actual.
   

  

 Optimize Hiring Source Mix as per the agreed grid
   

  

 KRA2 Quality Of Hire To adhere to the Infant Attrition grid along with agreed Diversity Hires as a % of overall HC budget.
   

  

 KRA3 Offer TAT (Hygiene) To adhere to TAT for sourcing till offer release with onboarding
   

  

 KRA4 HR Compliance (Process Adherence) Ensures effective documentation at the zone of all important personnel documentation such as joining formalities in a timely and accurate manner with the help of the HR Business partners in the business units.
   

  

 Adherence to TAT and FTR for all key recruitment processes

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**About the job** 




 We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior HR Manager to lead and manage our people operations for our organization. This role is pivotal in driving HR strategy, managing talent, conducting performance appraisals, and ensuring a positive employee experience across the organization. You will work closely with senior leadership, manage the full employee lifecycle, and play a key role in building and maintaining a high\-performing, engaged workforce. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on organizational culture, employee development, and business success.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment and talent acquisition, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and selection of candidates to meet organizational needs
* Design and execute comprehensive onboarding and induction programs for new employees
* Manage and maintain accurate employee records, attendance, leave management, and employee database systems
* Lead performance appraisal process: design, implement, and facilitate annual and mid\-cycle performance reviews across the organization
* Provide coaching and guidance to managers on performance management, goal\-setting, and employee development
* Oversee compensation and benefits administration, including payroll coordination, statutory compliance, and benefits management
* Manage employee relations, handle grievances, and resolve workplace conflicts with a fair and objective approach
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, statutory requirements, and organizational HR policies
* Design and coordinate employee engagement initiatives to foster a positive organizational culture
* Develop and implement training and development programs to support employee growth and skill enhancement
* Prepare HR analytics and reports for leadership, providing insights on HR metrics and organizational trends
* Build and maintain positive relationships with employees at all levels and serve as a trusted HR partner to management



  





**Requirements** 



* 2\-4 years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in a senior or supervisory role
* Strong expertise in recruitment, employee relations, performance management, and compliance
* Experience managing 100\+ employee organizations or similar scale
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (MBA in HR/Business preferred)
* In\-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws, compliance, payroll, and statutory requirements
* Proficiency in HR Management Systems (HRIS); experience with Zoho People, ADP, or similar platforms is highly desirable
* Advanced proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and handle sensitive, confidential information with discretion
* Strategic mindset with the ability to align HR initiatives with business objectives

title: Employee Relations Lead
description:
**Company Introduction :**
 Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and related services, provided to customers and partners in over 220 countries and territories through six primary consumer\-facing brands \- Booking.com, KAYAK, priceline, agoda.com, and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.
   

  

**Job Overview :**
 Booking Holdings India is a Center of Excellence (COE) based in Bangalore, India and was created to support the increasing business demands of Booking Holdings Inc. and its Brands. The COE is a key enabler of Booking Holdings Inc.’s global talent strategy for several technology functions such as Cybersecurity, Fraud monitoring/analytics, IT, and others across our Brand subsidiaries.
   

  

 The COE is looking for a seasoned Employee Relations professional with deep expertise in labour laws and Labour Compliance to support the COE Senior Legal Counsel (Legal \& Compliance) in overseeing the COE’s adherence to local laws and regulations, handling employee relations matters in partnership with the People team, implementing Compliance \& Ethics program initiatives at the COE, and to provide the People Team support as needed in Policy drafting and reviews.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities :**
 Together with the Senior Legal Counsel, Legal \& Compliance and India People Lead, lead the employee relations activities:
   

  

* Employee Relations:


 (i) Act as the primary point of contact to receive all the Employee Relation Matters reported within India COE,
   

  

 (ii) Handle employee grievance and take end to end ownership of conducting a due diligence on the matters received, reporting and summarizing the issues and recommending corrective actions on the matters and tracking them to closure,
   

  

 (iii) Maintaining a comprehensive dashboard to ensure we have visibility of all such issues reported, (iv) share a quarterly dashboard and also lead org wide initiatives to drive corrective actions.
   

  

* Labour Law Compliance


 (i) Lead all the statutory (non \- payroll related) compliances
   

  

 (ii) Monitor and supervise the compliance filings managed by external consultants and ensure that the company is compliant with its regulatory filings (e.g Shops and Establishment Act, CLRA, Minimum Wages, EPF, Gratuity.)
   

  

 (iii) Monitor regulatory changes and ensure timely implementation s (e.g Menstrual Leave and New Labor Code) and program manage them to closure.
   

  

 (iii)Together with the Senior Legal Counsel, Legal \& Compliance and India People Lead, lead and own the policies mandated by the Shops and Establishment Act, the Contract Labor Regulations Act and/ or driven by the work environment and drive compliance of the policy (For e.g. Contingent Worker policy, Working in Shifts or On \- Call, Hybrid Work arrangements policy, Creche/ Day care etc.)
   

  

 (iv) Support internal and external compliance audits
   

  

* Governance \& Risk Management


 (i) Track and report on the Compliance KPI with BH Compliance teams and regularly drive compliance on the timely completion of compliance training. Track and report the issues with Compliance Trainings.
   

  

 (ii) Drive rigor around topics such as Ethics Ambassador, Prevention of Sexual Harassment committee and Global Ethics Day etc. Track, analyse and report data on PIPs, successful and unsuccessful, and Probation non confirmation cases. Maintain a repository of all the relevant documents in one folder and ensure that we are following the right procedures and controls on this.
   

  

 (iii) Conduct onboarding/ awareness sessions for new hires on Legal and Compliance obligations for new hires.
   

  

 (iv) Drive regular updates on policies and reviews with the People, Legal and Finance team to ensure that policies are updated and compliant with the latest regulations etc.
   

  

**Qualifications :**
* 8–10 years of work experience ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations (including the Prevention of Sexual Harassment Act (“POSH”) and employment/labor), advising on employee relations matters and assisting with fact finding through witness interviews and memoranda drafting, and implementing compliance and ethics programs
* A bachelor’s degree in human resources, or a related field.
* A master’s degree (e.g., MBA in HR, Master’s in HR/IR) or especially valuable for handling complex employee issues, investigations, and labour compliance.
* Fluency in English and ability to work and communicate directly in English.
* Ability to articulate complex matters to the COE management team.
* Strong writing and editing skills and solid organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* This is an independent contributor role that involves close collaboration with both India\-based and international stakeholders, as well as functional teams. Therefore, the ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse functions, backgrounds, and locations to influence perspectives and build consensus is essential.
* Ability to comfortably work with both audiences within and outside the Legal department and across all levels in the organization.
* Ability to engage with employees and hold fact\-finding conversations in the context of employee relations matters independently.


**Other Skills**
* International experience: Self\-awareness of communication style and cultural differences.
* Experience with employee matters and responsibilities.
* Consultative style: Ability to formulate and articulate a perspective and present it in a manner that generates understanding and alignment.
* Self\-motivated and capable of operating independently with limited oversight. Strong sense of personal accountability for work tasks.
* Comfortable acting in a role both as individual contributor and influencer.
* Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and a fast\-paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Assertive, intellectually curious, and self\-starter personality


**Pre\-Employment Screening**
*If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre\-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre\-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.*

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 At Opus, we grow together. Our team of bold thinkers and passionate doers is united by a shared mission to tackle meaningful challenges. Our culture of trust and belonging has earned us the Great Place to Work certification in four countries, based entirely on team feedback. It reflects our commitment to fairness, pride credibility and camaraderie, and reinforces what we believe: when people feel valued, they do their best work.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The HR Manager will own employee relations and performance management across India (Mumbai), the Philippines (Manila), and South Africa (Cape Town) and ensure managers receive timely and effective HR support.
 



  





 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced HR professional to take ownership of employee relations and performance management across a diverse international workforce spanning Mumbai, Manila, and Cape Town. Working closely with business leaders, the HR Manager will serve as the primary HR resource for complex employee matters, influencing manager capability, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience across multiple regions. The role is well suited to an experienced, confident, and pragmatic HR professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment. The ideal candidate is already comfortable managing sensitive employee relations cases, supporting business decisions, capable of making recommendations which consider individual circumstances while balancing the needs of business, and acting in ways that foster employee engagement while effectively managing organizational risk.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Independently manage employee relations matters, investigations, disciplinary processes and other employee cases across Mumbai, Manila, and Cape Town, and appropriately escalate matters which are more complex, sensitive, precedent\-setting or higher risk
* Advise and coach frontline managers in the various regions on aspects of company policy, performance management, attendance, conduct, workplace concerns and other employee issues, enabling managers to understand and address issues effectively and fulfil their people management responsibilities
* Maintain a visible and approachable persona, being a role model for professionalism in your actions while building connections and fostering trusted relationships with employees and leaders
* Manage accommodation requests, attendance concerns, grievances, complaints and other employee matters requiring HR involvement, ensuring appropriate documentation, follow\-through and resolution
* Ensure probation, performance management, investigation and disciplinary processes are completed consistently, appropriately and on time, leading formal processes where HR involvement is required
* Using available data and through direct inquiries, monitor employee relations and performance management trends across assigned regions, identify recurring issues and recommend practical actions or interventions to address underlying causes
* Escalate significant legal, financial, reputational or organizational risks promptly and appropriately



  





**Key Qualifications \& Competencies** 




  




* Minimum 5 years of experience in an HR Manager role, with significant responsibility for employee relations, performance management, workplace investigations, disciplinary processes, and employee case management in India.
* Experience supporting geographically dispersed or international teams is considered an asset. Knowledge of South African and Filipino employment legislation is not required; however, the ability and willingness to quickly learn and apply local employment practices and legal requirements is essential.
* Exceptional knowledge of Mumbai employment laws, labour standards, and HR best practices, with the ability to provide practical, risk\-based advice and ensure compliance with legal and organizational requirements.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing complex employee relations matters, including grievances, complaints, workplace investigations, disciplinary processes, accommodations, attendance concerns, and performance issues.
* Proven ability to make objective, and sometimes unpopular, recommendations while maintaining fairness, consistency, and alignment with organizational policies, values, and business objectives.
* Confident and resilient HR professional who is comfortable and experienced leading challenging conversations, holding employees and leaders accountable, and managing sensitive situations with professionalism and sound judgment.
* Strong coaching and influencing skills, capable to build solid working relationships and establish credibility with leaders, provide candid advice, and help managers effectively navigate employee and workplace issues.
